**Music, together** (Viktor: «В Креаторе ползунок Music Together не работает. Подсчёт общей силы не работает. Сам по скрину посчитай»): the bar was counted when the form was painted and never while a strength was dragged; his screen showed 3.55, the five adapters' first strengths (1.0 + 0.75 + 0.6 × 3), over 1.55 on the sliders. It follows every strength now, and it is a slider of its own: dragged, it moves every music strength at once, each in proportion to where it stood, none past its own max, the 0.005 grid's remainders shared so the sum lands where it is let go.

**The Engine page in his rows** (Viktor: «как всё ужать и передвинуть, чтобы на 1080p всё встало красиво и не таким длинным полотенцем… Ты всё замерь и пересмотри»): from 1400 px one grid of thirty columns, so thirds, fifths and sixths share it: Server over Hardware beside the log (1/3 · 2/3, the log filling the height), Compute | GPUs (2/5 · 3/5), Appearance | Writer (4/6 · 2/6), VAEs | LoRAs (1/6 · 5/6), Sliders, About; the cards in that order in the source, so the keys walk them as they are seen; narrower, the flex rows as before. At 1920×1080 the page went from 3 975 px to 3 187. About in one band of three columns (his word: «RUACH STUDIO | YuE2 + ggml + yue2.cpp | Sound decoders, Sliders, Loras. В колонке YuE2 — логотип так же, как в первой наш»): ours with the layout it took after, then the model, the engine and the tensor library under YuE2's own mark, then the add-ons. The mark is M-A-P's (the one on map-yue2.github.io), traced from the picture Viktor downloaded (a beige ground, much air): each ink split from the ground, traced, cropped, 17.8 KB inline; the word takes the theme's ink, the circle and the ² a terracotta drawn a little toward it. The files, for a light and a dark ground, in `src/brand/yue2/`.

**The 💎 workspaces from Hugging Face** (Viktor: «Воркспейсы с 💎 — именно эти идут в соответствующие репозитории. И допиши код подтягивания этих воркспейсов из репо, по запросу пользователя, и если такой существует, спрашивать о восстановлении оригинальной копией, и краткий быстрый гайд в попап оверлее… Вдруг чел туда своего напишет, а мы перезатрём всё»). A published workspace is a folder of its repo: each take as MP3 320k with its cover, and `workspace.json` (the takes with their titles, notes and sections, the meta and the request of each: seeds, settings, music codes). `heresy/tools/publish-workspaces.sh` writes and uploads it (private; it stops while takes under 90 s are there, by his rule that approved probes are made again at full length first); `lab/diamond.py` lists the sets and fetches one on the user's word: through `tmp/diamond/` into `outputs/` (meta.json last, so the library sees a take only whole) and into the Collection, locked. The Librarian's «💎 From Hugging Face…» shows each set (here or not, its takes and size, or the hub's own words when it is not published) with one button. A set whose name is here already is never written over unasked: the lab answers 409, and the page asks, saying how to keep yours: rename it, then Get, and the original comes in beside it. Restoring brings back the takes it lacks, the published titles (through the engine) and notes, the published takes in the workspace (what was added leaves it and stays in the library; sections of its own stay). Checked against the real private repo in a sandbox studio (Get: 20 takes, 99 MB in 19 s; asked again: 409; Restore after a stray take, a note, a lost take and a changed title: one take fetched, the rest put back), and the dialog in each language with the lab's answers stubbed. «💎 Instrumental Probe LoRA» is published in `goldhub/Ruach_Studio_LoRAs/samples`; the three others wait for their full-length takes and for Viktor's word on where (datasets named after his bucket, `…_WS`, are the default; the bucket itself needs a newer hub client).

**The Writer knows what the probes found** (Viktor: «И не забудь, мы по всем инструментам хотели для комнаты Писателя для LLM дописать в уставы знакомые YuE2 инструменты, как минимум те стили музыкальные, что нагенерили, и т.п.»): the writing room's charter, besides the instruments heard and those not (1069), is told the instruments only our adapters play (the shofar at epoch 110, the duduk's breath), the 35 styles kept in «💎 Musical Styles» by their own words, and the voices of «💎 Voice Types» by the words that gave each (fifteen sung, nine spoken); the four not given (a boy treble came out a girl, an old man a woman, an old woman a young contralto, and no children at all), the metallic buzz on high female voices and choirs (a dry, close vocal against it), and how the spoken probes asked for speech with no singing. The voices and the adapters live in the sheet's source with the rest (`instruments_src.py`: `VOICES`, `ADAPTERS`), the styles count when their probes stand in a 💎 workspace; the charter is about 16,000 characters.

**A frozen workspace** (Viktor: «Деактивация воркспейса. Замораживаются все треки в этом представлении, никаких действий по ним, в `All Workspaces` и в поиске не отображаются. Сам деактивированный воркспейс немного засЕривается как неактивный»; and of the API tests' workspace: «я бы сделал неактивным… удалять его невовремя»): ⋯ → Freeze… The lab keeps it so: nothing changes a take frozen with it (a take in no workspace that is not frozen) or its membership, its sections with it: no like, note, hide, pin, move, rename, merge, deletion, trash or regeneration, each refused in words; a move from elsewhere never takes a take out of it; a take also in a living workspace lives on there. The Librarian greys the workspace (❄) and shows its takes only inside it, greyed, heard and read (Play, the datasheet), nothing else; they leave All Workspaces, the search and the counts. Unfreeze in its menu brings everything back. «API test · Claude» frozen (20 takes; All Workspaces 620 → 600). Checked: the lab's rules on a sandbox collection (17 checks), the page on the real studio, the words in the seven languages.

**The sheet against his verdicts, and our two LoRA sets on it** (Viktor: «гайд по инструментам полностью пересмотри и сверь с тем, что я одобрил + наши два набора LoRA — Дудук и Шофар»): read row by row against «💎 Instrumental Probe»: 200 instruments, 159 heard, 6 kept with his own words (the cowbell that is an electric guitar, the accordion like a harmonica, the didgeridoo's B, the sambuca as a harp, the duduk, the cicadas a style), 35 not identified: his «Tested, Failed» (the oboe, the shofar's eight attempts, the natural horn, the sambuca's strings) and the instruments whose probes he took out; none waits. The duduk's and the shofar's rows carry their adapter's A/B by epoch from «💎 Instrumental Probe LoRA»: the engine alone, then e080 to e200 for the duduk; e099, e110, e121 and e167 for the shofar, ▶ A and ▶ B with their seeds and his marks (e110 liked twice, e167 disliked twice).

**Slider curves** (Viktor: «по кривым… либо было flat, как сейчас (как базовое состояние), и кривую в виде арки/параболы, либо амплитуду вручную мышкой двигая вспышки и затухания по слайдеру»; «Slider curves делай и тестируй. В гайды также добавь концепт»): a slider's strength runs through the song along its curve. In the request a slider may carry `curve`, points `[t, k]` (t the music from its first frame to the end of its budget, k the share of the strength) or a name (`flat`, `arch`, `rise`, `fall`); none is flat, as before. In the engine the gain became a one-number tensor the graph reads, set before each step to gain × curve(t), eased between two points by half a cosine, so the static decode graph is never rebuilt; the kept part of a song made again from a point counts in t; the curve goes back into the take's request, so a take made again runs the same; the log gives each curve at the song's quarters and where it stands every 250 steps. In the Creator a slider's row shows its curve small; a click opens its editor: Flat, Arch, Draw (a point dragged up for a flare, down for a fade, along the song; a double-click adds one, on a point takes it out). Tested on two throwaway servers beside the Studio: a flat slider writes the very same 750 music tokens on the new binary and the one before; an arch and a drawn dip run their schedule. The guide says it in the seven languages.

**Smaller, the same evening**: the cover's overlay as large as its picture (Viktor: «при 1024 обложке попап растягивался до 1024x1024»), and the painter keeps its 1024 px (it kept 768); the workspaces' « no longer sits on the Librarian's filters (Viktor: «Сделай отступ от кнопочки сворачивания»; the other rooms' fold buttons measured, 10 px and more); a voice probe is a probe too when made again (it came back at its old 40 s).

**The server log, read while it runs** (Viktor: «кнопочку полной распашки консоли на всю высоту, и чекбокс автопрокрутки по дефолту, — не возможно во время активности прокрутить и глянуть, что до этого»): the unfolded dock's ⤢ gives the log the window's full height (⤡ back; kept as chosen); Follow stays on by default, and a scroll up by hand lets go of it (it unticks) until you are back at the newest line (it ticks again). While you read, the lines under your eye stay put: the oldest go only past five times the count, and the view moves back by what went. The same in Engine's log. Checked live with the regenerations writing: 180 → 829 px at 1080p, 400 → 411 lines arrived and the view held.

**Nothing gzipped** (Viktor: «Мы договорились избавиться от index.html.gz и других .gz, потому что это локальный сервис и нам нет смысла экономить на сжатии файлов»): the server carries no copy of the page any more (no xxd header, no `tools/public/index.html.gz` in git, no 406 without gzip); it reads `build/tools/public/index.html` from disk, from RUACH_PAGE or else beside its own build, and a page not built yet answers 503 with what to run. `build.sh` lost its gzip line, the lab's spectrum goes as it is (`cache/*.spec`, about 10 MB for 7 minutes) and the page reads it without unpacking (and a spectrum overtaken by another take no longer leaves its "Forge is measuring…" over the newer one's result). The patches to 1166 still carry the old page as binary; the release strips it, as before.

**A photograph says whose it is** (Viktor: «Instrument pictures одобряю. Тримай и апскейли их до нашего стандартного 1024x1024»): where the painter could only guess an instrument, its probes get a photograph from Wikimedia Commons, squared to 1024 (trimmed on a plain ground, else its middle; 4x_ClearRealityV1 first where the original is small). Its `artwork.json` carries the source, file, page, licence, author and a `credit` line; the lab lists the credits with the pictures (`/lab/arts` → `credits`), and the overlay shows it under the picture («Picture: author · licence · Wikimedia Commons», the page one click away), in the seven languages. The picture it replaces is kept in `artwork-removed/`.

**The 💎 sets in one bucket** (Viktor: «Упаковывай воркспейсы 💎 в goldhub/Ruach_Studio_Instruments_Probe_WS бакет. Поставил его в private»): the four published workspaces live in that Storage Bucket, a folder each (`instrumental-probe- lora/`, `instrumental-probe/`, `musical-styles/`, `voice-types/`: the takes as MP3 320k with their covers, and `workspace.json`). A bucket is known only to huggingface_hub 2.x, and the Studio's is pinned at 0.36 (transformers 4.57 holds it under 1.0), so the lab reads the bucket over plain HTTPS: `workspace.json` and each file from `/buckets/…/resolve/…`, the token sent to the Hub only, never to the signed address the bytes come from (a header is latin-1 only: a 💎 in the User-Agent stopped the first try). `heresy/tools/publish-workspaces.sh` fills it with an hf of its own (2.1.1 in `tmp/hf-buckets-venv`, set up at its first run) and a write token (`HF_HOME`), `sync --delete` inside the set's folder. The About card's link says «Probes, styles and voices».

### 1167 · The Creator as a kitchen; the LoRA repo in four rooms

**The Creator as a kitchen** (Viktor 05.10.2026: «Левую промптинг генерации на 2/3 слева как основную, разделить её на две колонки по 1/3, всё пересмотреть и реорганизовать. Статистику/карту трека реально нужно на 1/3 ширины справа… [дубли] во втором фрейме 1/3 ширины вниз этого фрейма под-фреймом… Каждую секцию отчётливо обособить… карточным абажуром. Схлопнутые блоки… более контрастно»; on the draft: «Одобряю», the takes folded to the right, the player minimal): the form regrouped, no field changed, into two columns of barely raised cards, the words (the song with the Writer's document, the style, the lyrics) and the machine (the profile, the plan and the seeds, the sound, the adapters, the four drawers two by two). From 1600 px they stand side by side over two thirds of the room; the last third is the take over its takes, a line between them to drag (Home or a double-click for the default; kept as a share of the height), the takes in compact cards of two lines, folded to a strip at the right edge with its word on its side. Every adapter not in use waits behind one line, «Add a LoRA» with its count, remembered open or closed; folded parts and closed drawers stand on a firmer ground with the chevron in the accent. The Creator's player is one row from 1660 px, as the scaled-up page has it. Below 1600 px the three columns and their grips stay. A tip reached by the keyboard now stays while the pointer only passes (the kitchen scrolls under a still pointer when a field takes the focus). At 2560 the kitchen fits without a scroll; at 1920 it scrolls by about 430 px. Made beside the Studio first (a worktree on :41994), merged after his look.

**The LoRA repo in four rooms** (Viktor 05.10.2026: «Для репо LoRA, пока ещё не поздно, сделай структуру: instruments, styles, vocals (певчие), voices (говорящие)»): goldhub/Ruach_Studio_LoRAs holds `instruments/` (the duduk and the shofar with their A/B samples), `styles/`, `vocals/` (singing voices) and `voices/` (speaking voices), the last three with a README each until their adapters come. `heresy/tools/upload-loras.sh` stages it so; the old top-level folders left the repo once each of their files had its copy under `instruments/`. The Studio's `loras/` is unchanged: an adapter's folder goes there as it comes.

### 1168 · Frames over the Creator; the lyrics' meter and its stress marks; F5, copying, Clear and New song set right

**Frames over the room** (Viktor 06.10.2026: «прикрути на каждый фрейм — левый и правый — разворот этого фрейма на "полный экран"… с увеличением масштаба всего фрейма здесь на добрых 20%… кнопку переключения между фреймами»; later: «при начале генерации всё же не нужно схлопывать фрейм… Просто переключаться на правый, где генерация идёт… И кликами на плеер чтобы не убегал фокус»): the form and the take each lift over the room, 95 % of the screen above the player and a fifth larger, with a button to the other frame; Esc, a click beside it or another room puts it back. Generate turns a lifted frame to the take's, where the run shows; Retake, Reuse and a score into the form bring the form's frame; the player's clicks keep the frame and give the keys back to it; the take's frame tools sit in its top right corner.

**The Score card with no score** («Туда только кнопку "Сгенерить партитуру из звука"»): a take without a score shows that button alone, the tools coming with a score. **Stars:** ★ among the Librarian's filters (the favourites in the workspace in hand); the Takes' star drawn as the thumbs. **The (i) notes** («везде, где есть (i), и если там после идёт микро подсказка, либо убирай её, либо в тултип»): 23 short notes after an (i) are their tips' bold first lines; the Style bar's hint goes. **The trash and the player:** a take moved to the trash, any way, leaves the player at once. **Play this song** hides while a song is made and offers the finished one when the player only holds it.

**F5:** in the Librarian it reads the library again and keeps the page and the music (Ctrl+F5 reloads); a run's clock goes on through a reload («стоит во время генерации нажать F5, счётчик времени обнуляется»); a run brought back by F5 lands in the workspace in hand and plays when done; a setting goes to the settings file at once. **Copying** («Кнопка копирования в буфер не копирует»): opened by the machine's address (http://192.168.…) the page has no clipboard API from the browser; its own copy stands in. **The Writer's fields** one height and dress, the API key wide with «Remember» beside it. **Clear and New song** («чем она отличается от `Start new song`? Это нужно утрясти»): Clear takes the words (title, style, lyrics, score), both seeds and loaded codes; New song puts the mode, sampling, sliders and LoRAs back to the defaults as well; Sound and output stays with both.

**The lyrics' meter** («нужна не только рифма, но и длина строк… вертикальную линейку, которая по куплету+мосту будет едино мерить. По при-корусу и корусу — отдельно… спелл чекер… подсчёт символов… ручную растяжку поля»): beside each line its syllables against its group's ruler (verse and bridge one group; the pre-chorus, the chorus and every other section their own; the ruler at the median; green, amber, red), what is in round brackets hatched after (it may be sung); under the box the counts, the tags, the brackets and the phonetic hand, the browser's spelling check in the lyrics' language, a height drawn by hand kept. The 110 official examples' tags are known (a tag's head names its section; who sings or what the song is opens none); a section with no words shows its name alone. **Stress marks astray** («вшей ещё проверку проёбов с x301. Что не на гласных, в пустоте, на пробеле»): a mark off a vowel (at a line's start, after a space or a sign, on a consonant, doubled, a spacing ´) in red, a word with two in amber, a button that selects each in turn. The count, measured on his lyrics (2,033 lines): stress marks move none of it and ע counts; a decomposed «й», a composed Latin ó and Belarusian ў, counted wrong before, count right. **The cheat-sheet's Lyrics tags:** a third tab with the sections as the official examples write them, counted, who sings, the instrumental cues, the meta-tags and his phonetic hand; a click puts a tag into the lyrics.

**The guide:** the meter and his phonetic hand (the stress mark, a capital stressed vowel, ע, the Latin o, a stretched vowel, [Interlude] and [Break], round brackets, Hebrew with its points) and Save, Open, Clear and New song as they are, in all seven languages. The interface's new words are English only until the pass before 2.0.0 (Viktor: «Добавочные языки интерфейса давай в самую последнюю очередь перед финальным релизом 2.0.0»). Patches 1180–1194.

**Open** («О том, что сброшено, Open молчит… это нужно допилить»): a prompt file's places the form could not hold (a field no prompt has, an unknown mode, solver, VAE, slider or adapter, a number that is none, a knob past its bounds) are listed in the toast, each with what the form holds instead; a file the page saved opens as before.

**Another VAE in seconds** («должны лишь готовые латенты за 5-7 секунд декодироваться»; «ты как-то сохранял готовые латенты. Вот прикрутить бы этот код к движку»): the Kit's VAE buttons on a take sent its replay with another decoder, and the whole sound stage ran again. The engine now keeps each take's acoustic latents beside its audio (latents.f32, the layout of its own tensor dumps, about 3 MB for eight minutes); a request with decode_from runs the VAE alone on them. Measured on an RTX 3090: 120 s of a song decoded again in 2.1 s (1.0 s of decoding), the same VAE giving the same sound to the sample, Legacy and Blend 1.6 s each; a take made before refused with that said, and the page renders its sound again with its button saying so. **The VAE** is chosen in the ☰ menu under the model («Выбор VAE переносим в бар в спадающее меню прямо под выбор модели»), the Composer's block gone. **Max length** («То поле в блоке семплера вообще нужно убрать и передавать туда секундное значение»): read first the other way round, the music's Max tokens hidden; Viktor from the road: «В Sound and Output поле max length так и осталось». The «sampler's block» was Sound and output (the solver is its sampler): Max length lives in Sampling now, the music's time, editable with no lock, the request's duration following it; Sound and output has no length field. Setting it, the duration is written before the bounds' guard runs, which re-syncs the ceiling from it (written after, the old length pulled the new one straight back). **Denoising steps** for ODE steps («замени на понятное DENOISING STEPS»); *Reset output* puts the solver back to midpoint too («не обнуляет выбор резолвера»). **The text profile** is off while the Creator's profile is music («деактивируй текстовый профиль, потому что он чисто для начитки»).

**The Writer's backup** («глобальный экспорт/импорт всех данных скопом для бекапа»): the whole notebook in one file and back, nothing written over. **Ctrl+F in a box** («перехватывать Ctrl+F, чтобы искать… только в активном блоке»): the lyrics', the style's and the Writer's boxes find in themselves, the match marked over the box; stress marks, ё, ע and the Latin o and a do not stand in the way. Viktor's first try found two faults, mended the same hour: in a Russian layout Ctrl+F comes as «а», so the key is read (KeyF), not its letter; in a lifted frame (zoomed 1.2) the mark floated, now measured in the box's own pixels and drawn at its scale. **The training keeps ע** («Оставляй ע как есть»).

**Upstream** («По репо апстримов подтяни патчи, особенно с ggml+yue2-cpp»): yue2.cpp's five commits since our base (its ggml fork rebased on ggml 0.26.0, 147 commits: CUDA kernels and fixes among them; Windows build scripts; a CMake policy range), taken as commits of ours so the patch series stays one line. Measured: his two-minute recipe in 51 s on GPU1, 54–61 s on the engine before. The official YuE2 repository's code changes since 10.09 are its own Python's (UTF-8 I/O, batches, an example's line endings) and its instrumental recipe, which the Studio's Instrumental already follows. **Windows 11**: INSTALL_WINDOWS.md, through WSL2, said to be untried by us.

**Tags under a «[»** («при наборе `[` появлялись как в кодовых IDE подсказки с выбором, Enter и вставка? Базовые в самом начале — Verse, Bridge, etc, но на особые Intro, Outro, END проверка, если уже есть в тексте»): heresy-complete.js, on the Creator's and the Writer's lyrics. The cheat-sheet's sections (lyricTags()), the common ones first, then the three a song has once, then the rest as the examples count them; narrowed from a word's start, in a Russian or Ukrainian layout too; a typed number numbers the tag, numbered verses are offered the next; Enter or Tab inserts by the browser's own typing, so Ctrl+Z takes it back; Intro, Outro and End already there (his [END] too) last and dimmed with their line. Ctrl+Space opens it and, at a line's start, types the «[» itself (no Latin layout for it). It inserts the official examples' [End]; his songs write [END] (30 of them), which counts as there.

**The meter by the sung sections** («игнорирование подсчётов, если в строке два [] тега типа [Break] [Silence]»; «Счёт по базису реальных вокальных секций. Даже если внутри паузные, интерлюдия/прелюдия, общее продолжаем по главному тегу секции»): every [tag] of a line is a tag, never sung (a line of tags alone none, a tag inside a line left out); a pause, break, silence, interlude, prelude or instrumental cue inside a sung section opens no group (dimmed, the section's ruler goes on); before the first sung section an intro's lines keep their own. **A syllable** («Считает гласные, а нужно считать слоги… Я|же|ви|жу|глу|п|цо́в|с|при|ду́р|чес|ким|пла|ном… 15 долей. Сможешь унифицировать счётчики и для всех языков»): in Russian a syllable is one vowel letter, and the meter counted that; his split is fourteen parts, two with no vowel (п, с), consonants that take time but are no syllable: глуп-цо́в спри-ду́р-чес-ким, twelve. Elsewhere it was wrong, and is mended: Spanish and Italian went by English (a final e silent: «noche» one), Greek lost its diaeresis, Hebrew counted ע and the shin's dot, Chinese counted nothing. Each language by its own rules now; the Latin words' language from the style, else from the lyrics' small words (the spelling check follows it).

**Seen, asked of the page** («Твоя подсветка работает при ровном скейле в 100%. На 110% уже съехала вниз»): not the zoom. A lifted frame's sticky Generate bar is 70 px, and the frame's own box reaches under it; a match was taken for seen down to 48 px above the frame's foot, so in the 22 px between nothing scrolled and the mark stood on the bar; at 110 % his line fell there. Measured with a real browser zoom (the profile's zoom level): at 100 % and at 110 % a line put under the bar left the mark on it. Now whether a line is seen is asked of the page (what stands at that point), the browser scrolls a probe into the middle of every box on the way, and a mark is drawn only on words seen; the stress marks' button likewise. **The view stays** («Если активен виджет поиска… встал курсором на другом месте, и единое движение клавишами… переносит оттуда на место поиска»): words typed in the box count the matches again and do not move the view; Esc from the box closes the bar and leaves the cursor; Esc in the find bar or the tags' list of a lifted frame closes them and keeps the frame. **The solver** spans two columns of Sound and output while the MP3 bitrate is hidden («Расширь селектор солвера на две колонки, чтобы была симетрия»). Patches 1196–1197.

**Consonant beats** (to my offer to draw «согласные доли» as the brackets are drawn: «Допиши одиночные согласные доли, потому что мы не меряем по реальным слогам между 2 и 4 символами, а по реальной затрате времени на произношение»): the meter measures the time a line takes. In Russian, Ukrainian and Belarusian words, a word with no vowel (с, в, к, з, й, ў) and a stop right after a vowel closed against an affricate (п|ц, т|ч, д|ц; not сердце's silent д, whose stop follows a consonant) are beats of their own, counted with the line's syllables (its bar, its number, the group's ruler) and drawn lighter at the bar's end; under the box the syllables stay syllables, the consonant beats counted beside them. His line «Я же вижу глупцо́в с приду́рческим планом» is 12 and 2: 14, his own split. The rule inside a word is narrow on purpose (his one example: глу|п|цо́в; not г|д in когда, not к|т in доктор): widened when his ear asks. **[END]**: the tags list writes it as his songs do («Да, измени»); the cheat-sheet keeps the official examples' [End]. Patch 1198.

**Two or more variations crashed the engine; ggml's mask scan.** compute-sanitizer on the crashing request (probe120-claves, M=2): «Invalid __global__ read of size 4… flash_attn_mask_to_KV_max<32>… block (0,1,0)… 11,777 bytes after the nearest allocation». The NAR asks flash attention for M sequences over one mask (ne[3] = 1); the scan that finds each tile's last key runs when the keys are a multiple of FATTN_KQ_STRIDE (nar_kv_pad makes them so, for the grouped-query path) and stepped by the mask's nb[3]: from the second variation on it read past the mask, crashing where that page was unmapped and cutting attention short with a wrong limit where it was not. ggml is a submodule of the yue2.cpp author's fork, so the fix is a patch file of ours, build/ggml-patches/0001 (`s33 = mask->ne[3] == 1 ? 0 : …`), which build.sh puts on before the server is built (once; one that no longer fits is said). Checked on GPU1 with fresh engines: claves M=2 BF16 and Q8_0, M=9, a whole 120 s take at M=4 and 452 s at M=2, all done. Patch 1212.

Three holes, each measured on GPU1 first. ① `qw3lm_kv_sets` only grew: after two guided probes four sets (10.75 GB at the whole 24 576 window) stayed for good, and a 300 s sound after them found no room; now `pipeline_generate` gives back more than two sets when it ends, whichever way (a destructor; never mid-run: probe i's NAR reads set i), and the same 300 s sound runs (16 443 MiB). ② A failed graph allocation left the NAR's and the VAE's scheduler half-reserved and the next request asserted in it, killing the engine: both renew it now (`nar_out_of_memory`, `vae_out_of_memory`) and say why in the job («Out of GPU memory for decoding the sound: 0.4 of 23.6 GB free for a tile of 1040 frames…»), checked by holding 10.5 GB of the card with a stranger's tensor: the 452 s run failed in words and the engine answered the next request. **Probes at once by the card** (Viktor: «адаптивно под VRAM Tiers 32/24/16/12/8 + выбор и реальный вес GGUF'ов… формулу дефолта и максимума, дабы избежать OOM»). `fitBatchFor(GiB, model, seconds)` = ⌊(VRAM − 0.6 − (GGUF GiB + 0.4) − (3.9 + 0.0072·s)) / 5.25⌋, at least 1: the weights as their file weighs (BF16 6.68, Q8_0 3.55, Q6_K 2.74, Q5_K_M 2.44 GiB) with the decoder and the engine's base, a guided probe's two KV sets 5.25 GiB at the whole window, the sound's and the decoder's working memory by the length (measured 4.8 GiB at 120 s, 7.2 at 452). queueVersions writes min(probes, max-batch, fit) per pass and says when the card made it fewer. 24 GB BF16: 2 at 120 s (22.0 GiB measured), 1 at 300 s (23.5 of 23.56 measured: the edge), Q8_0 2 at 480 s; a 16 GB card cannot hold BF16 at all, and the out-of-memory window offers Q8_0. **A voice's kind in the Trainer** (Viktor 05.10.2026: «Ты можешь у Тренера прикрутить… что определяет тип голоса? Мужской или женский, регистр? Нам не нужны Имена человеков, а нужны именно их тональности»; the README's To do «measured on speech and on singing, shown beside the set, with a name to give it»). `lab/voice_kind.py` (1167, pYIN over twelve tracks, twenty seconds each) gains a sung mode: the range sung as notes (10th, 50th and 90th percentile), male or female only when the middle is under 200 Hz or over 300 Hz, no register (the melody, not the voice, sets the pitch there). `POST /train/voice` measures a raw folder in a thread (about half a minute; 2.8 s on three clips of eight seconds) and keeps `voice-kind.json` beside the songs; `/train/datasets` carries it. The Material step shows it on each folder, in the picked folder's line (speech or singing taken from the lyrics' section tags, ♂ ♀ or by pitch, *Measure again*), beside the sets made from it, and offers *Name the set voice-ru-m-baritenor-117* (the lyrics' letters give the language), as the published voice adapters are named. Patch 1225, lab.

**The lyrics box as a code editor** (Viktor 08.10.2026: «В редактор лирики можно как в кодовом редакторе отображение номера строки? И вообще… по Alt+K маркировать строки, а по Alt+J прыгать на них. И подсвечивать тонким альфа слоем все музыкальные теги»). `HeresyLyrics.aids(area)` puts three layers over a lyrics box: the numbers in its left padding (40 px), a layer of the tags' boxes and the marked lines' bands, and a copy of its layout to measure them by (as the meter's). A line's number stands on its first row, a tag's box is read from the copy's spans (`getClientRects`, so a wrapped tag gets two). Marks are line numbers kept with a signature of the text: an edit moves them by the lines gained or lost after the first changed character, and a mark on a line taken out goes with it. A reload brings them back when the text is the same. Alt+K, Alt+J, Alt+Shift+J and Alt+Shift+K are on the box itself; the meter's bar says *Marks: N* (a press goes to the next) and switches the numbers. The Creator's box and the Writer's have it. Patch 1226.

The engine takes `end_at` (with `decode_from` the kept latents are decoded only so far: 8.4 s for 5:54 on a 3090) and `fade_out` (a half cosine over the last seconds, in both the decode and the render jobs; both written into a take's request only when used); the page's End at… asks the moment (the player's place offered), cuts the music codes to match and titles the take «· ends at m:ss». Tested on a copy of that take on GPU1: 354.52 s, the last half second at −64 dB against −42 in the original, the first 5:30 correlating 0.99998 with it (the level 1.3 % apart: the normalization's peak is taken over what is kept).

**Recite: the promo's narrator in the Studio** (Viktor 08.10.2026, 03:00: «И пожалуйста, твою утилиту для генерации партитур `score`, ... прикрути её в Студию»; «те утилиты, что ты имеешь во внутренней кухне, если видишь, что их можно вынести в паблик Студии, без вреда нашей кухне, - выноси смело»). heresy/tools/promo/promo_score_voice5.py laid the promo's lines on «Promo bed · C»'s own score with a hand-made table of tones per chord and one take's numbers written in; heresy-recite.js does it for any score in the form and any lyrics: the head kept, the blocks read (a section, a meter change, the Vocal line, the Ins lines), each bar's chords at their offsets; the words from the bar after the score's intro (not where its own voice first sings: a bed's voice may be a vocalise at its very end, which put the promo's words on bar 51 of 56), else from bar 2; a line from a bar's start, a section on an even bar after a bar's rest; a syllable an eighth (the Studio's own count, the language told by its letters: ў be, ї є ґ uk, Cyrillic ru, Greek el, else Latin), a breath after a comma (an eighth) and a full stop (a quarter), the line's last syllable a quarter on the chord tone below. The reciting tone is the chord tone nearest the last one around D above middle C (the bed's own voice sat two octaves up, which put the first try on f' to a'), the up and down tones its neighbours in the chord; accidentals written against the key and the bar so far; lengths only the dialect's (1 2 3 4 6 8 12 16 24 32 48, a 10 an 8 tied to a 2) and one to four bars a group, as the strict reader asks. On the promo bed: five Russian lines on bars 17–33 of 56, 80 notes, read back clean. The button asks first, replaces the score and the lyrics through the boxes' own history (Ctrl+Z) and turns Direct to Full.

**The Refiner's chain in the order of the work** (Viktor 08.10.2026: «У Огранщика во первых нужно перепроверить пайплайн и его логичность. Апскейлер нужен в двух местах - перед разделением на стемы и в конце после ремастера (как уже есть). По дефолту стеммер - four»). What it was: Debuzz › Upscale › Remaster of a single file, then the checks, and the stems last, split from the raw take (the frame buzz in them), the preset and the de-esser off in the chain for want of stems. What it is: Debuzz › Upscale › Stems › Remaster › Upscale, then Artifacts, Spectrum, Lyrics. lab.py: `stems_async(name, mode, source)` splits a file of the tree into a set of its own (`stems-MODE-TIME`, its source in the manifest; the same file again answers with that set, the take's own set stays `stems-MODE`); the chain splits the file before its remaster and remasters the set (the preset, the levels, the de-esser on the voice; without stems the de-ess is recorded off); its upscale at the end runs on the remaster with the remaster's `tp` as a ceiling (upscale_job.py measures the true peak four times oversampled and turns the whole file down to it; the manifest keeps `ceiling_db`, `true_peak_db`, `turned_down_db`). GET /stems and the API's stems take `source`, four by default; rpp.py and dawproject.py take the newest set of each kind (several of one kind would double the tracks). The page: the chain row in that order (the stems' select four first; the prefs moved once to four, the end's upscale starting as the first one is), the Remaster says its preset and de-ess when the chain splits stems, and its preset and de-esser come alive for it; the Stems step has a *Source* (the take, a debuzzed or upscaled file) and Split: four stems first. Measured on a 21 s take in a copy of the lab (heresy/MISC/claude-labtest, GPU1/GPU2, 128 s for the whole chain): each step took the file before it; the de-esser ran on vocals.flac; the remaster mixed the set from −15.7 to −14.0 LUFS; the end's upscale read −0.99 dBTP and turned the file down 0.01 dB, ffmpeg then reads −14.0 LUFS and −1.0 dBTP. Why the second upscale (absolute band energy, dB): the «other» stem carries hiss above 22 kHz 15 dB over its input (35.1 against 19.9), the mix gets +7 dB at 20–22 kHz from it (32.2 against 24.8), and the remaster keeps almost nothing above 22 kHz (7.6); the upscale at the end gives 21.8 and 17.4, near the first one's 24.8 and 19.9. Below 12 kHz nothing changes. Not measured: how it sounds; that is the ear's, in the tree's Compare. Also checked: a chain without stems (Debuzz › Remaster › Upscale, the de-ess off), the same source split again (200 at once, no new split), and a REAPER project after a second set of four (one set went in, the newest, sample for sample). Patch 1245.

**The lyrics' text alone, a frame's three steps, and the fields that did not grow** (Viktor 08.10.2026: «В Lyrics можно + и - только в самой зоне текста, а не весь интерфейс? Сейчас скейлится весь попап блокфрейм. В попапе фреймов всё скейлится с 4-мя шагами. Очень много. Опусти до 3-х. Поле Title остаётся почему-то прежним размером. **Pinokio** (Viktor 09.10.2026: «Пиши pinokio.js. Скачал и установил Пинокио для теста. На ноуте. Давай в RC3 включаем и не тянем коня за хвост»; asked for in #1 on 07.10). Read from Pinokio 8.2.0's own code (resources/app.asar), not from its documentation, which lags behind it: a launcher is pinokio.js (the menu; its info.exists, info.running and info.local are synchronous and resolve against it) and scripts of steps; `requires: {bundle: "ai"}` brings, on Linux with NVIDIA, miniforge with git, node, ffmpeg, uv, gxx<12 and nvidia/label/cuda-12.8.1::cuda (cudnn, nccl), CUDA_HOME at that miniforge; every shell.run gets Pinokio's own stops on /error:/i and /errno /i, which pip and cmake trip without failing, so ours turn them off (break: false) and each script stops on a line of its own («ruach install stopped: …»); the text is stripped of ANSI before a pattern sees it; Pinokio keeps its own files out of git through .git/info/exclude. So pinokio.js is the menu only (Install, Installing, Start, Starting, Open the Studio with the Terminal, More models, Update, Install again, Reset; installed means .venv's Python, the engine and the F32 VAE), and the work is bash: pinokio/env.sh (the toolkit: /usr/local/cuda-12.8 first, the way the Studio is made and tested, with the machine's gcc 11 to 14 and conda's nvcc flags unset; else Pinokio's; else an nvcc 12.8 on the PATH; build.sh and start.sh take it as RUACH_CUDA_HOME), install.sh (six steps; the backbone by the biggest card: BF16 from 24 GB, Q8_0 from 16, Q6_K from 12, Q5_K_M below), lab.sh and studio.sh (as their units run them; one that answers already is left alone and its address still reaches the menu), update.sh (main, fast-forward only; a release tag the page's own update checked out goes back to main), extras.sh (the painter, the listener and the trainer's base by the card, each asked with its size by fetch-heresy.sh; llama-mtmd-cli built for a GGUF listener), reset.sh (.venv, .venv-art and build/build only). Measured on Viktor's laptop (Quadro RTX 5000 16 GB, compute 7.5, Ubuntu 24.04, CUDA 12.8, gcc 13): its ~/.local/bin/ninja is a pip wrapper whose module is gone, build.sh took it (command -v) and cmake stopped; env.sh and build.sh now ask ninja --version, and env.sh puts PyPI's cmake and ninja into .venv/tools-bin when the machine's are missing or dead. install.sh whole on a copy of the public tree, with real venvs, the real cmake and the real engine build (pip's packages and the models stubbed): the engine in 338 s (225 steps), the whole install.sh in 353 s. The engine's RUNPATH names only its build folder, and libggml-cuda needs libcudart, libcublas and libnccl: start.sh puts /usr/local/cuda-12.8/lib64 first (on the laptop /usr/local/cuda is 12.4, and ld.so.conf names it), but a conda prefix keeps them in targets/x86_64-linux/lib and lib, so env.sh puts those first when the toolkit is Pinokio's; a toolkit can be named beforehand (RUACH_CUDA_HOME=… bash pinokio/install.sh), which is how Pinokio's own will be tried on the laptop once its AI bundle is there. heresy/tools/check-pinokio.mjs: the menu in nine states, every script's shape, the stop lines through the colours, the lab's and the engine's own lines (the port taken), start.sh's banner not ending the step early, bash -n on every script, build.sh's ninja and both CUDA_HOME lines: 62 passed (on the laptop's copy and on Forge's tree). Found on the way, for the audit: build.sh's page guard stops on a folder whose name the page contains (a clone into studio: the page has «studio» 565 times, «ruach» 58, «music» 1569; Pinokio's own names, Ruach_Studio.git and github_com_igrbible_Ruach_Studio, 0); convert-models.sh needs build/checkpoints/{YuE2-3B, YuE2-Vae, SheetSage2, MERT-v2-FullSong}, which a fresh install never gets (read, not run). The lab's studio_restart() asked systemctl to restart a unit Pinokio does not have and answered «restarting» all the same (and the page then said the Studio was back, as /hardware never went away): it now refuses where ruach-studio is not active and says how; a neutral answer that lied. Windows 11 through WSL2 under Pinokio is for later: Pinokio runs cmd.exe there. Patch 1259.

**Find and replace** (Viktor 09.10.2026, in his audit of the Creator: «В редактор можно добавить F4/Ctrl+H, с учётом регистра и без»). heresy-find.js: F4 or Ctrl+H in a song's box (the boxes Ctrl+F knows) opens the find bar with a second row, the words to put instead (#findR), *Replace* and *All*; from the bar's own find field the keys add the row. Enter in it puts the words in place of the match in hand and goes on to the next after them, Ctrl+Enter replaces every match at once (the text rebuilt and put in as one insertText, so one Ctrl+Z takes it all back; the box keeps its scroll; the bar says how many were replaced); each replacement goes in as typed (execCommand, the lyrics editor's way of 1169). A match keeps covering a stress mark, so обещано replaces обе́щано whole. **Aa** (Alt+C from either field) finds only as the case is typed, kept in yue2.findCase: fold() and pattern() keep the case then, and his hand's kin stay kin in capitals (О finds O, Е finds Ё). The bar wraps into two rows (up to 440 px). The suite: F4 opens both rows; any case finds three, Aa one (kept); Enter replaces it, Alt+C turns the case off, Ctrl+Enter replaces the two left (counted), one undo brings them back; a stressed word replaced whole; Ctrl+H opens it too. Patch 1276.

**The lyrics as plain text** (Viktor 09.10.2026: «Кнопку экспорта/импорта содержимого редактора в голый txt формат, авто имя файла по Title трека»). " < > | and the control characters) become spaces, the spaces run together, a leading dot goes, 120 characters at most, «lyrics.txt» without a Title; UTF-8, the line ends as LF and one at the end. The second takes a .txt through a hidden file input: a byte-order mark, Windows line ends and blank lines at the end dropped; a file with a character UTF-8 cannot read (U+FFFD after decoding: a cp1251 file, say) or longer than the box's 10 000 is refused with a toast that says why, never put in cut or garbled; with words in the box it asks first (*Replace*); the text goes in as typed over the whole box, so one Ctrl+Z gives the old words back; an empty Title takes the file's name. The buttons stop their click, so the Lyrics head does not fold. The suite: the name and the bytes of a save; a .txt with a BOM and CRLF put in after the question, the Title kept, one undo back; a cp1251 file refused out loud; an empty Title filled and an empty box not asked. Now: the sliders take their catalog, licences and weights only; every download runs through again() (its output kept in tmp/fetch-heresy.last.log, tried once more after 30 s) and a failure says why() (the downloader's last two lines); a folder that differs from the pin but whose .cache/huggingface/download holds the pinned revision is ours unfinished, so the next run goes on with it (it was «kept, --replace fetches it»: Install again could never finish it); the legacy and blend decoders and the sliders are made into GGUF right after their checkpoints by convert-extras.py alone (the Kit's convert-models.sh, which the install advised, wants the backbone's own checkpoints, which no install fetches), with the Kit's links build/checkpoints and build/models made where a released tree has none (and ignored in its .gitignore). The root's .gitignore keeps .venv-art/ and what Pinokio writes beside its scripts (logs/, ENVIRONMENT, its agents' notes) out of git, so Update keeps working. The release's scan for this machine's traces lets the fonts' licence pass (Raleway's names its designer with a mail address). Tried on a released tree on the Forge: --check names all 25 missing; the fetch brought them, failed 0 (sliders 246 MB, the decoders and the 16 sliders made, Whisper, the stems, UniverSR, the Kit's library, the 15 adapters); a slider's weight taken away came back by itself at the next run; --check --backbone BF16 says it is missing with its size. **The converted models come converted, from goldhub/Ruach_Studio_Models_v2** (Viktor 10.10.2026: «зачем нам конвертировать модели каждый раз? Может в репо положим сконвертированные и пропишем их в коде вместо тех, что ты конвертируешь каждый раз у юзера?»; «Да, заливай goldhub/Ruach_Studio_Models_v2… Но... тысячу раз перепроверь, что именно мы используем как рабочие веса, и в этот goldhub/Ruach_Studio_Models_v2 у нас идёт только продакшн»; «checkpoints/, по сути, это артефакт YuE2-Kit репо… Если checkpoints останется пустым, тогда его в gitignore»). What the engine runs on, read from the live studio's own command line: the four backbones, the default decoder and SheetSage2 Q8_0, as GGUF from Serveurperso/YuE2-GGUF and never converted here; the legacy and blend decoders (--vae legacy, --vae blend) and the 16 sliders with their catalog (--sliders), these three converted on every install from 1.3 GB of checkpoints (m-a-p/YuE2-Vae-legacy @ 5ddd12f, Mothersuperior/YuE2-Vae-merge-0.666 @ b00bdfc, ntc-ai/yue2-particle-sliders @ 33cf42f) by convert-extras.py, which wants gguf, numpy and safetensors in the user's Python and the Kit's links build/checkpoints and build/models (what failed on his laptop). **The Trainer's knobs explained, measured, and a run that goes on** (Viktor 10.10.2026: «В тренере смотри на RANK - подсказка под полем инлайн. И можно ли на завершённом тренинге продолжить по большему количеству эпох?»; «В гайде по LoRA Trainer ты не объяснил все параметры. Я так и не смог полностью сориентироваться по AR WEIGHT и AR ANCHOR, Пересмотри этот гайд, пожалуйста»). From lab/trainer/train.py: every step's loss is flow + ar_loss_weight × ar_ce + ar_kl_weight × KL(base ‖ adapted); the music half's cache reaches the sound half detached, so the flow loss never trains the music half, and the KL is reckoned only when the AR weight is above 0; AdamW (eps 1e-6, weight decay 1e-2) with the music half's adapter at lr × ar_lr_multiplier, both halves' gradients clipped together at 1.0. AdamW sizes every step by its own running gradients, so the size of the AR weight barely matters: what counts is whether it is 0, the anchor's share of it, and AR speed. Measured on GPU2 (Viktor's own run, trained on GPU1 meanwhile, untouched): eight runs of 40 steps on voice-natalia-korneva (60 readings), rank 16, lr 0.0001, one seed; the size of the adapter's change to the music half's matrices (B·A) and how far each run's came out from the first's: 0.5 · 0.2 · 0.5 1.32 (the same again: 1 %); 1.0 · 0.4 · 0.5 1.36 (5 %); no anchor 1.44 (23 %); the anchor as large as the weight 1.21 (17 %, its KL halved); AR speed 1.0 2.32 (99 %, its KL 0.443 against 0.257); AR weight 0: all zeros. The sound half moved 4 to 13 % between rows against 2 % for the same run twice (the shared clipping). VRAM 10.5 GB with the KL, 9.1 without, 8.2 with the music half off (rank 16, bf16). One run went on from its save at step 40 to 60 («going on from …_000000040.safetensors»). The guide's Trainer chapter in seven languages: section 3 every field of the form in its order (what a step is: a 60-second window for the sound half, the song from its start for the music half; whole epochs, 2016 tracks for 12 epochs are 24 192 steps; the saves and the optimizer's state; the learning rate as the sound half's step; Mode and separation for AI-Toolkit) with the kinds' knobs in a table; «Rank and the Other Knobs» keeps the rank and the sample rate; a new section, «The Music Half's Three Knobs», the lesson and the anchor, the loss, each knob, the measured table and what to turn when; Telemetry its tiles (ar_kl), the stacked curves, the log. The form: the rank's share and size are its tip's first line (data-tip-head), not a line under it; the AR knobs' tips say the same as the guide, and «How they work ›» opens its section; a finished run of the Studio's own trainer goes on to more epochs from its ⋯ menu (asked how many in all, four more offered; the same run, set and knobs, the steps for them: the lab's run of the same name takes the last save and the optimizer's state); Steps' max 20 000 → 1 000 000. **The Artist paints from a reference picture; one card for everything, tried for real** (Viktor 10.10.2026: «Артиста по модели InvokeAI постарайся на максимум вывести со всем возможным ахуем»; «На единственной видеокарте нужно автоматом выгружать модели… Иначе никак»). diffusers has no image to image for Krea 2 (Krea2Pipeline paints from noise; its modular blocks were not tried), so artist_job.py does what InvokeAI does: the picture covers the shape and is cut from the middle, goes through Krea 2's VAE (the Wan 2.1 VAE, a frame of one), is normalized as the pipeline decodes (latents · std + mean, here the other way), packed, and noised to a sigma; the pipeline then runs the tail of its own 8 sigmas from there (the scheduler shifts them with mu 1.15, Krea 2 Turbo being distilled: the 8 sigmas 1 … 0.125 begin at 1, 0.96, 0.91, 0.84, 0.76, 0.66, 0.51 once shifted; the strength asked takes the nearest, two steps at least). **The Artist repaints only what a mask says** (Viktor 10.10.2026: «Артиста по модели InvokeAI постарайся на максимум вывести со всем возможным ахуем»). Inpainting on the same latents as the reference (1305), as InvokeAI does it with models that have no inpainting pipeline of their own: the mask (white repaints) covers each shape as the reference does, goes to the packed latents' tokens (at the latent's size, softened by one latent pixel, each token the largest over its 2 × 2 patch), and a callback at every step puts the kept tokens back as the reference noised to the step's next sigma (the scheduler's own; the last puts back the reference itself), chained before the live preview's; the finished picture takes the reference's own pixels outside the mask, feathered by 12 px, so nothing outside moves. **His samplers and schedules** (Viktor 10.10.2026: «По моему набору семплеров хочу попросить, чтобы ты их внедрил. Некоторые из них их кастомного пакета нод KJNodes. У меня весь код в ComfyUI инсталяции. Семплеры: er_sde, res_*s, res_*s_ode, heun(pp2), exp_heun_2_x0(_sde). Планировщики: bong_tangent, sgm_uniform, exponential, beta, kl_optimal, beta57.»). The Artist's sampling for its flow-matching painters is the Studio's own now (`lab/artist_samplers.py`, a scheduler over diffusers' FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler): ER-SDE (the third-order ER-SDE solver of Cui et al., one evaluation a step), RES 2s and 3s with their deterministic _ode twins (the refined exponential solver of Zhang et al.: two stages at ½, three at ½ and 1; the stochastic ones put half the noise back each step, as a rectified flow takes it), Heun++ (Carzit's, MIT: three evaluations a step) and the exponential Heun of data prediction in log-SNR time (SEEDS-2 with r = 1; η 1 for its SDE), all on x0 = x − σ·v and λ = log((1−σ)/σ); the schedules Beta 57, KL optimal, SGM uniform and Bong tangent beside diffusers' Simple, Karras, Exponential and Beta. Written from the methods' papers and ComfyUI's formulas (GPL-3.0, which the Studio's AGPL may take); RES4LYF was read for its mathematics only, its licence barring commercial services, so none of its code is here. A method of several evaluations a step lays its stage points into the timesteps as diffusers' Heun does, so the mask's blender and the previews read each step's noise right, and each picture of a run noises by its own seed. Against the exact map of a toy flow at 8 steps they rank as their orders say (Euler 0.138, Heun++ 0.111, exponential Heun 0.084, RES 2s 0.058, RES 3s 0.046). The form says what each costs (its evaluations a step) and times the run by it. The second matrix (`heresy/MISC/claude-artist/matrix-1333`, 24 pictures through the test lab on GPU2, one prompt, seed 1328): every new sampler kept the picture whole on Krea 2 Muse, on 2512 Q4 with Lightning and on an fp8 fine-tune; KL optimal under Lightning painted two lighthouses on 2512 Q4, as Karras and Exponential did in the first matrix, while Beta 57, SGM uniform and Bong tangent kept it whole; the warning under the sampling names all three (1333c). Suite 622/0. Patches 1333, 1333b, 1333c.

**The upscalers' notes, an upscale in passes, Upscayl looked into** (1355; Viktor 11.10.2026: «Пройдись по репо всех моих апскейлеров и собери инфу по каждому, и оформи это в попап подсказки, чтобы человек видел, на что какой годится. И можно ли двух-трёх проходный апскейл делать наподобие того, как у меня в ComfyUI workflow? Вникни в код https://github.com/upscayl/upscayl… может быть можно этот Upscayl использовать под капотом»). The 38 models of his artwork/upscalers/ (his DIFFUSION_MODELS_etc/upscale_models) were matched to OpenModelDB's database (its data/models, cloned) by their SHA-256, else by their original names, the rest by the Civitai ids in the notes beside them; lab/upscalers.json keeps each one's title, author, architecture and licence as published, our own words on what it is for (photos, faces, art) and its time and card peak measured in the Studio's own upscale on GPU2 (1024² in: SPAN 0.9 s, Real-ESRGAN Compact 0.7, ESRGAN 2.6, DAT 14–17, HAT-L 20 at 5 GB, 8× ESRGAN 6.4 at 8 GB; heresy/MISC/claude-artist/1355/bench_up.py, bench.json, make_info.py). The measuring found 4x_Nomos8k_atd_jpg, the upscaler of his own workflow, failing in the Studio: spandrel's ATD says it takes bfloat16 and fails in it («expected scalar type Float but found BFloat16»); artist_upscale.load() tries each precision on a 64² tile first (ATD: float32, 28.9 s, 6.75 GB). The page: an i beside the choice, its tip the chosen one's notes, a click the window of them all (grouped, quickest first, the non-commercial marked, each with its page; a row picked is the choice); the list read anew each time Upscale… opens. The passes: his AIO QWEN IMAGE 2512 HERESY Draft #4 (user/default/workflows, traced through its Set/Get nodes) feeds a 2× second latent pass through CR Multi Upscale Stack (span otf strong ×2, then Nomos8kDAT ×4, Remacri ×1.5, UltraMix Balanced ×2) and CR Apply Multi Upscale (bilinear), then DF_Image_scale_to_side 7680 (Lanczos) and ColorMatch hm-mvgd-hm. Comfyroll's apply (read in his custom_nodes) runs each model over the picture as it stands and brings the result to the ORIGINAL size × the pass's factor, supersampling 8× before each resize. artist_upscale.chain() does the same, without the supersampling (PIL's downscale filters already average every pixel they cover) and with a pass's input brought down when its model would make more than 600 MP; the long side; match() is hm-mvgd-hm (histograms, Monge-Kantorovich mean and covariance, histograms) in numpy, its statistics at a megapixel, applied band by band. The tiles go into 8-bit as they come (the same rounding, a fourth of the memory). POST /artist/upscale takes {passes, resample, long, match}; the run says the pass it is on (chain_at). The page: Passes… beside 2K and 4K: up to four rows of a model and a factor, how they land, the long side, the colours, his chain one click away (where its four models are here), the size and time said by each pass's measured time; Again redoes the passes. Tried on the test lab: his chain over a 1920×1080 picture, 7680×4320 in 246 s (2.1 + 128.6 + 78.0 + 11.0), no seam, the colours kept. Upscayl (github.com/upscayl/upscayl, AGPL-3.0, read at a00d55f): an Electron and Next.js shell over upscayl-bin (upscayl/upscayl-ncnn, a fork of Real-ESRGAN-ncnn-vulkan) spawned per picture with -i -o -s -m -n -g -f -w -c -t -x (input, output, scale, models folder, model, GPU, format, custom width, compression, tile, TTA): files in, files out, its progress on stderr; seven models of its own in ncnn's form (Standard, Lite, High Fidelity, Remacri, UltraMix Balanced, UltraSharp, Digital Art; three of them marked non-commercial) and custom ones as .param and .bin pairs; Double Upscayl runs the binary twice. Under the hood it could serve, but it would give less: ncnn on Vulkan runs the ESRGAN and Compact families only (none of DAT, HAT, ATD, SPAN, OmniSR, the best of his folder), its models must be converted, and the Studio already runs the same .pth on CUDA through spandrel. What it teaches is taken or noted: passes (Double Upscayl, more general here), TTA (eight flips averaged) and a folder upscaled at once as TODO. Suite 671/0 (suite-1355.part), live 671/0, i18n 18/0. Patch 1355.

**The player goes on** (1361; TODO.md: «A take that does not play on late in the long page test (buffered at readyState 1), and the WAV fallback that does not resume a take asked to play»). It was meant to ask whether the element was playing, and could not: Chrome pauses a failed element silently before its error is heard (measured on the mock, the events in order: play, error with a capture listener still seeing it playing, the page's handler seeing it paused, no pause event between). The play asked for is now what the events say: a play event sets it, a pause event ends it, and a new take loaded without A/B's same-bar switch clears it (a pause followed at once by a new address loses its pause event: the load drops the element's queued events, which is why loadPlayer clears it itself); the fallback plays the WAV when it was asked (probe: the time ran on, 0.6 to 3.4 s of a 4 s take, then play-on went to the next take), and a take only loaded stays paused. The long test's take that sat buffered at readyState 1 (not understood) is met where it shows: a take asked to play whose sound is all here, and that stays short of playing with its time standing for 4 s, is loaded again in place and asked once more (the console says so); a second time it is paused and said. A slow line is not this, since its sound is not all here, and waits as before. stepTake's play is no longer swallowed: a refusal says why, as every other play does. **An adapter's strength over the steps** (1365; TODO.md: «Their strength by steps (keyframes, as Viktor's ComfyUI hooks)»). An adapter may carry keyframes, [[a share of the steps, a multiplier]…] (up to eight; a share 0–1, a multiplier 0–2), which shape its own strength as ComfyUI's LoRA hooks keyframe theirs: «0%:1, 50%:1, 60%:0» keeps it whole for half the steps and lets it go by 60 %. artist_loras.py: keyframes() checks them (in order, all at 1 is none), key_at() reads the multiplier at a share (straight between keyframes; before the first its value, after the last the last's; two at one share make a step), step_weights() the adapters' strengths at a step. artist_job.py: lora_sched() (a0, a1… with their strengths and keyframes, when one has them), lora_start() sets step 0's before the run, lora_steps() each next one before its step, the callback after the others (the live picture, the mask) whose answer it passes on; in Krea 2's run, and in the Qwen painters' through keyed() before each of their four calls, Lightning (speed) in every step's set at its own strength, since set_adapters lets go of an adapter not named. The page: ⏱ beside an adapter opens its field (focused), read as typed (a share as a percent, a multiplier; «half:1» or past 2 said where it stands, nothing kept), kept with the adapter, ⏱ lit while it has them, sent with Draw and said in the run's line; ⏱ again closes the field and lets them go. test_keys.py 10/0 (the keyframes, the reading between them, the calls on a stand-in pipe: step 0 before, ten more, Lightning in every set, the other callback asked and its answer passed on); try_keys.py 4/0 on GPU2 through the test lab (Krea 2 Muse Q4, Cinematic Movie Still at 0.8, one seed: keyframes all at 1 gave the very picture of the strength all the way, 99 dB; whole for half the steps then gone gave another, 29.4 dB from it; the keyframes said in the run; 277 s for four pictures). **The wave's scope** (1374; Viktor 11.10.2026: «когда я навожу мышку на волну трека в полноформатном трейлере, выводить спектральный граф полной длиной на весь трек, а тултип с отрезком текста выше. **The Artist's second pass** (1384; the rest of Viktor's ComfyUI workflow, AIO QWEN IMAGE 2512 HERESY Draft #4, read node by node: «1st Pass + 2x Upscale» is DF_Image_scale_by_ratio 2× nearest-exact, VAEEncodeTiled, InjectLatentNoise+ 0.6, then «#2 KSampler (Advanced)» from step 20 of 60 at CFG 4.5 with the same sampler and schedule as the first pass, both from one SamplerParameterPacker, er_sde and bong_tangent as it is saved; the res_3s and kl_optimal in that node's own fields are overridden by its inputs). The lab: POST /artist/draw takes "scale" 1.5 or 2 with a picture to paint from (a picture of an earlier run); artist_job.sized() draws each shape at that many times its size (multiples of 16) and keeps it at that many times its kept size, both painters (Krea 2 and Qwen-Image 2512; 2.1 edits by words and is refused, and so is a mask or the canvas); the picture is brought up by nearest ("ref_resample": ref_rs() into ref_latents), noised to the strength's sigma and painted from there as 1305's references are. The card asked for is the painter's own need and 6 GB more at ×2 (second_pass_mb(): 6000 · (s² − 1) / 3), whole or streamed. The page: Second pass… beside Upscale… (not on an upscale's picture nor on Qwen-Image 2.1's) opens a row of ×1.5 and ×2, each saying the size it makes, and how much it may change (0.5 first, kept); the draw it asks is the run's own painter, fine-tune, adapters, prompt, seed and shape, with the form's sampling when the form paints with that painter (his recipe: many steps, no Lightning), else the run's; Again of such a run paints it again at its size; its line says «second pass ×N». Measured on the test lab's GPU2 (3090): Krea 2 Q4 1280² → 2560² in 86 s, 14.5 GB at the peak (10.0 for the first); Qwen-Image 2512 fp8 (BASE fine-tune, Lightning and 12 steps as the fine-tune's default) 1920×1080 → 3840×2160 in 220 s, 22.9 GB, its blocks streamed (59 of 60 on the card). At strength 0.6 both kept the scene and moved its parts: Krea's brush grew finer, Qwen's surface smoother with Lightning's few steps; 0.5 is the row's first value for that. Not taken: the InjectLatentNoise's extra noise (the strength's own noise does that part). With it, the guide's own guard read: check_guide.py had said since the Artist's sections of 1330 that the root Viktor keeps out had slipped into the Ukrainian, Belarusian and Greek guides (робить, робота, зроблена…; δουλειά), and nobody read its last line: taken out in seventeen places. Kitchen suite 729/0 with suite-1384; the probe claude-1384-probe.mjs (the row in English and Russian, mocked runs). Patch 1384.

**Extra noise** (1385; Viktor 12.10.2026: «InjectLatentNoise можно именно в reference изображения на силу перерисовки. Ну... и куда ещё посчитаешь уместным»). His node is comfyui_essentials' InjectLatentNoise+ (MIT): samples + randn · strength, in ComfyUI's own latent space, which for Qwen-Image and Krea 2 (the Wan 2.1 VAE) is the VAE's raw space. Ours are normalized ((z − mean) / std) and packed (each VAE channel four times), so artist_job.jolt() adds inject · n / std[c] to a packed channel of VAE channel c: the number means what it means in his graph. Its noise has its own seed (the picture's + 1385); the clean latents stay for what a mask keeps (the blender), so only the start moves. POST /artist/draw takes "inject" 0 to 2 with a picture to paint from (a reference, the canvas, a second pass); the run keeps it, Again too. The page: Extra noise under the reference's How much it may change (0 first: nothing changes for anyone who does not move it; kept) and in the second pass's row (0.6 first, his value; kept); a run's line says «extra noise N». Tried on the test lab's GPU2 from the 1384 lighthouse (Krea 2 Q4): a second pass ×2 at 0.5 with 0 and with 0.6 kept the same composition, the 0.6 one with a more broken, livelier brush in the sky (102 and 78 s, 14.5 GB both); a reference at ×1 with 0.6 in 25 s. The guide says it in twelve languages. Kitchen suite 732/0 with suite-1385. Patch 1385.

**Qwen-Image 2.1 on a 16 GB card, and a card's limit as its ceiling** (1386; TODO: «For 16 GB cards a quantized DiT (GGUF)»). No GGUF of 2.1 is on the Forge (DIFFUSION_MODELS_etc/unet/QWEN holds 2511 and 2512), and none was fetched: the same weights stream instead. Its parts are a transformer of 14 GB and a Qwen3-VL text encoder of about 16 GB in bf16; enable_model_cpu_offload puts each whole on the card in turn (16.4 GB at the peak from words, 19.1 editing). artist_qwen.place21() keeps that where the room free holds the larger part and its work; else (the lab's ART_STREAM=1, or the room) the transformer streams block by block (diffusers' group offload over a CUDA stream) and the encoder leaf by leaf, the VAE on the card in tiles. STREAM_NEED qwen21 9.5 GB. Tried on the test lab's GPU2 under a VRAM limit of 15.5 GB: from words 1328² in 135 s at 4.1 GB at the peak (whole: 120 s, 16.4), an edit by words of the 1384 lighthouse (a snowy winter night) in 129 s at 7.9 GB (whole: 122 s, 19.1); the edit kept the scene, the snow where it should be. The try found a fault of 1294's limits: wait_card() told «no card here can take this» by the cards' whole size, so a run above a card's limit was told «no card can take this now» and waited for ever, and a painter that could stream never did; the largest card is now its size or its limit, whichever is less. Patch 1386.

**Regions** (1387; TODO, «The most of InvokeAI»: «regional prompts»). Up to three regions, each a box of the frame and words of its own. artist_job.regions_set() wraps the transformer's forward once (a pass-through until a picture sets its regions, so a kept painter never carries a run's regions into the next): a guided pass (its prompt's first tokens the run's own) is asked once more for each region with the main prompt and the region's words, and its answers blend by the regions' boxes as soft-edged token weights (mask_tokens, soft, an edge of a twenty-fifth of the shorter side), shared where boxes overlap, the rest the main prompt's: Latent Couple's way, not InvokeAI's attention masks, and it needs nothing from the model. The unguided pass of a guided painter goes through untouched. Krea 2 (its prompts padded to one length, so its position ids hold) and Qwen-Image 2512 (any length); Qwen-Image 2.1 is refused. POST /artist/draw takes "regions" (three at most, a box inside the frame and a twentieth of it at least), checked before the run's folder is made. The page: Regions under Sampling, folded: a row for each, a place (halves, thirds, quarters, the middle) with a small map of it, words, ✕; kept in this browser; a region without words is not sent; not for Qwen-Image 2.1 (said under the rows); Again sends the run's own; the time said grows by a pass a region; the run's line says how many. Tried on the test lab's GPU2 with «two animals sitting in a snowy forest clearing at dawn», a red fox on the left half and a white snowy owl on a stump on the right, seed 1387, 16:9: Krea 2 Q4 painted two vague cats alone (48 s) and the fox and the owl in one scene with the regions (137 s); Qwen-Image 2512 fp8 two bears alone (141 s), the fox and the owl with them (281 s). The guide has a stop of its own for them, in twelve languages. With it, a correction of 1381: its guide probe clicked the tabs and read the stops while the first tab's were still in view (13 × 5 = the «65 stops» it said); it now opens each tab itself, and all eleven translations hold the English one's 83 stops, each found by its id. Kitchen suite 736/0 with suite-1387. Patch 1387.

**The lyrics' timing in two passes** (1417; Viktor 13.10.2026: «stable-ts в июне отвергнут разработчиком. Лучше Whisper с Qwen-Omni допилить ещё малость»). stable-ts's forced alignment was tried first, his go given in the morning: alone it is not to be trusted on singing (on a take Whisper heard whole it pressed the first two lines into two seconds and pulled the fourth verse into the instrumental), and it is gone from the Studio's Python. What came of it is the rule it taught: a second opinion may only fill what the first could not hear. When the first pass heard less than 85 % of the lines, a second Whisper pass gets the lyrics as its hotwords (on the take's vocal stem when the Refiner made one, else on the take); timing.merge keeps every line the first pass heard, and times a guessed one from the second only when the second heard it, it lies between the first pass's heard neighbours (half a second of slack), lasts a quarter second a word at least and does not start before the line before it ends: the hint alone makes Whisper «hear» the words it was given (it heard 100 % on a take the first heard 81 % of). Measured on seven Dual CFG takes heard 75–81 %: five went to 100 % (the first lines of a verse, guessed from 0:00 to 14 s, placed at 10–20 s where they are sung), one to 94 %, one to 81 % with a collapsed fill (a line of no length, the next pressed onto it) refused. The second pass is a help, never a failure: if it fails, the first pass stands and the activity says so. Omni has no part in it yet: it cannot transcribe singing.

**Score mode in the Studio's own trainer** (1420; Viktor 13.10.2026: «Убирай AI-Toolkit внешний из Студии»; «Режим можно выбрать только с AI-Toolkit. Это твоя недоработка в коде?»). The first of three steps before AI-Toolkit leaves the Studio (score mode, the separation, then the removal). Ported from Ostris' MIT code line by line (yue2_model.py: _item_prefix_and_abc, _ar_inputs, get_noise_prediction): every track's score by the engine's own transcriber (yue-transcribe, SheetSage2 GGUF; Melody with --melody-only) before the model loads, cached as _ruach_cache/NNN_ruach.full.abc or .melody.abc; a track it cannot read keeps the reason as .fail, is named in the log and trains as Direct always. Each step: with probability abc_dropout (0.5, AI-Toolkit's) the track trains as a Direct prompt (the off instruction, no score), else the AR sees the cot's instruction and the score's ids before [ABC_END, MUSIC_START]: the score in the AR's targets (it learns to write it) and in the NAR's conditioning alike; the step log says which (score/sheet). The transcriber is AI-Toolkit's SheetSage2 ported to the engine, not its Python: the scores the trainer sees are the ones the Studio's own covers see. Smoke run on two Fosforida tracks (GPU1, 8 steps): the two scores in 45 s (4181 and 4065 characters), the score on 2 steps of 8, their ar_ce lower (4.56 against 4.94–5.68: the score's text is easier to foresee than the music's tokens), VRAM peak 19.1 GB on 5½-minute songs. The page: Mode open for the Ruach trainer, Go on keeps the run's mode, Separate still AI-Toolkit's; the lab refuses score mode in words when the transcriber is missing, before the run, not hours into it.

**The separation in the Studio's own trainer; AI-Toolkit out** (1422; Viktor 13.10.2026: «Убирай AI-Toolkit внешний из Студии»; «AI-Toolkit стоит отдельно ~/Documents/AI/AI_Toolkit»: his folder is his, untouched). Ported from Ostris' MIT code (yue2_model.py: encode_audio, _stem_ar_loss, get_noise_prediction): cache.stems splits every track into voice and instrumental with the Studio's own separator (BS-Roformer ep317 through audio-separator, the Refiner's stems; AI-Toolkit splits with MelBandRoformer), tokenizes each stem with the realaudio head, cut to the mix's length (_ruach_cache/NNN_ruach.stems.safetensors), and in score mode transcribes each stem's sheet (NNN_ruach.vocals.COT.abc, .music.COT.abc); the stems' audio is not kept. Each step, when the AR learns: the voice from the lyrics alone (the prompt ("", lyrics)) and the music from the tags alone ((style, "")), each from the song's start, each with its own score dropout; the lesson (ce + 0.5·ce_vocals + 1.0·ce_music) / 2.5, the KL the mean of the three, the NAR's flow on the mix only (AI-Toolkit's weights). Each stem's part goes backward on its own after the mix's: the same gradient as one sum, without three graphs on the card at once. Smoke run on two 5½-minute Fosforida songs, score mode and separation together (GPU1): 6 steps, 22 s a step, VRAM peak 19.1 GB (as the mix alone); the logged sum checked against the formula (step 1: 1.08 + 0.5·(4.961 + 0.5·4.733 + 4.376)/2.5 = 3.42). The separator is slow (about 5 minutes for a 5-minute song), once a set. Then AI-Toolkit left: the lab's job file (config_yaml), its paths and its launch are gone, a spec asking for it is refused in words; the Trainer's select has Ruach Studio alone, Mode and Separate open; Go on keeps a run's mode and separation; the tips and the guide's Trainer and Separate in twelve languages. The old runs AI-Toolkit made keep their cards (their loss split from the sum, 1090).

**His small things** (1421; Viktor 13.10.2026). The compare player: a version's play resolves when it has loaded, and the old callback paused the one it had been switched from, which by then could be the chosen one again: a click back to the first while the second was loading stopped both; now whatever resolves last, every version but the chosen one is paused, and the second a switch goes from is the last one known. The Style goes to the engine as one line («Музыкальный стиль скармливаем движку одной строкой»): a comma between lines unless the line already ends in one. The find bar («кнопка X съезжает»): the bar as wide as its rows may be, the find field the one that gives way. Max length («Когда ввёл 9 и Таб, всё равно на 0:10»): a bare number up to 15 is minutes, above 15 seconds, m:ss as written, empty the engine's default (8:00), shown at once in m:ss. The guidances in tenths («CFG у Творца сделай с десятичными»). A take's card («К хуям убери mp3, огранить, скачать и удалить кнопки с лица карточки… перенести в хвост первой ИДЁТ/ИГРАЕТ и VAE»): of the hover tools only the star is left (the four stay unseen in the markup, the checks' handle on the files' names; the take menu has Download, Refine, Move to the trash), the title's row ends with playing (or a run's state) and the decoder. **A LoRA's wave and the budget its layers share** (1447, Viktor 14.10.2026: «LoRA ересь и алхимия»; 15.10.2026: «И не забудь за динамичную волну, именно ту, что ты воплотил в слайдерах стилей»). The engine (lora-rt.h): an adapter with a wave or in a budget is no longer merged at load: y = W x + g·B(A x), A and B in F32 on the model's backend, g set before each step from its strength × its wave × its budget's share; the music half moves g at every token it writes, the sound half takes a row of gains, one a frame of the chunk. A budget: the strengths of a group add up to its cap at most (the measured red lines, music 2.25, sound 1.5), shared in proportion or served in the request's order, and what one adapter's wave lets go, the next one takes. An adapter's full deltas (realaudio's llm2vae and the like) stay merged at their flat strength (LoraSet::lora_skip); the decode graph is keyed by the set's build; YUE2_NAR_GRAPH_NODES makes room for the adapters' nodes. The lab (lora_alchemy.py, GET /lab/lora/profile): each adapter's ‖B·A‖ by layer and module, attention against MLP, how far it moves a layer at 1.0, the overlap of two and the cosine of their deltas; the budget's groups are its word. The page: a wave beside each row's strengths (the sliders' editor: Flat, Arch, Draw; one wave for a pair's two files), Budget Off, Share, In order (the rows dragged), the request's "curve", "group" and "lora_groups", brought back by a take, a prompt and the draft. Measured on GPU2 (BF16): merged and on the graph the same token for token over all 600 frames at 0.75 (greedy); the sound half's latents 0.54 % apart (41 % from none); the set loads in under a second where a merge takes 9.6 s. The six library adapters all reach the 28 layers (overlap 0.7–0.97) and their deltas stand nearly at right angles (cosine 0.00–0.05): stacked, they reach further than either, less than their sum. The slider arch's line in the log at every step silenced (Viktor: «К хуям убери этот лог арки»). Patches 1447.

**Steps of one's own in the Refiner** (1460, Viktor 15.10.2026: «написать всё как единый плагин, который мы не выложим в паблик, но он будет висеть у меня в пайплайне… И наверное на этом этапе и нужно начать прикручивать DAW от Plenio»; «И уходи к Огранщику. Ультракод включил»). The Studio's general hook, with no plugin in it: a plugin is a folder in user/plugins/ (or a link) with a plugin.json (its id, name, its own python if it wants one, its steps: a script inside its folder and fields of three kinds, select, number, check). The lab (lab/plugins.py, 12 checks in lab/test_plugins.py) lists what reads whole and names what does not, tells the page only names, words and fields, cleans what the page sends into each field's kind and bounds, runs a step as PYTHON SCRIPT AUDIO OUTDIR PARAMS.json on the CPU one at a time, and lands its files as a branch of kind "plugin" with its fields and measure (GET /plugins, POST /plugin/run). The page puts each plugin step after the Studio's own in the Refiner's row (a dashed edge), draws its panel from what it says (a source and its fields), asks the lab, says when it is in the tree; the tree heads the branch with the step's own name and fields, and its files play, compare (Compare all too), lie over the spectrum and serve as a source. docs/PLUGINS.md says the format. The kitchen's server now asks the Studio at 7777 (it still asked 41867, the port before 1431). Kitchen and live suites 820/0, check-i18n 18/0, check-player 3/0.

**The Refiner as the Engine and the Guide** (1461, Viktor 15.10.2026: «Если считаешь, что нужна переделка дизайна комнаты Огранщика, или несколько вкладок внутри, — одобряю»). Wider than 1100 px the room is a grid: its head, the import and the chain across the top; the steps as tabs in a column at the left, the Engine's look (1450), grouped in the chain's order (Debuzz › Upscale › Stems › Remaster): Hear and look (Spectrum, Artifacts, Lyrics), Mend (Debuzz, Upscale, Stems), Finish (Remaster, then a plugin's steps with a dashed edge); the open step at the right, as tall as it is (the column's extra height goes to the tree's row), and what is made from the take right under it. Narrower, one column as before. A plugin's panels stand before the tree, its fields in a row of their own widths. The guides in all twelve say the groups and point at docs/PLUGINS.md. The kitchen suite's new check had left the suite in the Refiner and eight Creator checks after it saw nothing; it goes back to the room it found. Kitchen and live suites 821/0.
