The head holds its button (flow-root), so the waves keep one x (1513's check had caught a float hanging into the row below). test_derived_trash.py, 11 checks.

**The guide's canvas** (1528; Viktor 17.10.2026: «Видел канвас, просто супер»). The Refiner's tab of the guide (F1) has a stop of its own before the DAW in all twelve languages, «The Canvas: Nodes and Wires»: the canvas and the list, a node's window and its keys, the right-click (Open, Run up to here, Bypass in the chain, Clone, Arrange), a wire setting a step's Source, clones, profiles, every choice in sight, and how the room opens set in Engine → Refiner Room; the tree's paragraph says a branch's Delete and the take's trash. Each language says it in its page's own words for the buttons, with the same lines and the same bold pairs as the English, so check_guide.py says of every translation exactly what it said before (Japanese numerals written as words for that).

**The DAW's console** (1531; Viktor 18.10.2026: «До утра доведи по максимуму DAW, пожалуйста. Преврати твой DAW начаток в профессиональный миксер как ты умеешь. У тебя есть на что смотреть»; 17.10: «Что там по DAW? Это пока что как бы mockup, мало пользы пока что от такого DAW»). Under the lanes a mixing desk (heresy-console.js): every lane a strip, its inserts (the EQ with its curve in small, the compressor with its reduction as it plays), the sends to the room and the delay after the pan, width and pan, polarity, mute and solo, the fader with its meter on the same scale (peak and RMS of both sides, the peak held, the loudest since cleared); the room and the delay as returns with their own level and mute; the master pinned at the right with its loudness by BS.1770 as it plays (momentary, short-term, integrated since play), a 4× true peak and the sides' correlation. A strip's devices: the input (trim, polarity, its version as chips), an EQ of up to eight RBJ bands drawn over the strip's own spectrum (a double-click adds a band, the point dragged, the wheel its width, a right-click away), the compressor (threshold, ratio, attack, release, knee, make-up, five starting points, its transfer curve and its reduction), the output; the room's three spaces, the delay's time in ms or as a note at a tempo, its feedback and low-pass; the master's spectrum. Knobs and faders: drag (Shift finer), wheel, arrows, a double-click back; Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z over the whole mix; A and B to compare two mixes as it plays; +stems prints every strip and return beside the mix. **What is heard is what is mixed.** The page's graph runs the render's order (lab/daw_mix.py, the value ruach.mix/1): the silence drawn, trim and polarity, the EQ (the browser's biquads take the render's RBJ coefficients; the cuts their Q in dB), the compressor, the fader, width by mid and side, the browser's stereo panner (its law written out in the render), mute and solo, the sends after the pan; the room convolves with the very impulse the render uses (GET /lab/daw/ir), the delay is Plenio's loop with its one-pole low-pass. The compressor and the meters are one kernel (heresy-mixdsp.js) run in an AudioWorklet built from that same function where the page is a secure context, and in a ScriptProcessor where it is not (the Studio opened by its network address): measured against Plenio on a signal pressed 10 dB, 3.8e-8 apart (float32), the integrated loudness and the true peak the same to 0.001. One difference, said in the guide: after a jump the compressor's memory starts afresh. The lab half: daw_mix.py (Plenio's EQ, compressor, room and delay; unknown fields refused before the job is queued), daw_job.py takes both values, test_daw_mix.py 29 checks (each stage against Plenio and the Web Audio law, the printed stems summing to the mix, daw_job end to end, the old value as before). A mix kept before 1531 keeps its one compression knob as a compressor of the same threshold and ratio. The guide's DAW stop in twelve languages; the console's words in eleven catalogs; the suite's section 1531 (both engines heard on a tone, the knobs, the fader, undo, A and B, the EQ and the compressor, Mix with its stems); 1471's check follows the new value.

**The song's sections on the DAW's ruler** (1532). Under the ruler's time, the sections as the player's wave has them (the lyrics' own tags placed by Whisper's word times, HERESY 1315; window.ruachWaveSections), a block each coloured by its kind (chorus amber, verse teal, bridge violet, intro and outro grey, instrumental blue) with its name, a thin line through every lane at each start; a click on a block goes to its start, a double-click loops it to the next, [ and ] the section before and after. The ruler grows to 36 px when there are sections.

**The DAW's mixes on Forge** (1533). Beside the set of stems they mix (derived/<set>/mixes.json, lab/daw_mixes.py): the working mix, sent 1.5 s after the hand stops and taken back on opening when it is newer than the browser's own (so the DAW opens as it was left on another machine or in another browser), and mixes kept by name in the console's third tab, Mixes: Save as, a click to call one back (Undo behind it), ✕ to delete one, asked. A file that cannot be read is said broken and set aside as it was before the next write, never taken for «nothing kept»; where Forge did not keep a mix, the tab says why. The mixes are asked after the lanes are painted, and a fetch that throws at once counts as a refusal (the older checks' mocks had answered every address starting /lab/daw/mix: now exactly /lab/daw/mix). test_daw_mixes.py 13 checks.

**The glow's ring off inside a node's window** (1534; Viktor 17.10.2026, his picture of Audio I/O: «вот та красноватая рамочка - это ненужная обводка. Данные и так хороши в общем канвасе оверлей окна. УБери её отовсюду в таких паттернах»). The look's glow (html[data-glow="on"]) rings every .card, .drawer, .panel and .meta-card; inside a node's window the step's panel kept it, 1508's rule being the weaker. Off there for every step, and off the DAW over the whole window. The Engine's cards keep theirs (asked).

**A lane's volume drawn over time** (1535). «A» on a lane takes its automation in hand: a click on the wave puts a point there and drags it (between its neighbours), a right-click takes one away, a double-click sets it to 0 dB, Undo over all of it; the line drawn over the wave on the fader's taper (its 0 dB where the fader's is), faint when not in hand. Heard after the fader as the gain's exponential ramps between the points, which is the render's curve: linear in dB (lab/daw_mix.py, ruach.mix/1's strip auto, [[t, dB], …]; the first point's level before them, the last's after). Measured on a tone: the line at −20 dB takes −12 dBFS to −32. test_daw_mix.py 32 checks. The guide's DAW stop says all four in twelve languages; a row of keys ([ ] Ctrl+Z Ctrl+Shift+Z).

**The master's monitor, and the night's mends** (1536). Mono and Dim under the master, for the ear only: after the meters, the loudness and the spectrum, never in the mix's value (the sides summed by four gains as a lane's width; −20 dB). The script processor's banks at 4096 frames (86 ms, every strip alike, the playhead takes it off): on the page's own thread a redraw of a few tens of milliseconds no longer breaks the sound when the Studio is opened by its network address. A lane's «A» lit only while its line is in hand (the lane's buttons were lit by s[key], and an empty list is true). The spectra behind the EQ and on the master on a floating scale, 72 dB under their own top falling slowly (the browser's analyser gives its bins some −90 to −120 dB for a voice at −14 dBFS). Two latent faults the night's checks brought up: the Mix watcher (since 1471) read the name of no take when the take changed while a mix was on Forge, now it stops; and HeresySpectrum asked app.js for the takes other than none (on heresy-derived with its panel open), now none is no take. The suite's section 1536 opens the console's own tab first (the console keeps its tab between sets).

**The compressor's key** (1537): a sidechain, the band ducked under the voice. A strip's compressor may listen to another strip as that one enters its own compressor (after its silence, trim and EQ); a muted key still keys. The page's kernel bank holds every strip's block, so its detector reads the key's (a silent key is silence, not the strip itself); the render's compress_keyed (lab/daw_mix.py) is Plenio's compressor with its detector fed by the key, Plenio's own sample for sample on its own strip, the page's kernel 1.5e-8 from it at 12 dB of reduction (MISC/claude-tc/dsp_key_check.py). In the compressor's device: «Listens to» (own, or another strip) and the starting point «Duck» (−28 dB, 2.5:1, 15/250 ms, keyed to the lead vocal). ruach.mix/1 comp.key; refused: a strip keyed by itself or by one not of the set. The catalogs' «Key» is the song's key (Тональность, Tonart), so the label is «Listens to». test_daw_mix.py 37 checks; suite 1537 hears the silent drums pressed by the voice's tone in both engines and not by themselves when own.

**No dropdown on a DAW lane, and the goniometer** (1538; Viktor 16.10.2026: «…избавляемся от этих голимых html'евских дропдаунов»). A stem's version on its lane is a button showing which (1/2, 2/2…): a click steps to the next, so two versions are compared as the song plays; a right-click opens the strip's devices, its versions there as chips; the select stays hidden under it, read and written as before (the 1471 check sets it). The master's devices draw a goniometer from the master's two sides (mid up, side across, a phosphor trail).

**The DAW's Stop** (1539; Viktor 18.10.2026: «Кнопка MIX запускает сведение, но нужна и кнопка STOP»). While a mix runs on Forge a **Stop** stands beside **Mix**: the lab's `POST /daw/mix/stop` takes a queued mix off at once, or ends the running one's process, takes its `.part` away and says it; no branch is made. The page's watch also ends when the mix is gone from Forge without a branch (a lab restarted under it), and says so.

**«Made from This Take» its own place** (1540; Viktor 18.10.2026: «Блок со всеми артефактами Made from This Take висит в хвосте каждой вкладки и докучает… куда вынести… чтобы он не надоедал глазу, но и был доступен всегда»). The tree is no longer under every step: it is an entry of its own at the end of the Refiner's sticky column of steps (under «This Take»), its mark the number of branches and a light while something is made; a click opens it where a step stands, lighting the branches of the step one came from. Not a step of the chain: the canvas, where it is a node of its own, and the steps' numbers stay as they were.

**Two-word buttons on one line** (1541; Viktor 18.10.2026: «Некоторые кнопки с двумя словами переносятся на две строки»). `.btn` keeps its words together (`white-space: nowrap`); measured in every room at 1920 and 2560 px in en, ru and de: no button wraps, none overflows.

**A cut's fades** (1542; on «фейды на краях вырезок»: «ТВОРИ»). A silenced stretch carries its own fall and rise: its top corners are handles that drag them (a double-click gives back 10 ms), its sides move it. The render's `cut_envelope` (lab/daw_mix.py) is Plenio's `mute_envelope` sample for sample at 10 ms; the page schedules the same raised cosines on the clock, picking a fall up mid-way where play starts, and draws the stretch as it sounds (dark as the gain is low, the gain's line). The value: `[start, end]` while both are 10 ms, else `[start, end, fall, rise]`.

**Groups as VCAs** (1543; on «группы/VCA (например, вся группа одним фейдером)»). `groups` in ruach.mix/1: a VCA holds no sound; its fader adds its dB to each member's own (theirs stay where they are), its M mutes them, its S solos them; a strip may be in more than one. In the console: «+ VCA» (the strip picked its first member), a VCA strip after the strips, its devices (name, members as chips, Delete). Heard and rendered alike; kept, undone and A/B'd with the rest.

**The master's chain, live as the render** (1544; on «лимитер и цепочка на мастере (живьём совпадающая с рендером)»). The master has EQ, compressor and Plenio's limiter before its fader, in the render (`master.eq`, `master.comp`, `master.limit`) and on the page. The limiter is Plenio's `limit` streamed in the page's kernel (resample_poly's Kaiser FIR 4× up and down, the demand's lookahead maximum and its mean, the release linear in dB): against Plenio 5·10⁻¹³ at 48 and 44.1 kHz (MISC/claude-tc/lim_vs_plenio.py), the whole master node (compressor, then limiter) within one float32 step of the render (master_vs_plenio.py). Its node is in the path only while its compressor or limiter is on (on the script processor's road, Viktor's, a node is another 85 ms), its delay counted in the playhead's. With a chain on, the printed strips are what enters the master, and the report says so.

**A take's mix stays its own** (1545; found by the 1543–1544 checks run after the earlier ones). On a change of take, or of set, the DAW kept the mix in hand under the NEW take's key before reading that take's own, so the previous take's mix became the new one's, in this browser and on Forge as its working mix (since 1531/1533). The mix in hand now knows whose it is (the key it was read for) and is kept only under that key, before the take or the set changes. Forge's two kept mixes were looked at: both as split, nothing carried.

**An input's floor after it settles** (1546; found measuring Viktor's new M-Audio M-Track Plus 18.10.2026). «Measure the input's floor» said −47.6 dBFS where the settled floor is −95: the M-Track's converter, after a change of rate, opens with a thump of −35 dBFS dying over 0.4–1.5 s, and the probe read its first two seconds. The probe now records 1.5 s more and reads what follows; the loop test lets the input settle as long before the tone goes out.

**The Digital Gateway** (1547; Viktor 17.10.2026: «Вот цифровой шлюз в паблик, и обогати его по максимуму. Аналоговый — это приватный Pro»). A step of its own in Finish, between the DAW and the Remaster: the take or any branch through an analog character in numbers (lab/digital_gate.py, numpy and scipy only): tape at 30, 15, 7.5 or 3.75 ips (record emphasis into a soft asymmetric curve and back, the head bump and the top by the speed, hiss, wow and flutter as a wandering read position, azimuth as an exact fractional delay), console (odd harmonics, the other side's highs leaking in), tube (even harmonics, a slow sag), transformer (the lows saturate first) or vinyl (the lows folded to mono zero-phase, the top rolled off, surface noise, crackle, rumble, wow). The curve runs 2, 4 or 8 times oversampled in blocks (exact to the whole-file way: a long song costs no more memory), the stateful parts at the file's own rate; width, a parallel mix, the level as it came (BS.1770) or as it comes out, a trim, the true peak held under −0.3 dBTP and said. Each branch says what its curve adds to a −12 dBFS tone (2nd and 3rd harmonic, THD). Eight starting points; clones on the canvas with settings of their own. test_digital_gate.py 22 checks (as loud as it came per character, wow measured as asked, tube even over odd and console odd over even, vinyl's lows in mono, crosstalk and azimuth as set, one seed one sound, the blocks' seams exact).

**The monitor** (1548; Viktor 18.10.2026: «допиши в Audio I/O возможность подключения второго устройства как Output/Monitor девайса… И не отключай нативный браузерный выход аудио»). Audio I/O keeps a second output on Forge beside the gateway (a tone through it, Stop). With one kept, each row of the tree has «On Forge»: the file plays through it from where its player stands, again to stop (POST /lab/audio/monitor/play, streamed from that second). The browser's own output is untouched.

**Progress above the player, in every room** (1549; Viktor 18.10.2026: «Порогресс бары повсюду прикрути… Сделай как в Художнике… снизу прямо над плеером отцентрованно, примерно 800px»). Whatever the lab runs has a bar each above the player, centred, at most 800 px: a training run and the listener by their steps, a job of the Refiner by its time against what it is expected to take (the take's length times the step's measured pace, or the job's own), counted in the lab from when it was first seen running, so neither the queue nor the page's clock bends it; a job that says nothing of its length striped, its time running. The Artist's own runs keep their bar in its room.

**Before and after at equal loudness** (1550; Viktor 18.10.2026, the mix against the analog gateway's: «нужно сравнить ДО и ПОСЛЕ»). The compare window shows each version's integrated loudness (GET /lab/loudness, Plenio's BS.1770, kept per file) and, with «Equal loudness» on (the default, remembered), turns the louder ones down to the quietest: a version a decibel louder sounds better by that alone.

**The chain as a pipeline** (1553; Viktor 18.10.2026: «различные эпизоды сразу в граф нод предусмотри. И сотвори несколько профилей пайплайна, как мы обсуждали и как ты видишь для Про и Паблик»). The chain's row has a Profile: the classic chain as it was, or a pipeline, a list of steps of any kind in their own order. POST /lab/chain with `pipeline` takes debuzz, upscale, stems (split, or `set`: a set the take has), daw (`mix`: a ruach.mix/1 value, or the DAW «as set now», neutral when it holds none), gate, remaster, plugin (a built-in step or a plugin's, on a file, on the set, or on one `stem` of it), inspect, spectrum and gloss; `until` is an index. Each step works on what the step before made: a file, or the set with the versions its steps made. The remaster on a set mixes those versions in place of the stems as split; a step on a set is told them (`_versions`) and each stem's way through the chain (`_history`). `lab/chain_plan.pipeline` checks a pipeline before it runs: a DAW or a step on a set with no stems before it, a step that is not here, one stem for a step that takes the set. The Studio ships seven (`lab/refiner_pipelines.json`): Quick polish, Song: stems and remaster, Song: my DAW mix, Song: full air, Warm tape, Spoken word and Look only; a plugin may bring its own (`pipelines` in its plugin.json), listed only while every step they name is here (GET /lab/refiner/profiles, `pipelines`). On the page a pipeline's steps are chips, one unchecked bypassed (kept per pipeline in the browser); on the canvas its way is drawn node to node, and Run up to here and Bypass in the chain work on it. A version of a version is a version: `lab/daw.py` follows a stem's branches through each other, and a branch's file may name its stem by `source`. On the sandbox lab, the 21-second waltz's eight stems went stems → Whole lead → DAW → Digital Gateway (tape, 30 ips) → Remaster → Spectrum in 20 s, the DAW mixing the whole lead and the backing less it. `lab/test_pipelines.py`: 40 checks.

**The Studio's own steps** (1553). Steps shipped with the lab (`lab/builtin_steps/ruach/plugin.json`) run as a plugin's do (a panel, a node, a branch in the tree, the GPU queue, the chain), but speak the page's language. A step says its `group` and the step it stands `after`; its `rate` (its pace, for the progress bars) is kept now, where plugins.py dropped it; a file a step makes may name the stem it is a version of (`source`, inside the take only), and a picture it makes is shown as one (`kind: image`). A user's plugin with a built-in step's id is left out, said.

**Whole lead** (1554; Viktor 15.10.2026 on «Крик», 2:08–2:22: «вокал в яме»). On a set of eight stems, where the backing stem is louder than the lead by 6 dB, louder than −40 dBFS and centred (its middle 9 dB over its sides), the stretch is the lead's: stretches under a second apart are joined, those under a second left, and the backing there is moved into the lead with 50 ms ramps. Lead and backing together are what they were, sample for sample; both come back as versions of their stems. Measured on «Крик»'s eight stems: six stretches, 21 s in all, among them 2:08–2:14 and 2:16–2:22; over 2:12–2:20 the lead went from −52.9 to −29.0 dBFS and the backing from −29.2 to −67.5; the sum differs from before by 1.2·10⁻⁷. On the waltz the split had lost the lead for most of the song (lead −81 to −113 dBFS while the backing held a centred voice at −20): 19 of its 21 s moved.

**Voice upscale** (1555; the Refiner's open order of 15.10.2026, «Vocal upscale per stem»). UniverSR (the Studio's own upscale_job.py, one variant, the original kept below the cutoff) on the voice stems only, the lead and backing or the lead alone, then back at the set's rate and length, so each is a version of its stem; the measure says each voice's level at 12–20 kHz before and after. Its first run on a card is still to come: on 18.10 both cards of the lab's jobs were training voices.

**Before and after** (1557; Viktor 18.10.2026 among the ideas he approved, «отчёт до/после на каждую ветку»; and after his first print through the lamp: «Нужны твои замеры и сравнение спектрограмм, в доказательство»). A studio's own step (`builtin_steps/ruach/report.py`) and a button on every file of the tree: the file against what it was made from (its branch's source; a set of stems, or a mix or remaster of one, goes back to the file the set was split from; the take when nothing else). Both measured the same way: integrated loudness, true peak and loudness range by Plenio's BS.1770, crest, width (side over mid), correlation, the share of four bands; the average spectra (Welch) in sixth-octave bands at equal loudness and their difference; the short-term loudness (3 s windows) through the song. A picture (three panels) and a page of numbers land in the tree; a step's picture is shown there now (`kind: image`). On «Крик» v4.2.0 against the tube of the Digital Gateway: the same −14.62 LUFS, true peak +0.30 → −4.61 dBTP, range 11.39 → 9.47 LU, crest 17.8 → 13.1 dB, lows below 40 Hz +1.2 dB and 89–178 Hz −1.2 dB at equal loudness, the quiet stretches 1–2 LU up: in 21 s.

**Match to a reference** (1558; among the ideas he approved: «reference match»). A studio's own step (`builtin_steps/ruach/match.py`) on Plenio's tone matching (`plenio_core/audio/eq.py`: each spectrum smoothed to a sixth of an octave with a silence gate, the difference weighted by how sure each band is, peak bands added one at a time where the most is left and refined together, each kept only if it helps and stays within the bound). The reference is a step's new kind of field, `file`: a file of this take's tree or another take (`take:NAME`), checked by the lab before the queue and given to the step as its path. Amount, the bound in dB and the number of bands are set; the bands are the DAW's own (peak, frequency, gain, Q), the file is the same EQ rendered, as loud as it came or as the reference, never over −1 dBTP; the branch's **Onto the DAW's master** puts them on the master's EQ of the set in hand, one step of the DAW's undo. On «Крик» v4.2.0 toward the SUNO take of «Крик» at 50 % and ±3 dB: six bands, 50 Hz +3.0, 356 Hz −2.6, 568 Hz +2.0, 732 Hz −1.4, 5.7 kHz −3.0, 9.8 kHz +2.7; the weighted difference 1.49 dB before, 0.81 dB after. `lab/test_builtin_steps.py`: 15 checks.

**Automation beyond the volume** (1559; Viktor 18.10.2026, the DAW to production: «автоматизация не только громкости»). A lane's «A» line draws its volume, pan, width, room send or delay send; the chip beside «A» says which (Vol, L–R, Wid, Rm, Dly), a click goes to the next. Points are put, dragged, taken away and given the knob's rest (0 dB, the centre, as it is, none) as the volume's were. A knob with a line plays it in place of its own value: the StereoPanner's pan, the width's four gains and the sends ramped straight between the points (a-rate params), a line taken away gives the knob its value back. In the render (`daw_mix.py`): `autos` {pan, width, reverb, delay}: [[t, value], …], the pan law per sample as the panner's, the width's mid and side per sample, a send per sample; each knob drawn takes its knob's place. `lab/test_daw_autos.py`: 10 checks.

**Inserts and Print** (1561; «свободные инсерты, Цифровой шлюз как инсерт»). A strip's Input has Insert: its version as it plays, through the Digital Gateway (its five characters) or a plugin's step on a file, on Forge; what comes back is the strip's new version (a version of a version, 1553), set at once and heard as it will be rendered; the versions keep the way back. The master's Print sends the mix the DAW holds (its value, its versions) through the gateway as a pipeline (the set as it is, the DAW, the gateway): a branch beside the DAW's own mixes. A pipeline's DAW may now name the versions it mixes.

**The chain on many takes** (1562; among the ideas he approved: «пакетный Огранщик по пространству»). POST /lab/chain/batch {names, …a chain}: the chain checked once, then run on each take one after another (one batch at a time); GET /lab/chain/batch says each take's state; POST /lab/chain/batch/stop lets the take in hand finish and skips the rest. On the page: «On the workspace…» beside Run the chain (the workspace in hand, or the whole library, asked first), the Librarian's «Refine N with the chain» on checked takes, the batch's line under the chain's row. On the sandbox lab two short takes went through Spectrum and Artifacts one after the other.

**Audio buses** (1563; Viktor 18.10.2026, the DAW to production: «аудиошины»). `buses` in ruach.mix/1 (at most eight): a bus sums its members' strips after their pan (their sends still leave from the strips) and runs the sum through a strip's own chain, EQ, Plenio's compressor (no key), fader, width and pan, into the master; muted, its members are not heard; a strip goes to one bus. In the browser each bus is a lane of the kernel after the strips (its compressor the same cells as a strip's, its meter after the master's), the members' strips wired into it; a change of members builds the sound anew and plays on from where it was, and undo takes it back. On the console a bus is a strip after the VCAs («+ Bus»): EQ and Comp, width and pan, M, fader and meter; its devices choose its members, its name, its EQ, compressor and output. Heard on the mock: a −12 dBFS tone through a bus at −6 dB reads −18 on the bus and the master, −12 on its lane before it; muted, the master hears nothing of it. `lab/test_daw_buses.py`: 10 checks.

**Moving and copying along a lane** (1564; Viktor 18.10.2026, the DAW to production: «правка регионов — перенос, вырезка, копия»). `edits` of a strip in ruach.mix/1 (at most 64): `{op: copy|move, a, b, to}`, the stretch a…b of the stem as it came laid at «to», what was there replaced with 10 ms raised-cosine crossfades at both edges, a move's source silenced as a cut of its own edges; laid after the strip's cuts, so a paste lies over them; one past the end is cut at the end. In the browser: Shift and a drag picks a stretch (a plain drag still silences), Ctrl+C copies, Ctrl+X takes it to move (once: the next Ctrl+V lays a copy), Ctrl+V lays it at the playhead on its own lane, Delete silences the stretch in hand, Esc lets it go, a right-click on a laid stretch takes it away, undo takes it all back. Heard as rendered: the lane's own sound silenced under each laid stretch and a move's source (the cut envelope), each laid stretch fetched from its source and played over through its own crossfade; drawn with the wave it brings. `lab/test_daw_edits.py`: 9 checks.

**A release with nothing of a private plugin, and every picture read** (1565; Viktor 18.10.2026, before 2.0.0: «Пропиши сторожей»). `heresy/tools/check-no-pro.sh`, called by make-release after the private lock, stops a release on what a word cannot catch: a built-in step other than ruach in `lab/builtin_steps/`, a pipeline calling a plugin other than ruach, anything in `user/` or in a `plugins/` folder (a user's own plugin lives linked in `user/plugins/`), and a picture not read. The private lock reads text, never pictures, and on 16.10 the guide's shots carried a voice run's and the readers' names since rc1. `heresy/tools/read-pictures.sh` reads each picture with tesseract (English, Russian, Ukrainian, at twice its size) for the private terms and for the words lawful in text but never on a screenshot (`heresy/MISC/picture-terms.txt`: the readers' names, the author's, the machine's address); a clean one goes into `heresy/MISC/pictures-read.txt` by its sha256, and a release lets out only those bytes; a picture that could not be read is not a clean one (its empty text would pass every word). Forge has no tesseract: there the release stops and lists the pictures to read where it is. Its first pass over the release's 70 pictures found the author's name on the Librarian's shot and on its tile of the visiting card. The C2PA test named a private plugin's step as a sample label, which the private lock would have stopped; it names a neutral step now. And the 2.0.0 shots: ten scenes, by day and by night at 1920×1080, from the live library and read only (`heresy/MISC/creator/tools/claude-2000-shots.mjs`): every write held in the page, the lab's running jobs, a private plugin's steps, pipelines, branches and versions, a private voice's workspace and its takes and a private painter's adapters and runs kept out of every list; the readers' voices named `voice-reader-N` in the data and again in each frame; the takes of «Крик» one shared cover for the pictures (Qwen-Image 2512, JibMix, seed 1919). The guide in its twelve languages shows the canvas and the DAW at their sections' heads, the README's rooms table both, the visiting card's tiles the new shots.

**The install's own checks without the sliders** (1566; found cutting 2.0.0-pre). The sliders went in 1449 and fetch-heresy and start.sh dropped them, but three of the install's checks still asked: `tools/test-real.sh` stopped at once («sliders/ is not converted») and gave its server `--sliders`, `tools/verify-install.sh` counted a missing catalog as a failure, `convert-models.sh` printed it in red. Now none asks; the old copies in `heresy/MISC/claude-tc/pre/before-1566/`. Past that stop the real-server test meets what it predates (the sliders' chips it counts, Generate with no Librarian behind a dead lab port, which since 1473 sends nothing): INSTALL.md and the agents' install guide say it is out of date in the pre and renewed for 2.0.0; the page suite's expected count there is 987.

**2.0.0-pre cut, tagged v2.0.0-rc9** (18.10.2026, Viktor: «Разрешаю срез RC9 и пуш по всем репо»; the tag his choice that evening, so a studio on an rc offers it in Engine → Updates; «-pre» alone it would never see, and semver puts it below rc8): live checks 987/0, 19/0, 3/0; the release tree passed make-release's three locks (the machine's shapes, the private names, 1565's steps, user/ and every picture read) and a look of my own; cutting it found 1566, then the tree built again and from a clean clone the engine built in 142 s, the page 987/0, the player 3/0, Pinokio 74/0, the places 26/0. Ruach_Studio.Release e2c9658, tag v2.0.0-rc9, the pre-release «Ruach Studio 2.0.0-pre» https://github.com/igrbible/Ruach_Studio/releases/tag/v2.0.0-rc9 with its tarball (SHA-256 c39d1c8c…), the visiting card on 2.0.0-pre in twelve languages with the new shots.

**The install's own test alive again, an older version's weights named, the card by night** (1567; Viktor 19.10.2026: «готовь 2.0.0», «На сайте визитке ночные темы не прикручены»). `tools/test-real.sh` and `tools/cdp-real.mjs` predated two changes: the sliders' chips (1449: counted 16, clicked Metal, read it on the song page) and a Librarian behind Generate (1473: a new take lands in a workspace, and with the lab's port dead the page sends nothing). The checks of the sliders are gone (one says there are none), and the test's lab port now answers 404 to everything: a studio with no Librarian, where the page lets a take land in no workspace, as it does for a studio without one. Run on Forge from its own tree: 6 passed, 0 failed (its page check 13 of 13), 53 s, Q5_K_M on the CPU. The install guides say so again. `launcher/update.sh` ends by naming the weights an older version left that nothing reads now (SDXL since 1405, Krea 2 since 1428, the sliders since 1449) with their size and the line that frees them; it removes nothing. The visiting card's room tiles carry their night shots as the Trainer's did (1505): by night the Creator, the Writer, the Refiner, the Artist and the Librarian show the night theme too; the Creator's tile no longer names the sliders, in all twelve languages.

**No monitor on the gateway's own card** (1568; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Monitor Out листит активный девайс в Шлюзе. Разве возможно без глюков на тот же девайс посылать монитор?»). It is not: an ALSA card opens once, and a monitor on the card the gateway plays out of or records from would take it from the gateway, or be refused. Audio I/O now offers the monitor every output but those on the gateway's card, as the gateway's selects stand (move the gateway, and the monitor's choices follow); a monitor kept there before is said in red and offered none. The lab refuses it too (`audio_io.set_monitor`; `lab/test_audio_io.py` +2). The 1548 check had written the bug down («every output as the monitor»): it expects the other card now.

**The canvas laid out as the work flows, on a grid; the chain's row and the jobs' strip fold** (1569; Viktor 19.10.2026, with two pictures of the canvas: «Канвас с нодами внахлёст. Arrage их тулит одну к одной, тогда как есть место на холсте», «Для нод на канвасе прикрути snapping к решётке канваса, - 10 pt шаг решётки. Настроечные/входные ноды влево вниз на канвасе. Типы нод перепроверь по раскраске», and of the list: «Добавь возможность схлопывания блока цепочки»). **Arrange** (`cvLayout`) puts the nodes in six columns, the steps' order left to right: the take and the chain; Debuzz and Upscale; Stems and the steps that mend; the DAW and the steps that work on stems or on one stem; the steps that finish the file; the looks at it. A row is as tall as the tallest node and a gap, measured once the nodes are laid and laid again when that moved, so none stands over another, and the columns take the canvas's whole width; Import a Track and Audio I/O, what feeds the way, stand at the left's bottom; a canvas narrower than six columns takes them in two bands of three and grows as tall as they need. Every place is on a 10 px grid, a drag's too, and the canvas's dots are drawn at that step. The colours checked against the groups: the take amber, Mend gold, Finish green, Look blue, the import grey, and Audio I/O, whose group «setup» had no colour of its own (a bare line), grey as the import is; a plugin's step that names no group stands with Finish, and its `group` in plugin.json (now in PLUGINS.md) puts it in its own column and colour. In the list, ▾ beside «Chain» folds the chain's row to one line naming its steps (`yue2.chainFold`), and the jobs' strip folds to its first job and «and N more» (`yue2.jobStripFold`).

**The chain's wires, a way of one's own** (1570; Viktor 19.10.2026: «В wiring не возможно разорвать цепь для построения собственного воркфлоу», and «Две ноды источника: Take и Upload - их тоже нужно разводить проводами»). The wires of the chain are its way, and now the hand's. A click on one (a wide unseen path over it) cuts the way there, the steps after it off. A wire dragged from a node's dot onto another puts that step right after it (from the take's dot, first; a step already on the way moves with its own settings), and the node takes the first one's newest file as its source as before (1510); every step can be wired to now, not only those with a Source to choose. *Off the way* takes one step out and joins the steps around it. The way so edited, from the classic chain or a pipeline, is «My way» in the chain's Profile: kept in the browser (`yue2.chainPipeOwn`) and in a profile saved by name (1515), which sets it again. Ctrl+Z on the canvas (no window open, no field in hand) gives back the way before the last cut, wire or step taken off. A way has two sources, the take or Import a Track; one wired from the import runs by itself on each track imported next, once the track is in hand (the page's `heresy-imported` event).

**The way tested as it flows, and a target** (1571; Viktor 19.10.2026: «К канвасу добавь ещё визуальные тесты цепочки. Идея - правый клик на ноде, команда "тест цепочки". Визуальная прорисовка потока. Такого в Комфи нет. А у нас будет. ЛОЛ Также пометка "таргетной ноды"»). *Test the way up to here* walks the way to the node step by step, drawn as it flows along the wires, and checks each step against what comes to it: a set of stems for the DAW and a step that takes stems, the very stem a step mends in the set it gets (four, six, eight or vocals: `lead_vocal` is only in eight), the gateway's interfaces in Audio I/O for a step through gear. The steps that hold turn green; the first that does not turns red with its reason («it takes the stem lead_vocal: put Stems before it»), and the test stops there. Nothing runs. *Make it the target* puts ◎ on a node: Run the chain then runs up to it and no further, and a test goes to it; *No target* takes it off. The target is kept in the browser and in a saved profile.

**A plugin's step names its stem and its gear** (1572; the same day's audit, Viktor 19.10.2026: «Гоняй DAW, шлюзы и всё остальное в Огранщике. Нужно вычленить все скрытые баги и непоследовательности»). The test of 1571 had nothing to read a step's needs from. Two fields of a step in plugin.json (`lab/plugins.py`, PLUGINS.md): `stem`, the one stem of a set it mends (an id, cleaned like the others), and `hardware`, a step that plays through gear outside the machine in real time. Such a step waits on the gear, not on the CPU, and held the CPU's turn of the lab's other jobs for the minutes of its pass; it does not now (`lab.py`), so it queues its own passes. Both are said to the page with the step. `lab/test_plugins.py`: 24 checks.

**A node's window as large as what it holds; the room's head without a row of profiles** (1573; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Пройдись через все попап она нод и постарайся выстроить css так, чтобы каждый оверлей был адекватного размера, а не всё фиксировано по размерам. В одно ноде 80% пустоты в оверлее, а в другой нормальная плотность по элементам», and «строка с профилями имеет экстра паддинг свержу. Съедает кучу вертикального места. Её вообще можно убрать и двумя svg иконками вынести в строку с Canvas/List External DAW кнопками»). A node's window was a box of the room's size whatever it held; now it is a column of up to 1100 px for a step's settings and the window's width for what is wide (the take's tree of waves, the spectrum, the gloss, the DAW, the Remaster, Audio I/O), as tall as its panel up to the room's height, centred, and centred again as the panel grows or folds. The row of profiles above the canvas is gone: in the room's head, beside Canvas/List and External DAW, a sliders icon opens the profiles (each by name, **Save as…**, **Keep the setup as it is now under ›**, **Delete ›**) and a grid icon is Arrange. The 48 px left above the canvas were the head's row gap, none in canvas mode now. The guide's canvas section tells 1569–1573 in every language.

**An answer that does not read is said, not shown as nothing** (1576; Viktor 19.10.2026, a picture: «в Made from this Take вообще всё исчезло, только оригинальный семпл»). One branch's manifest held `Infinity` in its measure (a file held against itself: no noise, no number); Python writes it, `/lab/derived` passed it on, the page's JSON.parse refused the whole reply, and «Made from this Take» said «Nothing made from this take yet» — an empty that lied. The lab now reads NaN and Infinity in a manifest as null (`derived_list`, `parse_constant`), and the page says the answer could not be read when it could not (a branch's manifest.json at fault), never «nothing».

**The Takes column's own «From all Workspaces»** (1577; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Для Творца в Takes нужно допилить собственный фильтр по пространствам, чтобы листить и фильтровать все постпроцессинги из любого… `From all Workspaces` в спадающем меню схлопывающейся колонки Takes»). In the column's ⋯: every workspace's takes in the column, the workspace in hand left as it is (new takes still land in it); with Refined, every refined take of the library; the menu's dot lit while it is on (`yue2.libFilters.allWs`).

**The compare window's rows on one line again** (1579; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Попап сравнения поплыл в болото по дизайну»). 1550 put each version's loudness in the row, a fifth cell in a grid of four, and the length fell to a second line under every name; the grid has five columns now (four when narrow, the group hidden).

**The canvas's wires say one thing each** (1580; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Я не могу пока что прикрутить провод из апскейлера вокала… Провода пунктиром - это подсказка по рауингу а цельный жирный - реальный поток в воркфлоу?»). The way the chain runs thick in the accent; what was made from what thin and quiet; a step's own Source dotted, and only for a step off the way; the roads a wire may take drawn only while one is dragged, the nodes that can take it lit and the others faded; a legend in the canvas's corner, folding. A wire from a step not on the way puts it there where its kind stands (a step on stems after Stems, Stems put in when missing), then the other after it; a wire into the DAW also sets its lanes to that step's newest files.

**The Refiner is its canvas** (1581; Viktor 19.10.2026: «полностью отказаться от варианта List, но из него в канвас забрать самое лучшее. Автонумерацию нод в их логическом потоке воркфлоу, всплывающие тултипы с подсказками по нодам, Нода `Made from this Take` - вправо вниз»; «нода 4 по клавише 4… До 10 уложимся?»). No List / Canvas button and no Engine choice of how the room opens (the Engine's card says what the room is); the panels the nodes open stay where they lived. The nodes are numbered as the work flows: the way's steps 1…N in its order, the rest after them column by column, Audio I/O none; the digits 1…9 and 0 open the node of that number, from the canvas or from another node's window; every node says what it does under the pointer; «Made from This Take» a node of its own at the bottom right, its window the tree; the take's node opens the Takes, to pick another.

**Slots of a class each** (1582; Viktor 19.10.2026: «маркировать инпуты и аутпуты, чтобы всё визуально не херачилось на одну точку… по классам инпутов/аутпутов»; «идеология и код Комфи… наш эталонный донор»). A node's inputs are named on its left and its outputs on its right, as ComfyUI's slots, of three classes: a file (amber), a set of stems (teal), one stem (violet). The DAW takes stems and versions and gives a mix; the Remaster takes a file, stems or versions; a step on one stem takes it out of a set. A wire leaves the slot of its class, lands on the slot that takes it, and wears its colour; while one is dragged only the nodes with a slot that takes it light up, and a drop on any other is said, not wired.

**The Voice upscale's bundle** (1583; Viktor 19.10.2026, after listening to the A/B on Krik's lead: «тройка в среднем и громчайший чистят отдельно в своём ракурсе… одиночно каждый апскейлер что-то улучшает, а что-то режет на вокале… связка даёт баланс. Пропиши несколько профилей для этих связок, по стилю суно ремастера с разными силами и причудами»). Measured first on a minute of Krik's lead, cut at 12 kHz and held against what was there (log-spectral distance): UniverSR 11.7 dB (4 dB short), FlashSR 11.6 (6 dB too bright), Apollo-vocal 13.9 (its shape the closest, 11.5 dB short), the three averaged as UVR averages separators 9.5 (1.8 dB short): the closest. The Voice upscale's Upscaler now offers the bundle: each of UniverSR, Apollo-vocal (baicai1145, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and FlashSR (Jaekwon Im) draws the voices' top, each is joined to the original below the cut, and above it they are averaged, the loudest taken in each cell, or air (averaged to 16 kHz, the loudest above); the drawn band is lifted or lowered (+2, 0, −2, −4 dB). UniverSR alone stays the default. Five pipelines: Voices: subtle, normal, high, air, bright. Apollo-vocal and its model code come with the Studio's models (goldhub/Ruach_Studio_Models_v2 at `models/upbundle/apollo/`, as their licences let them be shared); FlashSR comes from its author on first use, at a pinned revision, and is never shared by the Studio: its author states no licence yet (asked on 19.10.2026). `lab/test_vupscale_bundle.py`: 8 checks.

**The Creator's piano roll** (1578, 1584; Viktor 19.10.2026: «визуальный редактор партитуры в творце… не забывай, что в партитуре YuE2 два стана - Vocal и Ins»; «реальный горизонтальный 7-8 октавный фортепиано ролл и идти по нему сверху вниз как по настоящей партитуре… бумажная партитура… оригинальная, справа - исправленная»; «синтезатор… Дефолт - инструментал… распевки»; «MIDI device»; «SHIFT для набора мышью полных аккордов… белые на A-', чёрные на Q-]… профили 25, 37, 61, 88»; «клавиши живыми… клаву роланд или корг»; «88 клавиш… мелко… центральные октавы»). A staff with an octave on it beside the score opens it over the whole window: above, the score on paper twice (as YuE2 wrote it, and as it stands now, drawn again as one edits); below, the lane where time flows down to two weighted keyboards, Vocal's over Ins's, the keys one size on every screen, the octaves beyond at the edges (a small keyboard of them on hover, a click brings them in). The staff in hand bright, the other faint behind it; the lyrics' syllables on Vocal's notes, a syllable a note within each section, as Recite lays them. A click writes a note of the grid's length, a drag moves it, its lower edge stretches it; a voice of YuE2 sings one note at a time, so a note laid over another makes it give way. Shift and keys pressed together (the mouse, the computer's keys, a MIDI keyboard) make a chord set on the cursor's bar, named among the fifteen qualities the score's dialect reads; the computer's keys play a keyboard and a half (white on A…', black on W…], Z and X an octave), their letters on the keys; Web MIDI listens to any keyboard plugged in; Rec writes the key played at the cursor and steps on; 25, 37, 61 and 88 mark one's controller's reach. Space plays from the cursor, the original or the edited, Ins as keys (the default), Vocal sung on the notes' own names (a formant voice: Do, Re, Mi…), or both, the keys going down as they sound. «Write into the score» goes through `HeresyAbc.rewrite`: only the lines whose notes or chords changed are written anew, every other line byte for byte as YuE2 wrote it (the library's 174 scores read back to themselves, 870 edits read back exactly).

**The roll by day and by night, its keys with depth** (1585; Viktor 19.10.2026: «страницы партитуры в чёткой ночной инверсии. В дневном режиме лист партитуры сделай немного сероватым, чтобы белое не било в глаза»; «Подлиннее инструментальные клавиши… А вокальные пусть остаются как верхние на клавесине. 3D клавиши слабо?»; «Нижний блок поясняющий очень высокий… слева на бекграунд миди ролла наложить… При подключении Миди устройства скрывать этот хелпер, с чекбоксом»). The papers take the page's ground: by night dark with light ink, by day a sheet a little grey; abcjs draws in `currentColor`, so the paper's colour is its ink, and the roll turns with the page's theme while open. Ins's keyboard is 120 px deep and Vocal's 64, a harpsichord's upper manual over the lower; each white key has its top (in the felt's shade at the back) and its front lip, each black key is a raised block with a sloped front and a soft shadow on the white, and a key down sinks (a shorter lip, its neighbours' sides in sight) in its staff's colour. The keys' guide lies faint over the lane's low octaves, which are mostly empty, its box the one thing in it that takes a click (kept in `yue2.rollGuide`), folded when MIDI listens; under the roll one line. MIDI is the browser's only on a secure page, so a studio opened by its address from another computer says so and how to open it as localhost (`ssh -L`); keyboards plugged in while the roll is open are met; a controller's own control port (an Oxygen's DAW port: `MIDIIN2`, `MIDI 2`; Mackie, HUI) and its pads (channel 10) are not taken for keys.

**The roll's voices real** (1586; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Синтезатор звучит как на дешёвой ATARI видео пристаки. Бьюсь об заклад, ты сдешманил 8 битным синтезом»). He won the bet: the roll played a triangle and a sine for Ins and a sawtooth through three formants for Vocal. Now Ins plays the Salamander Grand Piano (Alexander Holm) and Vocal the choir «aah» and the voice «ooh» of FluidR3 GM (Frank Wen), both CC BY 3.0: a note every three semitones, played at its neighbours' pitches, mono MP3 at 80 kbps, 1.9 MB in `lab/sounds/`, served at `/sounds/NAME.mp3` as the fonts are (lab 62b064b). Vocal still sings the notes' names: «o» and «u» on the «ooh», the rest on the «aah» with the vowel's formants lifted, the consonant a breath of noise as before; a long note holds on the voice's middle. The built voices stay only for when the samples do not load, and the roll says so; Play waits for them.

**The papers follow the roll** (1587; Viktor 19.10.2026: «В пиано ролле нужна синхронизация бумажной партитуры с самим midi роллом и её параллелью - с листом правки/редактуры. Play не прокручивает ролл и партитуру. Перепроверь все синхронизации»). abcjs draws each group of the score's lines as one system and classes its marks by line, voice and measure (`add_classes`); its own measure count runs on the first voice and takes `Z4` for one bar, so the roll maps a bar by `HeresyAbc.groups` (the group and its first bar) and by the measure inside its voice's line, where a run of empty bars is one. Both papers follow the playhead, else a picked note, else the bar the lane was scrolled to, else the cursor, system by system, and the bar in hand is lit on both; a paper scrolled by hand takes the other paper and the lane to its first system in sight; a click on a paper's note puts the cursor on its bar with that staff in hand. Play did not scroll because it began at a cursor out of sight and followed only a playhead below the lane's three quarters: now a cursor out of sight starts Play at the lane's first whole bar, and the lane follows the playhead both ways.

**The jobs' strip clears the controls** (1588; Viktor 19.10.2026, with his picture of the strip over Probes and Variations: «Прогресс бар закрывает кнопки синтеза в Творце. Давай при наведении указателя мыши в область этих кнопок и движков временно растворять этот оверлей прогресса. Кнопку пиано ролла уведи вправо»). The strip never took a click but its fold button, so what lay under it worked, unseen; a control under the pointer there (a button, a slider, a box, a chip) now dissolves the strip to 6 % until the pointer leaves it. The piano roll's button stands at its row's end.

**The Studio's MIDI, and a MIDI API** (1589; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Хорошо, беру M-Audio Oxygen 61 MKV»; «официально с 2.0.0 релизом выкатим early-release поддержку M-Audio миди контроллеров. И предусмотреть интерфейс для 3rd party плагинов для MIDI. Откроем "MIDI API", люди начнут писать свои плагины»; on the two repositories he found for it, reaKontrol and flmidi-kompletekontrol). Those two speak NI's own NIHIA to Native Instruments' Komplete Kontrol keyboards through NI's service, which exists for Windows and macOS only; the Oxygen MKV's DAW port speaks Mackie Control (or HUI) in its presets, an open protocol every DAW reads. So the Studio speaks Mackie Control itself. `heresy-midi.js` holds the page's one MIDI: a keyboard's keys go to whoever listens (the piano roll, at once when MIDI is on), a control port goes to a script that turns its buttons, faders and knobs into actions by name (play, stop, record, rewind, forward, loop, the tracks, the banks, the strips', the octave), and the room that offered an action last answers it (the roll over the DAW in sight over the player); a handler that says false hands the button on. Built in: Mackie Control on a port named Mackie or MCU and on an Oxygen's second port (Play and Record lights sent back as the roll plays and records); another maker's DAW port is left alone until a plugin's script claims it. A plugin's MIDI scripts (plugin.json `"midi"`, a plugin may be made of them alone; lab d5cb778) run each in a worker of its own with no page and no network: ruach.midi/1 is `onMidi(bytes, port)`, `studio.act`, `studio.say`, `studio.send` (PLUGINS.md, «MIDI scripts»). Engine → Hardware → MIDI turns listening on and off (kept), lists every port with what it is taken for, and says why there is no MIDI on a page that is neither localhost nor https. Early support: written to the protocol and tried through the browser with made-up ports; the Oxygen itself comes later.

**The roll's ends, its lever, its tempo and its wheels** (1590; Viktor 19.10.2026: «По широкой клаве тултип с остатком клавиш не очень хорошо. Нужно слева/справа добавить кнопки-стрелки для сдвига стана, и кнопку возврата в центр»; «монитор 2K в портретном… Нам нужен рычаг сдвига между партитурами и пиано роллом… запоминание положения. И в таком расположении монитора клавиши инструментала можно в полноформатном рояльном соотношении»; «Строку состояния тоже перенеси… под шпаргалку клавиш»; «В баре кнопку Play/Stop сделай плеерной svg иконкой. Скорость воспроизведения высокая… Не вижу переключателя скорости»; «Во фрейме партитуры нужна как в чатах стрелка вверх»; «для MIDI контроллеров переопределить колесо pitch-shift'а. В миди мы рисуем ноты, а не эффекты»). Arrows over the keyboards' ends with the count of the notes waiting beyond, and ◎ the keys back on the score's notes (the edges' small keyboard gone). A lever between the papers and the roll, kept in `yue2.rollSplit`, a double click as at first. Ins's keys as long as the room lets them: a third of the stage, 120 px at least, a grand's own six widths (240 px) on a tall screen. The line of state under the keys' guide. Play and Stop as the player's icons; the tempo beside them, − and + by four, the wheel by one, a double click the score's own: a free-tempo score has no Q:, so the roll had played it at the nominal 120, which is what sounded fast; such a score now takes the last tempo set for one (`yue2.rollFreeBpm`, 80 at first). ↑ at a paper's corner once it is scrolled. A MIDI keyboard's pitch wheel runs the cursor through time (up on, down back, the further the faster, the grid at rest), its modulation wheel sets a new note's length.

**The roll's Vocal sings in phrases** (1592; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Рояль хорошо звучит, но вот вокал… може что-то подшаманишь в этом плане?»). The notes that touch are one breath on one sample (a leap of more than nine semitones starts another): the pitch glides into each note, a vibrato grows on the long ones, the vowel's formants flow from syllable to syllable, a breath before the phrase, a small hall around it (a convolution of falling noise, a fifth wet). It sings the lyrics' syllables (their vowel and first consonant, Cyrillic or Latin) or the notes' names, kept in `yue2.rollSing`.

**Icons for the common acts** (1593; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Перерисуй все кнопки `Cancel ...` svg иконкой 🗙. Применить - ✔️, и т.п. по стандартной системе иконографии функций кнопок, - там, где до сих пор текстовые надписи»). `heresy-iconbtn.js` looks at every button that appears: one whose whole text is Cancel, Close, Send nothing or Dismiss shows ✕; OK, Apply, Done, Confirm, Make it or Write into the score ✓; Save a diskette; Delete or Remove a bin; Clear an eraser; Reset a turn back (Lucide, ISC). Its word stays inside, unseen, so a screen reader still says it, the catalogs still translate it and the checks still read it; it is the button's tip when it has none of its own. A button a script fills with other words is words again.

**Transpose a segment** (1594; Viktor 19.10.2026: «раз уж ты предложил транспозицию… как в LoRA графах рисуем редактируемую прямую… двигаем по 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 1 ... 2 октавным шагам… с минорной/мажорной части в мажорную/минорную»; «кнопку "Транспозировать сегмент", поворачивать ролл горизонтально, по кривой рисовать сдвиг и возвращать обратно в вертикальное движение»; «По кривой транспоза принимаю твоё решение как зрелое и рабочее»). A drag along the bar numbers picks a segment's bars (a click there still sets the cursor; Shift from the cursor). ⇅ Transpose lays the segment across the stage: its notes above, faint as they are and bright as they will be; below, the shift as a line of points, moved by a semitone, a quarter, a third or a half of an octave, an octave or two; held from point to point or gliding (a note takes the shift at its start, in whole semitones: YuE2's score holds no microtones). To minor and To major turn a part in its own tonic (the third, the sixth and the seventh a semitone; I and IV minor or major, V kept; the lowered degrees' chords major), In the key moves a note pushed out of it to the nearest note in it, both staves or the one in hand. The pitch wheel and ↑ ↓ move the picked point; Apply is one step to undo.

**A voice adapter's road** (1595; Viktor 19.10.2026, after Chonishvili's r32 on his Есаул: «AR макс 0.5 (затем красное), NAR - макс 1.0, и затем красное. И по таким по именам адаптеров, где "voice" или "vocal", такое правило применять к лимитам»; «AR адаптера напрямую влияет на построение партитуры обеих Ins и Vocal… голосовые - чистая наррация, вот тебе и приглушение нотного ряда»). An adapter whose name says voice or vocal: the music half green to 0.4, amber to 0.5, red past it; the sound half green to 0.8, amber to 1.0, red past it. The guide says why (a voice taught on speech writes narration into the score through its music half; the timbre lives in the sound half). On his ear the same day: AR 0.4 with NAR 1.0 on the IRAE merge, «Музыка не перебивается. Голос стабилен». Its first build put a note mid-line in YueLoras' exports and made the rest of the line a comment: Open of a file with adapters failed on the live studio until the live checks caught it (74581d6).

**The Creator's form kept on every change** (1596; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Помнишь, мы замышляли для Творца прикрутить version control? Сейчас наверное тот самый случай из-за ABC редактирования. Испортил, применил, F5, и ... проебал основу»; «Каждый Ctrl+S или запуск генерации на изменённых текстах, параметрах, данных ABC сохраняет свою diff»). 1519 kept the words on each Generate only, so a score written from the roll and a reload left nothing of the one before. Now the form is kept, with its knobs (the request as Generate would send it, without the texts) and why, before each place that replaces it (an example, a score example or its removal, Make instrumental, a take or a recipe into the form, a plan's score, a cover's score, the Writer's brief, the assistant's apply, a version into the form, the roll), on Ctrl+S, after the roll writes into the score, and on Generate; the same words and knobs again are no new version (lab 6e337d1). A first build caught the boxes' value instead: it took away their own catches (the lyrics' counts and marks, Recite, the score's lights) and could not tell overwriting from typing; the kitchen suite caught it. The second step, a Version field beside the Title (numbers and dots), revisions inside it, a branch where an old one is edited, a tag as a star, the whole tree of a root title deleted as the Writer's drafts are, waits for his word on its shape.

**The dev repository and the models' mirror** (1597; Viktor 19.10.2026: «на Орфее под git@192.0.2.1/home/USER/ruach_studio_dev.git создавай bare repo и пушай туда всё наше как на внутренний upstream. Всё внутреннее и Pro… Модели не пушь. Их лучше на Големе миррорить»; 20.10.2026: «Используй один репо… лучше запушить всё в ruach_studio_dev.git как в полный наш dev репо»). `tools/backup-push.sh` pushes build, lab, heresy (the Pro plugin and the kitchens with it), kit, upstream and the public Release into one bare repository, every branch and tag under its prefix (remote «dev»); the old ruach_studio.git held nothing the dev repository lacks (its 11 branches compared commit for commit on 20.10) and is no longer pushed. `tools/mirror-models.sh` copies the weights and the data (models, loras, checkpoints, hf_cache, artwork, training, separation, whisper, writer, user) to the cold disk, never deleting there.

**The Refiner without a chain** (1598; Viktor 20.10.2026: «К хуям удаляй предопределённый `Chain`. Это - шлак без настроек. Никаких шорткатов… Реальный погружённый воркфлоу, который человек должен понимать, а не клацать на кнопки мыши. И в Гайде убери Chain авто воркфлоу»; «По режиму List… Мы договорились к хуям убрать Список»; «у нас больше, чем 10. Сделай микро задержку в 400-600ms для последовательного нажатия двух цифровых клавиш»). On the canvas the way is My way or a pipeline, never the classic chain: the room opening as its canvas turns a classic chain once set into the first My way, a studio that never ran it starts with the take alone. The chain's row is the way's bar in the room's head (the way in hand as a button with its list, New way, On the workspace…, Run the way), no Chain node; an empty way runs nothing and says so. The List button is gone for good (1581 hid it with the hidden attribute, which `.btn`'s display overrode, so it stayed in sight; the checks read the attribute). Two digits within half a second open a node past ten (1 then 2: the twelfth); a digit that starts no number past ten opens at once. The list stays in the checks' hands with the classic chain. Words: Run the way, Bypass on the way, Refine N along the way, ×11; the guide's Refiner ×12 without the chain. suite-1598.part; 1506, 1508, 1510, 1553, 1569, 1581 brought to it.

**Own plugins off for a public view** (1599; Viktor 20.10.2026: «Добавь также в настройки Огранщика, если есть в активе мои Pro плагины, отключение оных ради теста Паблик воркфлоу. Так сможем имитировать публичный код в Промо и на скринах… помести его в системный бар Студии в ниспадающее меню»). `heresy-pro.js`: a row in ☰, shown only when a plugin that is not the Studio's own lies in user/plugins/; off (kept per browser), the Refiner's steps and pipelines, the DAW's inserts and the MIDI scripts are read as a public studio would; the lab keeps them, nothing is deleted, the page reloads; a plugin's pipeline in hand gives way to My way. suite-1599.part.

**The roll opens the scores YuE2 writes** (1600; Viktor 20.10.2026: «Кнопка Transpose не ложит ролл горизонтально… Пробую Ctrl+R. Та же хрень»; «Лирика не поётся и на стане не выводится»; «Tempo взял в одну кнопку жирную, и оверлеем ниспадающим… выбор размера клавиатуры… тоже в единую кнопку с ниспадающим, и с толковыми подсказками. Доли bar'а оставляй как есть»). His Есаул did not open at all: its Ins wrote a bar of 18/16 (`A4z4E2G8`) and the strict read failed. `HeresyAbc.mend` evens such a bar for the roll (what runs over cut at the bar's end, a short bar filled with a rest, an odd length as tied supported ones), says so under the roll and in a toast, and a line the roll does not change goes back as YuE2 wrote it (written untouched: the score byte for byte). The lyrics stand under the Vocal staff of both papers (`HeresyAbc.withWords`, abcjs w: lines, the score keeps none), and an intro's few Vocal notes before the verse sing the verse's first syllables. Transpose with no bars picked takes the section at the cursor. The keyboard's size and the tempo are a button each with its list under it (88, 61, 37, 25 said; −4, −1, +1, +4, a slider, the score's own); the head one line at 100 % and 110 % on 1920. suite-1600.part.

**The paper's words in Noto Sans** (1601; Viktor 20.10.2026: «для титлов Vocal ...и Inst ... замени сраный таймс роман на нормальный Noto Sans с фейковой шириной 76%. И аккордные пометки с остальными - тот же Noto Sans, но дай ему фейковую ширину 90%. Количества для пустых bars - тот же шрифт, ширина 100%»). `HeresyAbc.dress` after every engraving (the Creator's staff, its print, the datasheet's, the roll's papers): Noto Sans, narrowed as LaTeX's FakeStretch does (scaled across about the point each word stands at), as attributes so a print window carries them; the print window takes the page's Noto Sans faces.

**Free tempo on one line** (1602; Viktor 20.10.2026: «Добавь в кнопку Free tempo неразрыв»): `white-space: nowrap`, in every language.

**The song licence row** (1603, README): M-A-P's individual creator permission of 16.09.2026 (MODEL_LICENSE): a musician or creator acting on their own may publish, sell and license the songs; a company needs the authors' licence.

**The engine at upstream's level** (1604; Viktor 20.10.2026: «Всё забирай и даже не жди утра! Мы паритетимся с апстримом yue2.cpp без вопросов… Если это даёт нам силу, забирае их коммиты без рассуждений»). yue2.cpp merged to 8af0174, 22 commits: continuation from a section of another song (`source_tokens`), upstream's adapters stacked on the backbone beside ours (the model store keys both, one load merges both), the audio tokenizer (Mothersuperior's realaudio v4 head, `/tokenize`, `--tokenizer`), MERT-v2-FullSong and the SheetSage2 head as separate GGUFs (the transcriber reads both), a stream with no score renders without one, every track's VAE latents in the reply (the page reads its first two parts), `--device`, ggml 0.27 with Pascal's snake and conv_1d kept. Ours kept whole: the LoRA wave and budgets, the sliders, decoders by name, the library, `decode_from`, fades, the medcard's timings. The sound is bit for bit the same (SNR 252.7 dB against the old engine's, the same tokens, the same length). ⚠ «27–30 s before, 12 s after», first written here, was not the engine: the new one had run on the idle GPU0 and the old one on GPU2 beside a training, as upstream's --device had dropped GGML_BACKEND (1613). On one card the two are as fast.

**Multistep is AB2** (1605; Viktor 20.10.2026: «И внедряй солвер AB2»). It was in already: our Multistep (1004) is Adams–Bashforth of the second order, one network call a step, the step before it reused. Now named so in the solver's list (*Multistep · AB2*), its tip and the guide, which say each solver's calls a step. On the take above: 9 s against Midpoint's 12, the same tokens, SNR 25.5 dB against Midpoint's sound.

**Chords for the planned score** (1606 engine, 1607 page; timoncool/yue2.cpp 1e21e63, MIT, after Yeufonic). The planner tends to loop one progression through a whole song. `src/harmony.h` whole: in the ABC stage, a chord heard among the recent changes loses logits by its share, a root held past `hold_limit` pays more, out-of-key roots may gain (`outside_bonus` up to `outside_limit`), a section's opening chords are kept apart from the one before, sections may be followed in order; off unless the request's `harmony` asks, a refusal said by the server (400). The Creator: *Chords* under the planning modes, Off · Gentle · Varied · Bold (strength 4, 8, 16; Bold also lets a chord step outside the key), sent only when the model writes the score; kept in the draft, the versions, prompt files and a take's request, said on its card. Measured on Есаул's plan (one lm_seed, Q8_0): off, 6 distinct chords and one four-chord run ×13; strength 8, 9 distinct and the commonest run ×4. suite-1607.part.

**Only the opening** (1608 engine, 1609 page; timoncool/yue2.cpp 7810749, MIT, after Mothersuperior's hum-to-song). With `abc_continue` the score is the opening of a plan, not the whole of it: it joins the prompt after ABC_START with its end token left out, the model writes the rest of the song on from it in its key and meter, and the opening is put back before the plan's own tokens (ported by its meaning: our `yue2_generate` has no carried tokens); `plan_only` takes it too; Direct or a semantic stream refused (400); a take made from an opening replays its whole score. The Creator: *Only the opening* under the score, in Full or Melody, with *Chords* steering what the model adds. Measured: Есаул's intro as the opening, the plan starts with it and goes on (verse, interlude, verse…). The kitchen suite caught a note left mid-line in the prompt files' keys (it had made `abc_sampling` and the rest a comment) before it went live. suite-1607.part.

**The transcriber as the merged engine reads it, in the install** (1610). Since 1604 the engine reads SheetSage2 as a head with MERT-v2-FullSong of the same kind beside it; the models the install fetched still held both in one file (957 MB as Q8_0), so a fresh install would have had no covers from a recording. goldhub/Ruach_Studio_Models_v2 815098b0 (`MISC/claude-tc/hf-1610.py`): SheetSage2's head in place of the old file, MERT-v2-FullSong beside it and Mothersuperior's realaudio tokenizer v4 head, F32 and Q8_0 each, byte for byte as Serveurperso/YuE2-GGUF publishes them (e630f2b8f6, every sha256 compared before the upload), with their rows in MANIFEST.tsv, the notices and the card; the pin moved. `download-models.sh --transcriber` takes the head and its MERT; `fetch-models.sh --check` names both; `start.sh` passes the transcriber only with its MERT beside it and not the older combined file, and otherwise says to run `./download-models.sh --transcriber` (the old file against the new pin is fetched again); `convert-models.sh` makes and checks MERT-v2-FullSong-F32 too and moves an older combined SheetSage2-F32 to tmp/rejected/ to be made again as two; the engine's `convert.py` skips the tokenizer when its checkpoint is not there and says so (upstream had made it a step every conversion needed). Checked: the live install against the new pin, all four files «have»; the start guard on the old file and the new; a conversion with no tokenizer checkpoint.

**FlashSR kept beside the Studio's models** (1611; Viktor 19.10.2026: «Свежие веса, что идут в Паблик, не забудь в наш HF репо выложить и прописать в загрузках»; 20.10.2026: «Не дай Бог репо будут удалены или закрыты»). Its author answered on 20.10.2026 (jakeoneijk/FlashSR_Inference issue 1): his code MIT, the pretrained weights Apache 2.0, the parts from Diffusers, AudioSR and BigVGAN under their own licences; we said there we would keep a copy, and nobody objected. POST /train/pack {name, undo} packs a set in the background; a set that is a link (on the Patriot) is refused, as writing there is. Mended on the way: preparing from a raw folder linked to the Patriot (1623) failed, its files resolving outside the link. `tools/pack-set.sh NAME [--unpack]` and `tools/fetch-hf-parquet.sh REPO NAME [FIRST [LAST]]` in bash; pyarrow 26 into .venv; lab/test_tracks.py all passed. **Intel Arc, as a beta** (1656; Viktor 21.10.2026: «Отличная новость по Arc. Конечно, выпускай бета поддержку для интеловских карт»).
- `build.sh --sycl` builds the engine with oneAPI's icpx into `build/build-sycl` and leaves the CUDA one in `build/build` as it is. icpx gets the newest GCC that has its libstdc++ headers: 13 on Ubuntu 24.04, whose GCC 14 has none. Built on the Forge in 157 s.
- `start.sh` runs it under oneAPI's runtime with `YUE2_ENGINE=sycl`, or by itself where there is a SYCL engine and no CUDA one. NVIDIA's guard and `GGML_BACKEND=CUDAn` are left out, and the card is named by `sycl-ls`.
- `SYCL_CACHE_PERSISTENT=0`: with the kernels' disk cache, libsycl 2026.1 dies at its first kernel, a fresh cache too (found 21.10 on the B50, 1639).
- Docs: INSTALL.md «Intel Arc (beta)», README's requirements, the guide ×12 under GPUs, CHANGELOG.
- The 13.10 refusal of going on from kept music on SYCL (`arc-beta-1418-engine.patch`) is not taken: it guarded against the cache, not the device.
- Measured on the Arc Pro B50 (16 GB) with the live engine, 30 s songs:
  - 43 s in BF16 (continuing after 10 s kept);
  - 52.6 s in Q8_0 plain;
  - 56 and 60 s with an adapter in Direct and Full;
  - Q5_K_M no faster than Q8_0.
  BF16 is the fastest copy on the Arc. The night's 186 probe takes and 108 A/B takes ran without a failure.

The Trainer's Save every goes down to 0.1 (ten saves an epoch, as the night's pilot was run by hand); the lab saves every round(tracks × N) steps, at least one; a save at a tenth is named RUN-eNNN.T (RUN-e001.3) in loras/ and the run's list, a whole epoch as before (RUN-e001). Under Active/All/Archived/Trash, a row of states: Training, Paused, Done, Stopped, Failed, each with its count, one at a time, kept in this browser. **A job may name its backbone** (1661): a request's "backbone" field, one of the names the engine was started with (--model); a job that names none sings on the Engine's choice. The worker switches between jobs, as settings_apply does (about a second on the Arc B50); an unknown name fails the job in words, naming the backbones the engine has. meta.json records the backbone that sang the take, request.json keeps the field. So the fine-tune's probes sing on the bare YuE2 beside the Studio's own backbone, on one engine. build-sycl/ in build/.gitignore. Tried on the B50 (a SYCL build): no field, Q8_0, no field again (switched back), and an unknown name (refused in words). `build.sh` (heresy/root) rebuilds the SYCL engine beside the CUDA one in the same pass (③b), so the Studio on the Arc restarts on fresh code too; an install with a SYCL engine and no CUDA one goes the SYCL way by itself (the updater runs `./build.sh`), and restarts the Studio only when it runs the SYCL engine. Tested 21.10 on the B50: a job naming Q8_0 sang on the bare YuE2, the next with no name back on IRAEv2, an unknown name failed in words; live on :7777 the same with BF16.

**A run without fragments** (1669; Viktor 21.10.2026 on the first wave's ranks: «гоним r192/r384»). Measured on one 3090 with the wave's knobs and a sheet on every step (the longest sequences a run meets): r192/r384 ran out of memory at 23.3 GB, 3.17 GB of it reserved by PyTorch and never used; with the allocator in expandable segments it peaks at 21.1 GB, 3.7 s a step (r128/r256: 18.1 GB, 3.6 s). The lab starts every training run so (PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True); a small run loses nothing by it.

**The first card no longer carries the average** (1671, 1671b). The first wave fell twice on 22.10.2026, both times «CUDA out of memory» on GPU0 alone: r192/r384 at track 111, then r160/r320 at track 3057, 255 tracks before its first save. Under DDP the first card alone kept the moving average (1631): at r160/r320 that is 440 M weights in fp32, 1.76 GB the other cards don't carry, and 1669's measure on one card had no NCCL beside it. Now, under DDP, the average lives in the host's pinned memory: after each step the weights are copied there and the average follows them in one pass (`_foreach_lerp_`, eight threads lent for the pass, since torchrun gives each process one: 0.38 s a step in one thread, 0.12 s in eight). Measured: the pace the same as before (1.35 s a track), GPU0 at 21.7 GB instead of 23.3; the host's average matches the card's to 7e-7 relative after 400 steps; three cards at r160/r320 with the sheet on every step end with the same adapter on each. A single card keeps its average where it was. The first wave started again at 12:28 on the same set (`fw-relaunch.sh`).

In the own-score drawer, above the key's transposer, a row writes a score at once from a key (24), a meter (4/4, 3/4, 6/8, 2/4) and a tempo (both read from the style when it names them): every section of the lyrics gets bars of chords over rests in the Vocal voice and an empty Ins voice (two bars a line, in fours, sixteen at most; a progression for the verses, one for the choruses, one for a bridge; no two neighbouring bars on one chord), read back by the page's own parser before it is written; the plan mode turns to Full and the model writes the melody and the arrangement over that harmony. Ported from timoncool's YuE2-Studio (score/chord_bed.rs, MIT, Ilya Timonin; after gary4juce's yuey scaffold): the same progressions (15 major, 16 minor) and seeded generator. The take grows by the section; its score gets the section's bars twice, its lyrics the lines twice; an ended take ends as much later. **Music before a repeat; an interlude written by the model** (1717; Viktor 22.10.2026 on the 1714 and 1715 probes: «Оно заработает, если будет музыкальный переход хоть 5-7 секунд. The lyrics carry an [Interlude] block. The cuts follow the draft's own voice, split off on the processor (`lab/vocal_rest.py`: htdemucs_ft's vocal model alone, behind the training at nice 10 and six threads, about 0.9 s a second of sound) instead of 1715's loudness of the whole mix, which found no rest in a dense one; and they sit on the score's bar lines, so what goes in is whole bars and the take's own music after it stays on its beat. The model plays longer than asked (Flood: 10.5 s before its lines for 4 asked, 9.4 s when none was), so whole bars of its music come out of the middle, its first bar and its lead-in to the voice kept. The guide ×12 has both in «Replace a Section». suite-1718.part.

**Match sections** (1719; RIVALS 9; Viktor 22.10.2026: «9 - Match sections с основной лентой»). In Cover or Remix › From a Recording, after the recording is transcribed (its score's sections named by SheetSage2), «Match sections» gives each block of the lyrics the tag of the score section it is sung in. The lab's Whisper hears where each block's first line begins in the recording (POST /lab/timing/recording: the recording kept in the cache by its hash, so it is heard once however often the lyrics change; a card through the guard, else the processor), and the blocks are matched to the score's sections. Ported from timoncool's YuE2-Studio score/section_match.rs (MIT, Ilya Timonin), after HOT-Step's Cover Studio: words never change; a block keeps its tag when it names the same kind of section; a block not heard, or one that starts in a section's last quarter, keeps its tag and place, unsure; a sung section with no block gets a copy of the last block of its kind; sections the voice does not sing get an empty tag. The proposal is shown, editable, before it goes into the form (the form as it was kept as a version first). The Rust tests' cases pass in the page. 1719b: the job keyed by the recording and its lyrics (the words heard once a recording all the same). The guide ×12 has it after «Cover or remix». suite-1719.part.

A take's time, wherever it is shown (its card in Takes and in the Library, a pinned one, the peek, the sheet, the datasheet, the take's own line), is «how long ago» or its exact date and time, as Engine › Appearance › Take time says (how long ago by default; Default look resets it). On a card a click on the time flips it to the other for that take, and its tip always says the other. The guide ×12 says it under Appearance. suite-1720.part.

**The take's menu: Edit, then Regenerate; the crossfade gone** (1727; Viktor 22.10.2026: «из раздела меню "сделать ещё раз" можно в "править" перенести несколько пунктов, таких как "Продлить", "Заменить на", "Нарастание".
