Edit (Crop, Remove a section, Repeat a section, Insert a part, Speed; then Extend, End at, Fade in, Trim to the text) and under it Regenerate (Regenerate with a new seed, Retake, Reuse, Re-render sound, Regenerate from, Edit and re-render) stand right after the wave's own items, before the Library's block. «Transcribe this take» was the datasheet's «Write it from the sound» under another name: it is that name now, in the Refiner's group. ⋈ leaves the player's bar; its code sleeps (0 s) for the playlist to come. Engine › About credits the Kit with its Apache 2.0 licence and thanks. The older menu checks (1483, 1488) read the new groups; 1713's and 1722's crossfade sections leave the suite; the guide ×12 loses its Crossfade item and says where Regenerate with a new seed stands now.

**The star's sand as faded gold blots** (1728; Viktor 22.10.2026, on 1726's grain: «Песок сделай гуще. Там сейчас на глаз меньше 5%. 20-25% смело, со скоплениями/пятнышками, пусть выглядит как выцветшие золотые кляксы»). A soft low-frequency noise picks about a fifth to a quarter of the ⭐+👍 card, a faint gold wash lies in it and the fine grain gathers inside it, nothing outside; a 480 px tile, each card from its own place.

**The take's wave over its edits** (1729; Viktor 22.10.2026: «По всем редакторским командам из контекстного меню предлагаю для визуальной ориентации по таймлайну трека вставлять его же волну и тегировать по волне донора и грядущей»). Each edit dialog of the take's menu shows the take's own wave under its words, its regions marked by kind (the donor amber, the place it goes patina, a cut red, what stays green), each with its word: Crop (what stays and goes), Remove a section, Repeat a section (the copied stretch and its copy after it), Insert a part (the part under the pointer, then where it goes in), Sing it once more and Insert an interlude (the section and what the model adds, following the breath or length chosen), Re-sing this line (the line). The marks follow the row under the pointer or in focus, and the ticks of a pick. HeresyDialog's confirm, prompt, choose and pick take a wave. The guide ×12 says it under Edit. suite-1729.part.

**The playlist** (1730, 1730b, 1731; Viktor 22.10.2026: «В библиотеке в воркспейсах в самом верху левой колонки создаём воркспейс Playlist. Удаление из плейлиста не затрагивает саму композицию/трек»; «В контекст. меню добавляем "Добавить в плейлист > Первым, Последним, Рандомно"»; «Вместо кнопки кроссфейда… кнопку для вызова модального окна с плейлистом»; «при активном плейлисте добавляем нижнюю полоску тонкую в плеер… В левой предыдущий трек, в правой — грядущий. Имена кликабельные»). The lab keeps one ordered list of takes apart from the workspaces, in user/collection.json, with its crossfade (0–4 s, kept for 1732): add first, last or at random (a take already in it moves), remove (the take itself untouched), the whole order as dragged (compared with its takes still in the library, 1730b, so a take deleted while in it never locks the order), a deck's shuffle. The Librarian's «▶ Playlist» stands first among the places, never renamed or deleted, with its own view: Play from the top, Shuffle the deck, and 720 px cards in three rows (title; when, length, plan; the marks as icons), play first, the cover last; dragged into order, × takes a card out, a right click opens the take's menu. The take's menu has «Add to playlist ›» First, Last, Random (a checked batch too). The player's ☰ opens the same view in a window over it; while the playlist plays, a strip under the player says the previous take, «Playlist · N / M» and the next, the names clickable, and the playlist plays on whatever Play on says. **The playlist's crossfade** (1737; Viktor 22.10.2026: «кроссфейд именно в плейлисте/воркспейсе выставляем ползунком от нуля до 4 секунд… при PREV и NEXT кроссфейд нулевой»; «грядущий трек не кешируется»; «Если нет, то к хуям этот кроссфейд»). 1713/1722's crossing wakes in the playlist alone, at the playlist's own 0–4 s: the slider is back in its head and the strip says «⋈ N s». Why 1722 cut the end of one take and the start of the next: its second player sought far into a file over the line for the tail, and the next take was fetched at the seam. Now, while a take of the playlist plays with a crossfade set, it and the next one are held whole in the page (at most three, never one still playing), the player and the second one play from them, and the next take starts at its very beginning; Prev and Next cross nothing; outside the playlist nothing is fetched ahead and the crossfade is 0. The guide ×12 says it with the playlist. suite-1737.part.

**Mono Maker, Peak glue, True-peak ceiling** (1738; Viktor 22.10.2026, on Shaumarov's «TOP plugins of 2026» read for the Refiner: «Берём это всё, но как у нас всё в нодах, так и выстраиваем, новые ноды, рекомендуемые этим звукотехнарём, с его дефолтными пресетами»). Three of the Studio's own steps (lab/builtin_steps/ruach) on Plenio's DSP, in the Finish group: Mono Maker (the side under 120 Hz taken out, zero-phase, the mid as it was; 80–200 Hz, an amount), Peak glue (his preparing compressor: the loud moments shaved by the dB asked, 3 by default, the loudness kept) and True-peak ceiling (the last step: an oversampled limiter at −0.5 dBTP at the file's own loudness, or driven to −14, −11 or −9 LUFS). On his КРИК: the lows' side 18.2 % → 2.0 %; 3.0 dB off the loud moments; true peak +1.25 → −0.59 dBTP at the same loudness. lab/test_mixtools.py on made sounds, all green. The guide ×12 has them as steps 13–15.

**The Trainer's run filters as icons** (1739; Viktor 22.10.2026: «Если всё в SVG иконки можешь превратить — гони огонь. Высоты элементов в общий стиль»). The Runs column's views and states are icon chips of one height (28 px) in two even rows, their words in their tips; «Done» no longer turns into a check with its count fallen under it (1593's icon button had caught it). suite-1739.part.

**The spectrum's views** (1740; Viktor 22.10.2026: «добавь в визуализацию спектрограмм и в плеере и в Огранщике переключатели всех возможных видов: моно усреднение дефолтное, Mid/Side рядом с Log/Linear, и стерео… в две строки, и… единый спектр с проявкой разниц»). **The player mirrored around its centre** (1741; Viktor 22.10.2026, night, his ruler over the player: «Укороти описаловку слева в семпле… разворачивать строку при наведении, скажем, до 800px. Никаких попап тултипов здесь… В правильном 100% скейле 1080p выравниваем дистанцию слева и справа к центру. Всё, что слева, укорачиваем. Зеркальная точность»). Measured at 1920 × 1080, the controls centred at 960, the left group stopped 65 px short of them and the right one began 181 px after. Now the left group takes the right group's visible width, so the gaps mirror within a pixel (kept as the window, the time or the hidden controls change), and the style line unfolds on hover up to 800 px, with no tip. 1741b: the two-row player's song name wraps to two lines at most, as the one-row player's did (it had been cut since 3401, its old width hiding it). suite-1741.part.

Это будет органично и неповторимо»). 1728's blots for every state of a Librarian's card, blurred hard, in pastels: gold for a star and a like (keeping 1728's wash), a paler gold for a star, green for a like, rose for a dislike, grey-blue for none; lighter by night; each card from its own place. suite-1742.part.

**Full sings an octave lower by default** (1743, the page; Viktor 22.10.2026, night: «А что, если мы будем автоматом в FULL режиме херачить октавой ниже? И в `Engine > Creator Heresy` дадим настройку по октавам?»). A new Engine tab, Creator Heresy, sets the octaves a score the model plans whole in Full moves its Vocal line before it is sung: −1 by default, −2 to +2; a score given or opened is sung as written, and the instruments never move. The request carries vocal_octave; the take's Score Planner column says the Vocal line's octaves. The engine's side (yue2.cpp's vocal_octave, matched on 240 library scores to the page's own shift) is live since 23.10.2026 02:56 (build 9b168cc, the SYCL and CUDA engines built beside the running Studio, which restarted onto them between the probe watcher's jobs). suite-1743.part.

**The page opens when everything has come** (1745; Viktor 23.10.2026, on the road, with a screenshot of the Studio half drawn: «Перепроверь Loader. Открываем страницу Студии только после того как всё загрузилось, а не как на скрине при медленном соединении. Сейчас сеть какая-то гнилая»). The veil lifted at twenty seconds whatever had come (1435), and «ready» never waited for the load event or the web fonts; on a slow road the page showed with the fallback font and its icons unpainted. Now it lifts when the page has loaded, the fonts are in, the room is set and the words are translated: ten seconds at the least, a sweeping line after twenty, and two minutes at the most. Checked at about 3.5 Mbit/s: the old page lifted at 20.6 s still loading, the new one only after its load. suite-1745.part. 1745c: the live check still saw a face loading at the lift: the wave's section marks (IBM Plex Mono, drawn on its canvas only once a take is in), and any role picked in the Fonts card or a language's own letters can do the same. Now at the load event the page asks the faces of all six font roles at 400 and 700 (with the language's letters), waits for them, and holds while any face is still loading.

**The player holds a take whole** (1746; Viktor 23.10.2026, on the road: «в плеер Студии 100% кеширование, иначе рвёт трек на проигрыше ужасно при херовом моём соединении»). Every take is fetched whole into the page before it plays (1737 held only the playlist's). On a fast line it comes within 1.2 s and plays from the page; on a slow one the stream gives its length and wave, ▶ waits with the bar saying «NN %», and the whole takes the stream's place at the same moment and play state when it lands. The next take of the list is fetched while one plays; eight takes or 450 MB are kept, never the one playing. suite-1746.part; the suite reads a take's own address (suite-fix-1746).

**Composed texts in the page's language** (1672; TODO 2.0.0 #5, «all strings in twelve languages»). The page's English harvested over the whole suite (15 499 texts, 23.10.2026), its half-translated ones read by hand: three places where a broad pattern swallowed a text the page composed in English whose parts each have their key. The Trainer's «…is missing {0}:» joined the names first, so its «{0}» was a list no key knows: each name is now in the page's language before the join. The Writer's OpenRouter line (model · price · context) was not painted again when the language changed, so «{0} context» kept the rest English: it is painted on the change now. The instrument sheet's notes are the probes' own words, with no keys; a pattern turned their «of» into «de»: they are kept as written. The other half-translated texts were a moment between the language's walk and the repaint that follows it, or the mock's own data. suite-1672.part. 1673: «{0} MB» and «Compare with…» stood twice in all eleven catalogs; in a script's object the later one wins, so the earlier was dead text (and in ja and zh it said another thing): the earlier goes, the later, the one the page shows, stays.

**Voice tamer, Voice attack and body, Bass under the kick, Details up** (1748–1751; Viktor 23.10.2026: «Идеи Шаумарова обязательно, но не как закон»). The rest of Shaumarov's tools as the Refiner's own steps on numpy and scipy, tuned to the Refiner's motto rather than the plugins' presets. The tamer lowers what rises over the voice's own colour at that moment, from 2.5 kHz up by default (a singer's formants stay: on Krik and Buratino a band from 1.2 kHz took 2–3 dB out of the words), never notching an overtone or shortening an «s»; attack and body raise the voice's beginnings and its dying away a little, capped under full scale sample by sample; the bass's low makes room under each kick found on the drum stem; and a three-band upward lift at 10 % brings up the detail under the loud parts at the same loudness. In a set of eight the voice steps take the lead and backing vocals only, as the DAW does. lab/test_refiner_nodes.py on made sounds; measured on Krik's eight stems (the tamer 1.1 dB off 2.5–6 kHz in the mix, mostly at 4.7 kHz; 195 kicks, the bass's low −2.3 dB under them). The guide ×12 has them as steps 16–19.

**The learning rate honest, with a fade** (1752; Viktor 23.10.2026, evening: «у нас LR на обучении первой Волны не слишком низкий?»; then «делай затухание на 3.5+4.0, и впиши это не только в код, но сделай настройкой и в UI Тренера»). The trainer set its rate once, when the optimizer was made, and a run gone on from a save took the rate saved with it whatever its config said, while the progress line printed the config's: a changed rate was a number in the log and nothing in the training. Now both halves take their rate from the config before every step (the sound half at the rate × √cards, the music half at its multiplier of it) and the line prints the rate the step used. The Trainer has two more knobs after Learning rate: «LR fade, epochs» (the run's last so many epochs, 0 none) and «LR at the end, %» (where the line ends, 0 by default); the fade's start is found from the run's own length, so a run gone on further fades at its new end. «Go on to more epochs» now carries every option the run was made with: it named eight before, and the lab's defaults silently took the rest (three cards became one, the moving average's span 1.0 instead of 0.25, the held-out set lost). The first wave fades over 3.5 → 4.0 epochs. lab/test_lr_tail.py; suite-1752.part; the guide ×12 says it after Learning rate.

**The DAW, a sound engineer's pass** (1753–1756; Viktor 23.10.2026: «пройдись по нашему DAW как профессиональный звукарь и всё перепроверь, удобство и фичерсет. Чего не хватает, дописывай»). The DAW's head row is one height (its controls measured at 20, 24, 28, 30 and 35 px before). A solo is shown in the head («S · n», how many lanes are soloed), and Alt+click on any S clears them all: a forgotten solo made Mix render one lane. The reference is the set's own source, matched in loudness to the mix over the stretch being played (the lab's /daw/loudness gives its K-weighted 100 ms blocks; /daw/chunk with strip=source plays it); with it a gate fault mended: a block of digital silence read as null loudness, and null passed «> −70» in JavaScript, so silence counted in the master's integrated loudness. The song gets a fade in, a fade out and «Ends at» on the master after its fader, linear in dB from −60, drawn dark over the lanes, in the render too. The DAWproject export does not carry the fade (no DAWproject concept we map). lab/test_daw_fade_ref.py and the six older test_daw*.py; suite-1753.part; the guide ×12 after «Moving and copying».

**A window sung anew with adapters of its own** (1757; TODO 6а, Viktor 15.10.2026: «растяжка до и после выбранного сегмента, в окне свои адаптеры, силы и волны»; «на волне плеера выбирается окно»). «Sing a window anew…» in the player's wave menu, anywhere on the wave: no sections heard by ear are needed (the section under the pointer is the first guess, else ten seconds round it). Its dialog lays the window on the take's wave by a drag (its edges move), with ramps before and after it (0–10 s, 2 s at first) drawn fading; the window's adapters (the take's own at first, eight at most), each with its music and sound strength and its wave over the window (flat, arch, rise, fall); the lyrics; one version or two. The lab (section.window, POST /section/window) keeps the take's codes up to the ramp before, sings on with the take's adapters fading out over that ramp and the window's fading in, the window's alone over the window and back over the ramp after; the draft's codes up to the end of that ramp are joined with the take's own, then one replay of the whole stream on the take's sound seed with the same waves (the sound half follows a wave frame by frame), so the rest of the take sounds as it did. Each version is a take of its own, a child of the take, marked as Replace a section's are (replaced.json, kind «window»). A take whose own adapters ride a wave of their own is refused for now, and said. Replace a section (1414) is untouched. lab/test_section_window.py (a fake engine, 22 checks); suite-1757.part; the guide ×12 at the end of «Replace a Section»; sixteen keys in each of the eleven catalogs (ru, uk, be: «растяжка» for the ramps, his word).

**A value typed in the DAW's console** (1758; Viktor 23.10.2026: «пройдись по нашему DAW как профессиональный звукарь… Чего не хватает, дописывай»). As a desk's numbers are: a click on a knob's number or a fader's, or a digit typed while a knob or a fader has the focus, opens a small field over the number. Enter sets the value in the knob's own words: dB; Hz with «k» for thousands; ms, with «s» for seconds; %; the ratio (4:1); L30, R30 or C for the pan; −∞ or dB for a send (kept as an amplitude). Esc, or what cannot be read, leaves the value as it was; one undo a value. The console's hint says it («…; a click on a number, or a digit, to type one»). suite-1758.part; the guide ×12 in «Knobs and faders», before Ctrl+Z; two keys in each of the eleven catalogs.

**Parallel compression: a compressor's Blend** (1759; Viktor 23.10.2026: «пройдись по нашему DAW как профессиональный звукарь… Чего не хватает, дописывай»). A compressor gets «mix» (0–1, 1 as before): the compressed sound with its make-up blended with the dry one, dry × (1 − mix) + wet × mix, on a strip, a bus and the master alike. The page's kernel blends its gain the same way ((1 − mix) + mix × its own), so what is heard is what Mix renders: lab/test_daw_parallel.py runs heresy-mixdsp.js under node and finds the page a cell later and equal to float precision. At 1, or unsaid, nothing changes to the sample. The console: a seventh knob, «Blend», in the compressor's devices (four columns now), a preset «Parallel» (−30 dB, 6:1, 5 ms, 120 ms, knee 0, +8 dB, Blend 40 %), the curve drawn blended; the report says comp_mix. suite-1759.part; the guide ×12 at the end of the Devices paragraph; two keys in each of the eleven catalogs.

**A strip's gate** (1760; Viktor 23.10.2026: «пройдись по нашему DAW как профессиональный звукарь… Чего не хватает, дописывай»). A downward expander against what the separation leaves between the phrases (the cymbals in the voice, the voice in «Other»): threshold, ratio, range, attack and release, in the compressor's own 1 ms cells, listening to the strip after its EQ (when the compressor is keyed to another strip, the gate still listens to its own); below the threshold the level goes down by the ratio, never more than the range; its gain multiplies the compressor's and its blend. The lab's render (daw_mix gate_env) and the page's kernel run the same cells: lab/test_daw_gate.py finds them equal to float precision. A third slot, «Gate», between EQ and Comp on a strip, and its card in the devices; one insert height on strips, buses, VCAs and returns, so the faders stay in a row. suite-1760.part; the guide ×12; ten keys in each of the eleven catalogs.

**The lab's reload waits for its own threads** (1790). /health's «jobs» counted the lab's job table and a weights download (1289), not the threads of section.py, a 💎 fetch or a starter set's download; the reload that waits for an empty lab (reload-when-idle.sh) restarted it under them. At 21:11:34 on 23.10.2026 the 1759 reload cut the fork's live window (1757): its draft done, its replay not yet sent. Each running one is now a job in /health.

**The returns' pre-delay and cuts** (1762; Viktor 23.10.2026: «пройдись по нашему DAW как профессиональный звукарь… Чего не хватает, дописывай»). The room gets a pre-delay of 0–250 ms on top of its preset's; both returns get a low cut (20–2000 Hz) and a high cut (1–20 kHz) on the wet, Plenio's RBJ bands at Q 1/√2, 20 Hz and 20 kHz meaning Off (said in the value only when on; «off» may be typed). The delay's cuts sit after its loop. The page's graph: input · delay · convolver · two biquads · return, a cut that is off a 0 dB bell; the lab's render the same (lab/test_daw_returns.py, 12 checks; the suite reads the biquads' response in Chrome: a 300 Hz high-pass at 60 Hz −27.97 dB against −27.968 computed). Six keys in each of the eleven catalogs; the guide ×12.

**LRA and PLR on the master** (1763). The loudness range from the short-term blocks since play, as Plenio counts it (7.26 against Plenio's 7.259 on a synthetic minute), and the peak-to-loudness ratio, the true peak over the integrated loudness; in the master's devices only, so the console strip keeps its height. «Mixed» says the render's LRA too, which the lab's report had. Two keys in each catalog; the guide ×12.

Now longhands, the strip's whole width; a name that does not fit goes to 11 px, then 10 px, then two lines at 10 px in the same 19 px, so the faders stay in a row. Seven more DAW rules carry the same invalid shorthand (.mx-print, .mx-ref, .mc-tab, .mc-chip, .mc-monb, .mc-addvca, .mx-verb); they are left as they have always looked, for Viktor's word.

**The Babel window over a run from elsewhere** (1765; Viktor 24.10.2026: «У меня само выскочило по Вавилону… написала нада модель IRAEv2 и LoRA адаптер, но не смог прочитать в ночном режиме темы»). A reload is safe: the page keeps its own live runs by id and finds them again in the log's replay, so they never go provisional. **A take made again is made on the backbone it was sung on** (1767; Viktor 24.10.2026: «Добро, гони все 53 регена»). Before the regens of the 💎 takes under 90 s the fork found that 47 of the 53 requests name no backbone: they were sung on the bare BF16 when it was the default, and /regen would have sung them on today's default, IRAEv2, putting other takes in the 💎 sets' places. A request that names no backbone now takes the one its meta says (BF16, one of the engine's --model names); one that names its backbone keeps it. The Keys Probe («keys-probe-…», 95 s requests that ended at 85–89.8 s) joins the probes' full length, 120 s with at least 90. 29 of the 53 were already 90.0 s, the 1165 minimum, so only the 18 Keys Probe takes are made again. lab/test_regen_backbone.py, 5 checks.

**The decode ladder, a Creator option** (1768; Viktor 24.10.2026: «Делай это опцией Sampling блоке Творца. Везде в остальных местах Студии пусть остаётся оригинальный стабильный предсказуемый декод. А этот в тултипе подсказки пометь как экспериментальный и отличающийся выхлопом»). «Sound decode» in Sampling › Sound and output, after Peak clip: *Whole song · standard* (the default) or *Ladder · experimental*, its tip saying the output differs. The engine's request field nar_ladder: the sound half in even pieces of about 20 s (no short tail), each solved over a window that hears 2 s past both its edges, neighbours joined by complementary half-cosines 1 s either side of their common edge in their latents; the noise kept until every piece is solved; written into the take's request only when on. Off, or a song of one piece, as before to the byte: the fork's CPU check (16 threads, base-Q8) found a replay of 300 codes and a 30 s song from nothing md5-identical with and without the patch; a ladder replay of ru-01 byte-identical to the probe Viktor called «отлично». Everywhere else the standard decode: the player's re-renders (New sound, Trim, End at, fades, VAE version, Regenerate from a moment, Extend) drop it, and so do Replace a section, Sing once more and the window anew (section.py); /regen keeps the take's own request; the lab's API never passes it. The engine went live first, at 15:10:34 in the fork's window (both binaries prebuilt, the Studio restarted between jobs), then the page and the lab. Not in it yet: the pieces solved while the music half sings on, and streaming. lab/test_section_ladder.py; suite-1768.part (8 checks); the mock keeps the field (all three copies); the guide ×12 in «Sound and output»; four keys in each of the eleven catalogs.

A merge folded into that layout was checked three ways: loaded strictly by the trainer, each delta strength·B·A within bf16, and equal to the GGUF merge of the same adapter and strengths to one bf16 step.

**The Studio's models never read from a cache** (1799; Viktor 26.10.2026: «По UniverSR, Apollo и FlashSR и остальному ... это наш продакшн модели, и их нужно из кешей вывести в правильные папки Студии, привязать в HF репозитории и в загрузчики… В идеале удаление .cache и hf_cache никогда не должно сломать ни одного из пайплайнов Студии»). UniverSR comes only from universr/: upscale_job.py fetches it there itself when an install lacks it (the Studio's copy in goldhub/Ruach_Studio_Models_v2 at its pin, else woongzip1's at his), never from hf_cache/; the upscale part of fetch-heresy.sh copies an older install's woongzip1's out of hf_cache/ into universr/ (the same bytes as v2's) and checks it by the pin, and hf_cached, whose only caller that was, is gone. Apollo-vocal's checkpoint and FlashSR's weights, when the Studio's copies are missing, come from their authors into models/upbundle/ as well, not into the hub's cache. heresy/MISC/claude-arc/no_cache_check.sh loads every model the pipelines load, the way their jobs load them, with HF_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME and TORCH_HOME empty and the hub offline: UniverSR, Apollo, FlashSR, Whisper, MERT, the separators of the stems and of the voice's cleaning (seven), the prompt writer, the content filter, Qwen-Image 2512 and 2.1, all clean (26.10.2026); the three upscalers also took a 15 s clip through on a 3090 that way. On the Forge the Studio's hf_cache/ (7.3 GB: woongzip1's UniverSR, the Kit's CLAP and MERT, the first copies of Apollo and FlashSR) went to /Trash. Unchanged: the three are in the Studio's own repo and loader since 1445, 1583 and 1611; nothing new is mirrored there.

Kept on purpose: the LoRA library still knows an SDXL or Krea 2 adapter by its layers, to say it is not for these painters; the gallery keeps the name of a picture Krea 2 painted; the Writer's style tags are still written «as an SD/SDXL prompt is» (a way of writing, not a painter); launcher/update.sh still offers to clear an older install's SDXL and Krea 2 folders; their history in HERESY.md, the CHANGELOG and the code's notes. **The evening's Studio orders** (1802; Viktor 27.10.2026). *The star after a like* («после того как я поставил лайк… по клику на звёздочку нужно ждать иногда до 10 секунд, пока станет активной»): a like's answer is the whole list as the lab read it when the like was asked, and a star set while it travelled was put out again by it until the next reload; what the page sets (the star, 🔥, 💎) is now held as the ratings were, by its turn, over any older list, and the star lights at the click (its server's word confirms it or takes it back). *🔥 and 💎* («Может давай повсюду в Студии прикрутим к картам треков 🔥 и 💎? После кнопки thumbup?»): two marks of a take's own after 👍 on the Librarian's cards and sheet, the Creator's takes, the take's head, the player and the playlist's cards; the lab keeps them (collection.json fire and gems, op mark) and the filter's Marked group has them. *Notes* («в воркспейсы и их подкатегории прикрутим Notes… к LoRA адаптерам заметки пользовательские… ограничить длину заметок разумными 500-600 знаков»): a workspace's or a section's note (⋯ → Note…, op ws-note; it follows a rename, goes with a delete, moves to a merge's target when that has none), its tip in the column and its name underlined with dots; the user's note on an adapter (right-click → Your note…, op lora-note, GET /collection/lora-notes), under a line in its tip, one note for its bf16 and its q8; every note field 600 characters, a short one counting its characters. *A double-click* on a card's ground plays it or stops it; the sounding take's round button is filled, its sign inverted. *On a reload* the Librarian's active workspace stands in the middle of its column. *The Librarian's foot* (his picture at 23:24, «Сдвинулось над плеером вверх после переключения с Творца»): while the Trainer's bars stand (a training was running), 1653's spacer under the layout left a band above the player and the sticky column rode up with the layout's end, as 1733 had cured for the room's own 60 px; the cards' grid carries that room now under its last card, measured on his window (993 px, scrolled to the end): the column ends 16 px above the player, it ended 138. *The cards' Refiner badges* («На карточках наш Огранщик рисует свои прометки, но что это — одному Клоду известно»): the filter's flags were named DERIVED too and declared over the badges' names in the same scope, so a card said «1» for stems, Debuzz, a remaster or an upscale, and «daw», «gate», «plugin» raw; the filter's map is HAS now, every kind has its name (the DAW mix, the Digital Gateway, a plugin) and «Made from it in the Refiner: …» under the pointer, and the filter's Has group lists the three. *The ♪ sheet's First Wave tab* («В Студию ты шпаргалку по First Wave оформил?»): the vocabulary page F1 links to, in the page's language and tone, the user's own vocabularies (user/vocab/, GET /vocab/) laid over it. *RU*: «ран» → «прогон» in all its forms, on the page (89 lines) and in the guide (23) (his: «омонимизм»). *The guide*: «A Voice of Your Own: Questions from the Field» in the Trainer's chapter, twelve languages, the answers to manchuwook (issue #2) kept («Такое грех терять»). The suite told the new rules (the take's head, «прогон», nineteen ticks); uk and be say «створено», the root «роб» kept out. MISC/claude-arc/apply1802.py, suite1802.py, guide1802.py, lib-gap.mjs.

**A take starts before all of it has come, on a slow line** (1803; Viktor 28.10.2026: «У нас сейчас кешируется весь первый трек. На удалёнке время занимает. Что, если начинать воспроизведение с первой минуты закешированной?»). 1746 holds a take whole before ▶ (his line tore streams). Now, on a line slow enough that the whole would keep ▶ waiting, the take starts once its first minute is in and the rest will come before the playing reaches it, by the measured pace with a margin; a fast line (the whole within 3 s) waits for the whole as before. What came plays as one file. Measured first in headless Chrome: a FLAC cut short says the whole take's length and, where its bytes end, jumps to that end and fires ended, and a seek past them stands silent. So a longer piece goes in its place 20 s before it runs out and the whole when it is in, each at the quietest moment of the wave ahead (its peaks, up to 40 s on). A line that falls behind, or a seek past what came, waits on the bar as the hold did and goes on from where it stood. While the take playing still comes, the next one's prefetch waits for it (one line, one download), and the stream no longer starts beside the hold. Tested on a line throttled to 1.2 MB/s, a 4-minute take (47 MB): it started at 10.9 s instead of about 40, its time never stood but once, 0.3 s where the whole took its place. Engine → Defaults → Start playing: «when the whole take is in» is 1746 as it was. window.ruachEarly for the checks; MISC/claude-arc/apply1803.py, flac-part.mjs, early-test.mjs.

The server log's head (his picture: «Forge · 540 мс» under the Russian tabs): its tab keeps 220 px and clips its own, the buttons wrap under it; and its buttons are icons now («захерачь понятные и внятные svg иконки»): Follow (lit while it follows), full height, copy, Engine, a window of its own (Lucide's copy, cog, arrow-down-to-line, app-window; ISC). **The Studio's https door** (1805; Viktor 28.10.2026: «по твоему совету с прошлой недели касательно самописного ssl сертификата для Студии... прикручивай, но не на всю Студию, а только на удалённый MIDI-контроллер и для будущих имплементаций»). A browser gives Web MIDI (and the clipboard, an AudioWorklet) only to a secure page, and the Studio is http on its port. lab/tls_door.py is a second way in beside it, changing nothing of it: https on 7443 with a certificate the Studio makes for itself (user/tls/, ten years, for its names and addresses), passing every byte to the Studio's port and back. Who may come in is Engine → Security's answer (user/access.json, the engine's rule repeated by the visitor's own address, since through the door everyone would reach the Studio from this computer); a refused one gets a page saying why. systemd/ruach-tls-door.service (install-units.sh writes it; started only when asked; on the Forge it is on). Checked: from the laptop over the VPN the page and the lab answer through it; headless Chrome there says a secure context with navigator.requestMIDIAccess (the grant is the user's click). The MIDI card names the door first, ssh -L beside it.

**The Studio's own Writer** (1811; Viktor 28.10.2026: «Не многие смогут настроить LLM для Писателя. У меня есть очень хороший квант QWEN 3.5-9B, а именно Qwopus3.5-9B… забирай копию этого кванта в Студию, прикручивай как Local Studio LLM, через llama.cpp… и пусть это будет опция по умолчанию для установок, где VRAM позволяет. Так не нужно будет юзеру коннектиться на внешние сервисы»; «перепакуй тензоры, выбрасывай vision голову»; «дай выбор юзеру выбрать либо мой качественный квант, либо более сжатый, чтобы в 8 или 12GB точно лёг»). His AutoRound quant of Jackrong's Qwopus3.5-9B-v3 (on Qwen3.5-9B, Apache-2.0; W4A16, symmetric, group 32, auto_gptq packing) moved into GGUF by llama.cpp's own converter with three changes (MISC/claude-arc/writer-llm/repack_q4.py): AutoRound read as GPTQ v1 (its zeros stored minus one: all 7, so 8), an index of groups made for it (it has none), and a Q4_0 writer that keeps each block exact. A symmetric group of 32 is a Q4_0 block (one fp16 scale, q - 8 in [-8, 7]); half its scales are negative, so the writer tries both signs: 178 257 920 blocks, every one exact, and the tensors read back equal to the source's by hand. What he kept in BF16 (the embeddings, the output, the linear attention's projections) is Q8_0 in «quality» (6.7 GB) and Q4_K, Q6_K, Q5_K in «compact» (5.5 GB; its 152 Q4_0 tensors byte for byte the quality's); the vision tower and the MTP head left out; the chat template his. Sane on the processor (17 × 23, two capitals, a song's brief as JSON with its sections, an English chorus), 4.5 tokens a second there. Both in goldhub/Ruach_Studio_Models_v2 at checkpoints/Qwopus3.5-9B-GGUF/ with the Apache-2.0 text, the card and MANIFEST.tsv saying them (pinned 5323010). lab/writer_llm.py runs llama-server behind the lab's /llm/v1 (models, chat/completions) and /llm/status, /llm/variant, /llm/stop: started at the first question on the card the guard gives with room for all of it, else on the processor (never a part of it squeezed onto a card that lacks the room: what holds the rest of that card, the songs' engine or a training at its peak, would lose the memory it grows into; the fork, 28.10), its thinking off unless asked, gone from the card after ten minutes without a question; the biggest card read once (nvidia-smi under a training's load answered in seconds and the page's 3 s check said «not answering»). Engine → Models and LoRAs → Studio writer (quality, compact) through fetch-heresy.sh --writer; launcher/extras.sh chooses it by the biggest card (quality from 12 GB, compact from 8) and builds llama-server. Engine → Writer has its pane (its state, the quant, Use this writer, Unload); where its weights are here and no chat server was ever chosen, the Writer asks it, a default that follows the page's own address and is not stored. Checked live: a question through the engine's /lab answered in 9 s from cold on the processor (every card busy with a training); a fresh page took it as its Writer, «ready». MISC/claude-arc/writer-llm/ (apply1811.py, w1811.py, repack_q4.py, writer_probe.py, hf_writer_up.py, hf_writer_card.py), default-probe.mjs.

**The player: PREV twice, its buttons at rest, the page's helps, the load line, a change of piece without a gap** (1820; Viktor 28.10.2026: «на кнопку PREV две функции: один клик - на начало текущего трека. Два клика в промежутке 1 сек - предыдущий. Все кнопки и тексты на плеере сделай на 10% непрозрачнее… регулировку полупрозрачности… выключатели отображения вспомогательных подсказок/тултипов… в Звезду добавь подсказку Favorite… ThumbDown тоже подсказку и об исчезновении в списке… на 55-й секунде микро-провал по звуку… прогресс загрузки волны семпла»).
- ⏮ once: back to the take's start (at its start already: the take above); twice within a second: the take above.
- The player's buttons, marks and times stand at 60 % at rest (were 50 %); Engine → Defaults → «The player's buttons and texts at rest» sets it from 30 to 100 %, seen as the slider moves.
- Engine → Defaults → Hints: the tips over buttons and fields, the hint lines (row-hint, hint), the ⓘ marks (a warning's stays), each off by its class everywhere at once.
- ☆ says «Favourite»; 👎 says that the take leaves the lists while «Show disliked takes in the lists» is off and that «Only the disliked» still finds it (in the player, the take's page and the cards; 👍 and the marks stay without, as «fewer tips» had them).
- How much of the take has come: a thin grey line along the player's top edge, out of the flow, the player as tall as it was.
- The drop: a take started from its first minute changes to a longer piece of itself at the quietest moment before the piece runs out (about 55 s), and the player stood silent while it found its place in the new piece (1.2 s in the headless probe; «micro» on his machine). The piece playing is now decoded 3 s ahead of the change (Web Audio: a FLAC cut short decodes as far as it goes, 112 s in 0.33 s) and sounds from the very sample the player stood at; the player finds its place paused, 1.2 s ahead of the buffer, and comes in when the buffer reaches it, the buffer fading in 90 ms. A pause by hand stops the buffer. A second, silent player was tried first and stood «seeking» inside the piece cut short at every change. Found on the way: «one sound at a time» (1476) paused the player the moment any other player started, the crossfade's second player too (1713/1737), which is why the playlist's crossing had never sounded; the crossfade's player and the player are one group now.
Checked headless: ⏮ from 0:30 to 0:00, then twice to the take above; the load line 8 → 57 → 100 % and gone; the player at rest 0.6, the slider live; the three hint switches hide and bring back; at 420 KB/s both changes of piece bridged and landed: the buffer sounded from 49.1 s and from 122.6 s, the player found its place paused (the first seek into a new piece took 1.4 s, so it aimed again 1.2 s further) and came in where the buffer stood (MISC/claude-arc/apply1820*.py, player-1820-probe.mjs, bridge-1820-probe.mjs).

**The Videographer follows the player** (1830; Viktor 28.10.2026: «Не забудь про Видеографа 🎥. Начаток уже есть, и это радует»). On the take in hand, a line on the strip stands where the player is, and its shot is lit there and in the list; while it plays the list keeps that shot in view, unless a scene is being written. Every shot has ▶, which plays the take from the shot's start (a double click on its block does the same), and ⧉, which copies the shot as a video model reads it: its scene (what is seen, Camera, Motion, Light and colour), then the clip's look (Characters, Setting, Palette, Notes), then its length, the fields as they stand, saved or not. That is what goes to MiniMax H3 when a card is free, and what can be tried by hand in any video model meanwhile. The storyboard (.md) carries the same prompt under every written shot, so all of them go in one file. The page gives its seekTake to the room (window.ruachSeekTake). Checked live on a planned take of 37 shots: ▶ on the fourth started at 0:26, the fourth block and card lit, the line inside its block; the suite answers a plan of three shots and catches the seek and the copy. **Sound to MIDI: MuScriptor in the Studio** (1834; Viktor 28.10.2026: «Вписывай MuScriptor в TODO. И… при первой возможности вживляй MuScriptor в Студию — в паспорт треков и в самого Огранщика»; «забирай large модель muscriptor, и пропишешь все три размера в Engine. Автоматом предлагаем large для нормальной видеокарты»). MuScriptor (Mirelo and Kyutai; its weights CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial use only) turns a mix into multi-instrument MIDI: 34 named instrument groups and the drums, without velocities. The Studio runs it through muscriptor.cpp (DamRsn, MIT, on ggml) with a small program of its own, build/muscriptor/ruach_muscriptor.cpp: the sound in as 16 kHz mono float32; out a type-1 MIDI file (a track an instrument, the drums on channel 10, every note at velocity 100) and the notes as JSON; its progress in lines. build.sh builds it into build/build-muscriptor the first time and when its source is newer (muscriptor.cpp and its own ggml fetched at their pinned commits); it is not the server's build, so it never restarts the Studio. Engine → Models and LoRAs has a row «Sound to MIDI» with the three sizes (fetch-heresy.sh --muscriptor small|medium|large, from DamRsn/muscriptor-gguf at its pin into models/muscriptor/v1, with its notice and licence) and offers large first where the program runs on a card of 8 GB or more, small on the processor. The lab (muscriptor.py; GET /midi, /midi/sets, /midi/status) makes a set under the take's derived/ as the stems are, one transcription at a time, on half the processor at most (16 threads: past that it went no faster). The take's datasheet has MIDI: the sets with their instruments and the file, a size (the suggested first; the sizes done marked and not run again) and the run's progress. The Refiner's tree heads a MIDI set with its size, notes and instruments and offers its file as a download, neither a player nor a source for other steps. The Refiner has a MIDI step of its own: a source (the take or any file of its tree; a stem gives its instrument alone), a size the lab has (the suggested first), the run with the program's own progress as its bar in the step and the room's head, the set into the tree; on the canvas a node with a file in and nothing out, wired from the take by default, with the looks at the right so their numbers stay. Measured on a 100 s gospel take, on the processor (two Xeon E5-2697A v4, 16 threads): small 30–39 s (607–663 notes), medium 71 s (651), large 274 s (575). Prelude forcing (the reference's default: notes still sounding carried into the next 5 s chunk) is off: with it the medium model filled the take with woodwinds that were not there (2719 notes, 877 of them a bassoon, in 580 s). The cards come later: muscriptor.cpp lists Metal and Vulkan only, CUDA needs a patch of ours, and its device listing alone opens a context on every card, so it waits until they are free. The Studio's own score importer reads the MIDI (A♭ major, as the take is; 48 bars). MISC/claude-arc/apply1834b.py, apply1834c.py, apply1834d.py, apply1834e.py, apply1834f.py, ds-1834-probe.mjs, rf-1834-probe.mjs, muscriptor.py.

**A MIDI set opens in the piano roll** (1835). The lab reads a set's file as the Creator's score with the importer REAPER's Generate here already uses (midi_score.py: the key guessed from the notes, the voice for Vocal, an instrument's line for Ins, a chordal one left to the instruments): GET /midi/score. The datasheet has «Open in the roll» on each set: the score into the form (asked first when the form holds one), the Creator, the roll on it, the key, tempo and bars said. Checked on the gospel take's small set: A♭ major, as the take, 48 bars. MISC/claude-arc/apply1835.py.

**The tail guard** (1836; TODO from RC3's report of 08.10.2026, «Сторож хвоста: если громкость возвращается после тишины в последней минуте, End at… предлагается с готовой секундой»; Viktor 08.10.2026: «после последнего правильного затухания какая-то… хуета выскакивает на 10-15 секунд»). lab/tailguard.py reads a take's loudness in 50 ms steps against the song's own median: a silence is 22 dB under it for 0.6 s at least, and it counts when the sound comes back after it, within 15 dB of the median, for 2 s at least, in the take's last 30 s (the last 40 % of a short one). GET /tail says where. End at…, when the player does not stand on the take, offers that second and says why («The sound comes back at 0:49.5 after 1.2 s of silence: suggested, it ends there»); with the player on it, it offers where the player stands, as before. Measured on the 200 newest takes: in the last 75 s it fired on 27, most of them a narrator's pause or a break before the outro, so the window is 30 s; there it fires on 23, all short (test minutes, where the song seems to end at 48.5 s of 60, and the promo's narrations), on no song longer than 150 s. A suggestion only, said with its reason; his ear says whether it finds his case. MISC/claude-arc/apply1836.py, tailguard.py.

**The Videographer's animatic** (1837; Viktor 28.10.2026: «Не забудь про Видеографа 🎥. Начаток уже есть, и это радует»). Before any picture is made, the plan can be seen in the song's own time: «Animatic» beside the storyboard draws a frame a shot (its number, time and section, its words, its scene with the labels in the page's language) over the take's cover blurred and darkened (a dark ground without one), each shown for its shot's length, with the take's own sound, as an MP4 of 1280 × 720 (Pillow draws the frames, ffmpeg joins them: the processor alone, no picture model). The room shows a player for it and its MP4; the lab makes it as a job (POST /video/animatic), says how far (GET /video/animatic) and plays it with Range (GET /video/animatic.mp4); user/videos/NAME.animatic.mp4. Measured: a plan of 37 shots on a song of 4:30 in 24 s, 7.4 MB. DejaVu writes Latin, Cyrillic and Greek; Japanese and Chinese words wait for a font that has them. MISC/claude-arc/apply1837.py, animatic_code.py.

**The Videographer's shots get their pictures, and the clip is cut from them** (1838; Viktor 28.10.2026: «Не забудь про Видеографа 🎥»; MorningDAW's «Bounce to picture», taken as a thought). Each shot has a slot for a picture of its own beside its scene: a click opens the Artist's pictures (from its runs, the wide ones first, those put aside left out) and «From disk…»; a picture picked is kept as a JPEG of at most 3840 px in user/videos/NAME.frames/ (one replaced or taken off goes to off/, never deleted) and stays with its shot when the plan is cut again on the same times; the strip marks the pictured shots. «Clip» beside «Animatic» cuts the clip in the song's own time with the take's sound, 1920 × 1080: each shot moves slowly as its scene's camera says (a push-in, a pull-back, a pan; held still when locked off), else in turn; a wide picture fills the frame, a square or tall one stands whole over itself blurred; a shot with no picture of its own shows the take's cover, and in a take with none its words and scene (the animatic's card), so the cut shows what is still to picture. The cuts fall where the shots begin, on the sung lines. Pillow readies the pictures at twice the size (the move does not step), ffmpeg moves and joins them: the processor alone, no video model. The scenes being written are kept before a picture or the clip is asked. The lab: GET /video/frame, POST /video/frame ({name, i, run, file}, or off) and /video/frame-upload (the bytes), POST /video/clip, GET /video/clip, GET /video/clip.mp4 with Range; user/videos/NAME.clip.mp4. Measured on the Forge with the processor shared: 37 shots of a 4:30 song in 188 s, 13 MB. MISC/claude-arc/apply1838.py, apply1838b.py, clip_code.py.

**A shot's picture drawn in the Artist from its scene** (1839; Viktor 28.10.2026: «Не забудь про Видеографа 🎥»). 🎨 on a shot puts its prompt for a picture into the Artist's form and opens the room: what is seen, who is in it and where, the framing, the light and the colours, ending «A still frame of a music video, no text.» (the motion and the length are left out: they are the video model's, ⧉ still copies those). A word in the Artist says what next: once drawn, the picture is given to the shot from its slot (1838), the wide ones first. The wave of an adapter through the song has six modes now: Flat, Arch, Rise (from a tenth of its strength up to the full at the end), Fall (from the full down to a tenth), Draw and Sections; Rise and Fall are the shapes a sung window has had since 1757 (lab/section.py SHAPES), sent as their points as Arch is. GET /sung?name=TAKE[&run=1] (sung_end): {timed, done, count, unsung, suggest, last, heard}, 202 while the timing runs. **Three more Colours in the Remaster: cassette, radio, hall** (1845; TODO 2.0.x: «Ещё «Цвета» в Огранщике рядом с винилом, лентой и комнатой: кассетный wow и flutter, полоса старого радио, воздух зала»). Cassette: a hiss higher and brighter than the tape's (pink, 2–11 kHz), and the song itself through a slow wow (0.55 Hz) and a fast flutter (6.5 Hz), ±0.115 % and ±0.078 % of pitch measured on a 1 kHz sine (ffmpeg's vibrato depth is not linear: the depths were found by measuring), its top rolled off at 12.5 kHz. Radio: the song in an old radio's band, mono, 300 Hz to 3.4 kHz, squeezed a little (3:1), with the air's static and its crackle in the same band, mono too (one seed for both channels). Hall: a hall's low hum (25–220 Hz) and the air of its people (180 Hz–2.5 kHz, 9 dB under). The noise layers levelled as the others were, their RMS at a=1 measured over 20 s (the tape's −20.1 found again, −20.11). Measured on 30 s of a take: the radio's sides correlate at 1.0 and its lows fall 5.7 dB; the cassette's top 1 dB; the hall at −36 dB barely moves the spectrum. The guide's Remaster step now says its Colour (1425's, never in the guide) with the three, in twelve languages. lab/debunker.py (COLOUR, COLOUR_MUSIC, COLOUR_MONO); MISC/claude-arc/apply1845.py, guide_1845.py.

On the Forge tonight: 63 takes timed, 13 not sung to their end, 26 sung, 24 too little heard to say. MISC/claude-arc/apply1846.py, fix1846b.py, fix1846c.py (the suite: the catalog mocked and All workspaces, as Compare does).

**The player's stream: FLAC or Opus 128** (1851; Viktor 29.10.2026: «Оставляем wav/flac как базовые форматы. А вот поток плеера на страницу вместо listen.flac — это да и амен. Engine → Defaults → Player → The player's stream: FLAC (the engine's listen.flac, as it was) or Opus 128 kbit/s: the lab makes the take's listen.opus beside it at the first play (libopus VBR, its title in the tags, made again when the take's sound is newer, one encode at a time a take) and serves it with Range (GET /listen?name=&codec=opus). Only the player: downloads stay WAV and FLAC, comparisons hear FLAC. **A long shot in pieces on its card; the guide's Videographer as it is now** (1879; Viktor 29.10.2026: «Придётся резать на куски… абы таки на склейке не было разницы по песку латентов. 8 шагов берём на прототипирование, а 28 — в продакшн. В гайде распиши все свои находки и прочее»; «Если одна карта, то резать, а если две+, то может лучше DDP, если такое возможно?»). A card of 24 GB holds about 33 000 of H3's video tokens at once: at 768p 32 latent frames (107 frames, 4.4 s), at 480p 82 (277 frames, 11.5 s). lab/h3rt makes a longer shot chunk after chunk on its card (runtime.chunk_latents, H3._shoot_chunks; the worker's shoot() goes there by itself): a chunk but the last keeps its whole groups of latent frames (a group is 17 frames: the first one and four of four), so the chunks lie end to end on the VAE's own grid; the next chunk takes the last frame of the one before (its last group decoded alone) as its picture at its own frame 0, shown to the text encoder too, as the shot's picture is (FL2VA), and carries the last 2 latent frames before it at their own times (the community's H3 Extend); the frame made twice loses its copy and the last frame is held for it (42 ms a seam; the clip cuts a shot to its time anyway); the whole shot is decoded in one pass, so its grain does not change at a seam; the chunks' seeds are the shot's and the next ones. Measured on a 3090, the same picture, prompt and seed (8 steps): the 2 latent frames alone (226 frames, 3 chunks, 851 s, 21.4 GB) cut hard at the first seam, a frame difference of 51 against a median of 2.1: the next chunk began the prompt's «slow push-in» again from the wide shot; the picture one frame before the chunk kept the woman, her dress and the sea but not the framing (39 against 2.8); the picture at the chunk's own frame 0 held it all: 1.9 at the seam against a median of 2.85, the grain the same on both sides (1.295 and 1.295), the push-in going on (209 frames in 2 chunks, 820 s with the processor shared, 20.5 GB); it is the default (runtime.SEAM). DDP: a shot is not shared between cards (sequence parallel over PCIe across two NUMA nodes, with 70 % of the DiT streamed from RAM, would not pay); the cards make shots side by side, a clip as fast. The guide's «Coming to the Videographer» gives way to «Moving Shots», «Long Shots», «Upscaling Shots» and «How Long a Shot» in twelve languages (check_guide: nothing new against the English); anchor_guide gave the translations' «A Voice of Your Own: Questions from the Field» its id, which links into it missed in eleven languages. The pipeline (vendor.py): context_latents with context_offsets, ctrl_time, decode=False; packing: a keyframe anchor at any time. MISC/claude-arc/h3rt/vendor.py, runtime.py, patch_seam_1879.py, smoke_chunks.py, smoke_seam.py; guide_1879.py.

**An ambient layer's level is no longer set by one pop** (1941; 30.10.2026). The Ambient step scaled the whole layer by its loudest sample, so one crack in a fire recording, some 11 dB over the rest, put eight minutes of fire on a real take at −48.4 dBFS where −37 was asked, while its manifest said «−17 dB where it sounds». lab/ambient.py limit(): the gain dips only around a peak that would pass the ceiling (the least gain it needs, held 20 ms each side, averaged over no wider a window, so it never comes back above what the peak needs); on that take the fire sounds at −36.4 dBFS, its crack held 12.3 dB down alone, 0.19 % of the samples touched. The step reports how deep it limited and names its second recording «recordings II», not «bank2». The quiet version stays beside the new one, marked.

**The Trainer's held-out groups and its stop-crane** (1944; Viktor 29.10.2026, the next run's plan accepted: «Валидация по группам: RU, UA, HE, EL, дикторы и база, примерно по 20 отложенных треков в каждой. Стоп-кран: если ar_ce на RU, UA или дикторах растёт два сохранения подряд или ar_kl выше 0,07, обучение встаёт, и берём предыдущее сохранение»). A run's spec may name its held-out tracks by group (val_groups: {group: [stem, …]}, at most 12 groups of 64; a weighted track too, named by the run, leaves the epoch with all its copies); each group is measured on its own at every save (val/flow_G and val/ar_ce_G in the log, val.json's history), and so is the AR's KL averaged over the steps since the save before. The stop-crane (stop_ce_groups, stop_ce_rises, stop_kl_max): a named group's held-out ar_ce higher at each of the last rises saves than at the one before, or the KL over its ceiling, stops the run and names the save to take (val.json «stopped»: why, take). crane() is a pure function of the history: lab/test_crane.py, eleven cases. The lab passes the four keys through.
