MISC/claude-arc/apply1953.py, docs_1953.py, refiner-1953-windows.mjs.

**Mute and bypass by ComfyUI's keys** (1954; Viktor 30.10.2026: «Да, давай как в Comfy настоящий Mute с шорткатами Комфи»). Ctrl+M mutes the nodes selected (else the one under the pointer, or the one whose window is open): greyed out, «muted» on it, kept in this browser; a muted step does not run from its window (its own run held, its window says so) and the way stops before it, what follows it taking its output; a muted check is left out alone. Ctrl+B bypasses the same nodes on the way, as their right-click does; the right-click offers Mute and Unmute.

**The bucket in place of the workspace's run** (1955; Viktor 30.10.2026: «в моём примере 13 треков в пространстве. Это сколько времени всё это будет херачиться?… ограничиться, как и в Видеографе… выбором одного трека, настроить и протестить под ним воркфлоу, а вот потом… бакета, в который пользователь может сложить от одного… до 10 треков, и вот тогда только гнать батчем… Никому не нужно это «Прогнать на пространстве»»). «On the workspace…» is gone; «Bucket» with its count stands in its place: a window of up to ten takes kept in this browser, the take in hand put in from it, checked takes from the Librarian's menu («Into the Refiner's bucket», ten at most, what does not fit said), one taken out, emptied, and «Run the way on N» asks first, naming them, then sends the batch as before.

**The legend dragged, its «?», the DAW icon in line** (1956; Viktor 30.10.2026: «подсказки с легендами… переносить их не получается. И при сворачивании давай сдвигать кнопочку со значком вопроса влево вниз на канвасе, и побольше её, сделай красиво в SVG»; «кнопка EXPORT TO DAW - она не в стиле, увеличен размер бордюра и сдвинута вниз»). The legend drags where it suits and stays there until Arrange; folded, it becomes a round 42 px «?» drawn in SVG at the canvas's bottom left, which opens it again; a line of it names Ctrl+M and Ctrl+B. The head's «Export to DAW» icon is 28 px with its neighbours' corners, on their line. A suite section for the three (a mocked way run: the muted step not sent, its window holding its run), section 1562 made the bucket's. MISC/claude-arc/apply1954.py, fix1954_i18n.py, docs_1954.py.

**The way kept as a profile, each flow its own layout** (1957; Viktor 30.10.2026: «При F5 моя раскладка исчезла из канваса Огранщика. Как и с Творцом, продумай кеширование в браузере и сохранение состояния в файлах пользователя в Студии. Предложение сохранить текущий изменённый воркфлоу, если нет уже сохранения, и если этот же редактируется, предложить перезаписать. Ctrl+S те же действия»). His layout went because choosing a flow from the list laid the canvas out anew (1951) over the one place the positions were kept; now each flow keeps its own layout in this browser (synced to the Studio's settings as every yue2 key), so another flow lays out anew and coming back finds the nodes where they were put. The profiles (1515) already keep in the Studio's files the way, the steps' settings, where the nodes stand and the clones; the one set or kept last is the profile in hand, and a dot on the profiles' icon says the canvas changed since (a node moved or arranged, the way wired, cut or made anew, a clone, a mute, a step's setting changed by hand), its tip naming the profile. Ctrl+S keeps the way: with a profile in hand it offers to overwrite it or to save a new one, without one it asks a name (a name kept already is overwritten only when asked); Ctrl+Shift+S always asks a name; setting another profile over changes not kept asks first (overwrite the one in hand, keep them under a name, or drop them).

**The log's window taken back after a reload** (1958; Viktor 30.10.2026: «Отсоединённое окно осталось на другом мониторе. А после F5 студии оно полностью потеряло связь»; «я сделал ресайз и текстовое поле заимело большой отступ снизу»). The detached server log keeps a small watch of its own (a script in its own window, which outlives the page that opened it): when the Studio's page is loaded anew it asks that page to take it back, and is filled again with its rooms' tabs, its lines and the cards' tick (the old tick stopped). It no longer keeps the room the Studio's page leaves for its player, so its log reaches its bottom edge at any size. A suite section (the dot, each flow's layout, Ctrl+S asking a name then offering to overwrite, a profile set over changes asking first, the window's watch). MISC/claude-arc/apply1957.py, docs_1957.py.

**The Engine as he asked it: About, Updates, Hardware, the time bars** (1959; Viktor 30.10.2026: «В обновлении и о программе… наш github репо, моё авторство и общая благодарность всем деривативам несколькими словами, и громко нашу AGPL 3.0 лицензию… Сначала идёт всё наше, а затем модели, что мы используем в Студии, и по мере важности сами репозитории заимствованного и пропатченного нами кода»; «дропдаун селектор КОГДА ВЫЙДЕТ не выпадает»; «кнопка "КАК ОСТАВЛЕН"… Это просто переключатель режимов»; «блок ВИДЕОКАРТЫ растяни на всю ширину… блок MIDI… третьей колонкой после блока ВЫЧИСЛЕНИЯ… 3/5/4»; «Производительность Студии — бары налеплены один на другой»; «в творце при наведении на семпл, что рендерится, маркер ИДЁТ бегает влево»). About's first line is the Studio's own: its repository, its author, AGPL-3.0 as a pill of its own and a few words of thanks to every project it grew from; the Kit, a derivative, keeps its link in the first column, which now goes ours first (the source, the website, the weights, the LoRAs, the starter sets, the probes, the coffee), then the models the Studio uses, then the code it grew from. «When it comes out» is a choice in hand everywhere: where the Studio is not a clone of its repository and cannot update itself, the line under it says why and, with «update by itself» chosen, that it asks until it can. The Refiner's setting has its two modes, the list or the canvas, with no third «as it was left». The Hardware tab: Hardware, Compute and MIDI in one row at 3 : 5 : 4, the GPUs under them the whole width. The time-with-the-studio bars were slabs laid over each other because the listening share's class was «play», and the play button's `.play { width: 44px; height: 44px }` took the SVG rect (CSS geometry wins over the attributes): the class is «listen» now, the bars begin at the first day kept (a week at least), each narrower than its day; and after an F5 the Engine opened on its last tab paints the card at once, not a minute later. A take in rendering keeps its «running» mark where it stands when the pointer is over it. The README's words of the author in ru, uk and be say it without the root of «раб». A suite section (the choice in hand, the row, the GPUs' width, the bars' own width and their gaps, the card painted on the Engine's opening). MISC/claude-arc/apply1959.py, docs_1959.py.

**Adapters against the model they were trained on** (1960, with the trainer's half in lab 989eff5; Viktor 30.10.2026: «нужно продумать в Творце флагирование и отключение адаптеров, которые не на своих моделях/файнтюнах тренились как несовместимые. Отключать как в списке LoRA адаптеров, так и в подгруженных, если вдруг переключил модели»). An adapter learns on the weights it trains on: one of YuE2 tears on the RS-FW fine-tune, as his ear found on 27.10, and one of RS-FW does the same on YuE2. The lab tells each adapter's base (lab/lora_bases.py, POST /lab/lora/bases with the model and the catalog's ids in the body, since the Studio's door refused the long URL with 414; a GET for a few): its file's word first (base_model, which the Studio's trainer writes from this patch on, or kohya's ss_base_model_version), else the run of this Studio that made it (training/<run>/run.json, options.base: empty is YuE2), else YuE2, said to be assumed. The model's line comes from its GGUF: an RS-FW epoch folded in by merge-loras makes it RS-FW of that epoch, else its name (RS-FW-2.4…), else YuE2 or a merge of YuE2 with adapters (IRA, IRAE), else unknown and nothing flagged. The fit: same (YuE2 and its merges, or RS-FW of the same epoch at any strength), near (RS-FW of another epoch), other (YuE2 against RS-FW either way); an adapter folded into the model already says so too. The Creator asks the lab when the model or the catalog changes: a chip of another model's wears ⊘ and its base, its tip says why, and a click asks before it goes in («Use it anyway», said for this model only); a near one wears ≈. When the model changes, the song's adapters of another model are muted with a toast and a red tag on the row, left out of the run, and come back by themselves when the model is theirs again; a right-click brings one back anyway; a take brought back is weighed against the model at once. The Engine's list says «trained on …» on each tile. And the toasts loras.js speaks through (window.HeresyToast) were never set: its notes' toasts since 1802 had no one to show them; app.js gives its own now. A lab test (lab/test_lora_bases.py, 10 checks) and a suite section (the mark, the question, Cancel and Use it anyway, the mute and the way back, «anyway» per model, the right-click, a take). MISC/claude-arc/apply1960.py, docs_1960.py.

**The Videographer's inner rooms** (1961; Viktor 30.10.2026: «настаиваю на внутренних комнатах/вкладках в Видеографе, чтобы всё было на одном едином канвасе в 1080p»). The edit page (the program monitor, the inspector, the timeline) became the first of four inner rooms, **Editing**, beside **Shots**, **The idea and the look** and **Animatic and clip**; one in sight, as tall as the column, so nothing scrolls the room on a 1080p screen (it was 1263 px of room in an 852 px window), only a room's own list. The bar keeps the plan's own buttons (the plan, the scenes, the cuts on the beat, Save, the storyboard, the editor's zip); 🎨 🎬 ⇮ went into Shots, Animatic, Clip, the titles, the lyrics, between sections and the shape into Animatic and clip. The program monitor takes the height its room has; a shot chosen on the timeline opens its card in Shots from the inspector («Its card in Shots»). The room left on is kept, Editing the default. A suite section at 1920 × 960 (every room fits, the monitor large, the timeline whole, each room's buttons in it). MISC/claude-arc/apply1961.py.

**The running node's bar, its ETA, its Stop** (1962; Viktor 30.10.2026: «На активную работающую ноду можно приделать индикатор прогресса с примерным просчётом ETA. ETA можно вычислять по движению самого прогресса бара. И явная кнопка остановки работающего процесса… прогрессы на каждую ноду прикрутить в стиле Комфи»). The lab: what a chain starts is the chain's own. A thread knows its owner («chain:<take>»), the job threads it starts inherit it (_spawn, nineteen of them), and every process an owned thread starts (subprocess.Popen, so subprocess.run too) is kept under it in a group of its own; POST /lab/chain/stop ends those groups, a wait in the chain ends as «stopped», no new process starts, and the chain says «stopped», not «failed» (the bucket's Stop stops its take in hand too; a batch waits on «stopped» as on done). Each step's pace, the seconds of work for a second of song, the last twenty by its kind, is kept in user/refiner-pace.json; a step starting says when, and what its kind took before on a song this long; GET /lab/chain gives the lab's clock and the running step's own progress when its job says one. The page: the running node wears a bar under its words: the job's progress with the time left from that movement; else the past pace («by its past runs»), striped once it runs longer; on a first run it only breathes and counts. ■ beside it asks, then stops the way where it stands; the chain's line says ■ and «stopped by hand». A step working inside the lab itself (no process of its own) finishes first. A lab test (lab/test_chain_stop.py, 7 checks) and a suite section. MISC/claude-arc/apply1962.py, docs_1961_1962.py.

**The console's chips in their own size** (1963; Viktor 30.10.2026: the console's «Комната / Пластина / Зал» out of style and overflowing to the right). Seven rules of the DAW's console (its chips, its tabs, the M/S marks, the monitor, the reverb's picker, +VCA) said «font: 11px/1.45 inherit», which is no font at all: inherit cannot stand in the shorthand, the browser drops the whole declaration, and each drew the page's 15 px, «Пластина» 90 px wide in a strip of 70. Their sizes now as longhands; the room's three fill their strip, a long word cut short. A suite section (each one's size, the three inside their strip). MISC/claude-arc/apply1963.py, docs_1963.py.

**2.0.3 cut and published** (31.10.2026; Viktor 30.10.2026: «как только уверен, что в Огранщике и Видеографе код зрелый и исправный для очередного среза, одобряю сделать срез 2.0.3, и в гитхаб репо. Также не забудь обновить сайт визитку и наши HF репо»). HERESY 1815–1963; VERSION 2.0.3, the CHANGELOG dated with 2.0.4 · In the Making above, README's Done › 2.0.3, the card's line «2.0.3 · the Videographer to a finished clip» in twelve languages (MISC/claude-tc/v203/v203_docs.py). make-release stopped the tree once, on the trainer's 1944 docstring naming a private run (lab f212ab1, fixed at the source); the first clean clone failed one check that the root's tools/ copy of the suite did not yet have (make-release copies the root's tools/, not heresy/root/tools): synced and cut again. The clean clone saw no CUDA card: the page 1379/0, the player 3/0, Pinokio 74/0, the places 26/0, private 0 (yue2.cpp's demo lyric let by its exact file). Ruach_Studio.Release 2474461, tag v2.0.3, https://github.com/igrbible/Ruach_Studio/releases/tag/v2.0.3 (the latest), tarball SHA-256 63be4d491cb0c13fefd3844942a1dcd1c71ebccaa5c944d28c81d52753799d45; the card live on 2.0.3 (its ring/ on the web server left as it was); the FW and LoRAs cards on Hugging Face say that an adapter holds only on the weights it learnt on (MISC/claude-tc/v203/hfcards203.py, the Studio's HF_HOME token).

**The node's output** (1964; Viktor 30.10.2026: «вкладку "Выхлоп ноды"… только её вход и то, что эта нода сделала, с богатыми плеерами дерева»; I said yes). A step's window has two tabs: Its settings, as before, and The node's output: what went in (the take, a file or a set of stems, from its newest branch) and what this node made from the take, newest first, in the tree's own rows with their players, Compare, Spectrum, On Forge and FLAC. heresy-derived.js draws the original's row and a branch by functions of their own (origHtml, branchHtml), keeps its handlers to put on another host, and gives renderInto(host, ids); the window's output is drawn again only when its branches change, so a player that plays keeps playing; closed, its players go. The tab chosen stays while the nodes are walked. The take's tree, the import and the take have no such tab. A suite section. MISC/claude-arc/apply1964.py, docs_1964.py.

**The DAW's lanes their own height** (1965; Viktor 30.10.2026: «каждая полоса фиксированной высоты по умолчанию, 60–80px, а пользователь тянет её снизу до ~120px»; «сама страница не прокручивается: DAW как фиксированный холст, дорожки прокручиваются внутри»). A lane is 72 px in the window and over the whole screen alike, no more the screen's share (1499); a grip at its foot drags it from 40 to 120 px, kept by the stem's name with the page (yue2.mxLaneH), and a double-click puts it back. The lanes scroll inside the DAW under a ruler that stays on top, the playhead running down all of them; over the whole screen they take what the console leaves. The full screen's tip and the guide say so. The suite's full-screen section rewritten for it (72 px there as here, the grip, the double-click). MISC/claude-arc/apply1965.py, docs_1965.py.

**A lane's own menu** (1966; Viktor 30.10.2026: «На полосы в DAW со стемами продумай контекстное меню, как в Bitwig и других нормальных DAW… Mute трека и остальное»). A right-click on a lane's left part (its name, its buttons) opens its menu: Mute or Unmute, Solo or Unsolo, its automation, its devices in the console, Height (40, 72, 96, 120 px, as the grip of 1965 sets it), its level back to 0 dB, its silences and moves taken off (when it has some), and the lane as split (its level, mute, silences, sends and devices); each one step of the DAW's undo. Its version's right-click (its devices) and the wave's (a silence or a point given back) stay as they were. A suite section. MISC/claude-arc/apply1966.py, docs_1966.py.

**The DAW's console on the right** (1967; Viktor 30.10.2026: «блок с консолью, устройствами и Миксами — рамкой справа, по наведению или закреплённой… открепляемой как плавающая панель, но в DOM страницы: переключение вкладки или комнаты её прячет»). The console (its strips, its devices, the mixes) no more under the lanes: Docked, a column of its own beside them; On hover, a strip at the right edge that slides it out over the lanes and away again; Floating, a panel of its own moved by its tabs' row and resized by its corner, still inside the DAW's panel, so it hides with its room and goes with the browser's tab. The mode stands in its tabs' row, kept with the page (yue2.mixer.dockMode, the panel's place in yue2.mixer.dockXY); over the whole screen the lanes keep their height beside it. Console's tip and the guide say so. A suite section (pinned by default, on hover the strip at the edge, floating fixed in the panel, the mode kept). MISC/claude-arc/apply1967.py, docs_1967.py.

**Three second hands, seen in my window** (31.10.2026, before 1964–1967 were committed). 1964: a node with nothing made opened on its empty output when the output tab had been chosen (the DAW showed a line instead of its lanes); now it opens on its settings and the tab chosen stays for the next node; the two parts of the output are one column, as the tree's, also when the window opens straight on it (the alignment waited for nothing: the window was still hidden). 1966: a lane of 72 px has its name and buttons in a row of 26, and a right-click above or below them fell on the lane and opened nothing; the whole left part opens the menu now. 1967: the console's first mode said «Закреплённые», the take list's plural of «Pinned»; it is «Docked», in each language the word its guide already says, the knobs' hint goes under the tabs' row in a docked console, and on hover the console slid away no longer widens the window (2452 px of 1691: the page would scroll sideways). And the console stands beside the lanes, docked or on hover, only where they keep 1000 px (data-dock-room, measured with the panel): in the step list's column it took 883 of the panel's width and left the waves 50 px, which turned seven of the suite's DAW sections red; there it stands under the lanes as before, and its column is narrower (clamp(520px, 34vw, 900px), its strips scroll inside it). 1965's dw11 still asked for lanes of 64 px; 72 now. The suite's sections say each. MISC/claude-arc/edit1964b.py, edit1966b.py, edit1967b.py.

**The DAW edited as in an audio editor** (1968; Viktor 31.10.2026: «как в ocenaudio есть возможности мышкой браться за точку на треке и вести её вверх в пик или вниз в затухание, подобное продумай и здесь. Разрезка по сегментам, копирование, вырезание, передвигание… в общем как в аудио редакторе… По тому, как это всё сейчас работает, это красивая обёртка, а толку из неё мало»). A drag along a wave selects (it silenced before; 1564's Shift is no longer needed, Shift and a click now stretch the selection); its edges move; a drag inside moves what it holds, Ctrl a copy: the lane's own sound as a move (its place silent), a laid stretch by its own «to», a part of one cut out of it and laid as a copy. Ctrl+X cuts at once (the stretch silent there and kept to lay), Ctrl+V lays at the playhead and selects what it laid, Delete and «Silence it» trim a laid stretch over the stretch too (silenceRange: a move cut into pieces keeps its source silent), Ctrl+A selects the lane. The selection's right-click: Copy, Cut out, Lay at the playhead, Silence it, Fade in from silence, Fade out into silence, Louder and Quieter by 3 dB (the level's points over it, 10 ms to them from outside, the points inside moved with it), Split at its edges, Select the whole lane. The level's line (1535's «auto», after the fader) is drawn over every wave and taken there without «A»: pressed where it has no point and pulled, a point is made with its neighbours 30 px away, so a peak or a dip stays where it is drawn; a click on it makes none and plays from there; a point dragged, double-clicked back to 0 dB, right-clicked away. Ctrl+E splits the lane at the playhead (at a selection's edges), a double-click between splits takes the segment (on a laid stretch, the stretch), a right-click on a split joins it; the splits are the page's marks, kept with the working mix (its state on Forge and in the browser) and never sent in the mix, so the lab is untouched: the render already makes muted, auto and edits as the page plays them. At most 64 laid stretches and 64 splits a lane, said. The lane's menu: Split at the playhead, Select the whole lane; «Its silences and moves taken off» takes its splits too. The suite: ed64, ct42 and the first DAW section select and press Delete where they drew a silence; ed68 is the new one. MISC/claude-arc/apply1968.py, docs_1968.py. Its second hand, seen in my window: the DAW state line wrapped to a line of its own when it said much, so the lanes jumped 20 px under the hand (a drag meant for the selection took a lane grip); it keeps one line of its own width now (flex 1 1 220px, its whole text in its tip). And the wave is drawn as the level line makes it, laid stretches too: a fade seen thinning, a peak growing, as ocenaudio shows what it did. MISC/claude-arc/edit1968b.py. And in the DAW's node window «0» (its fit) opened node 10: the canvas's digits (1581) took the key first; with the DAW open they are the DAW's (edit1968c.py).

**The Refiner's nodes in FULL, as ComfyUI's** (1969; Viktor 30.10.2026: «ComfyUI-style nodes with all parameters on the node face… a click then shows only the input and output… `SIMPLE with Options Pop-Up` / `FULL in ComfyUI Style`… под „Всегда холстом“»). The Engine's Refiner card has a second pair under the two ways it opens (yue2.refinerNodes, simple by default). FULL: each step's own panel moved onto its node's face (the same element, so its fields, its run button and their handlers stay its own; a comment keeps its place in the list), its summary and its long words hidden there (they are its tip and the guide's), its choices in sight (1509); the node a group, not a button (a button holds no fields), 360 px wide (NODE_W follows the mode), as tall as its settings: the faces are put on before the heights are measured, so the columns stand as they need. A press or a click on a face's field neither drags nor opens; the node's tip on its head; a click on its name opens its window on its output alone (1964's tab, the panel left on the face). The DAW, Audio I/O and a clone keep their window; select()'s one step shown is overruled on the faces. SIMPLE or the list puts every panel home. Focus kept when the canvas is drawn anew. A suite section. MISC/claude-arc/apply1969.py, docs_1969.py. Seen in my window before its commit: a redraw of the canvas took the old faces out of the page with their panels, and $(id) found none (paint() then threw on their fields): the panels are kept by reference (FACE[id].el); a plugin step placed after a step on a face went into that face and was lost on the next redraw: it goes after the step's place in the list (its hold); Viktor's own node places, set in SIMPLE, stood FULL's wide nodes on one another: each mode keeps its own places (flowKey «:full», yue2.refinerCanvasPosFull), FULL laid out anew; FULL's world is twice the window's width, its tall nodes in more columns (⤢ shows it whole at 50 %); a face's window, its output alone, opens large. MISC/claude-arc/make1969.py writes the three files from the originals.

**Pianoteq, a step of the Studio's own** (1970; Viktor 30–31.10.2026: «Что с Pianoteq плагином и его интерфейсом?… И в DAW обязательно интеграция… в постпроцессинге этот Пианотек и нужен»; «По распространению Пианотек в паблик… подготовим для Plug-N-Play и дадим отдельный гайд по установке и активации… в оверлей не копируем их графику»). lab/builtin_steps/ruach/pianoteq.py, on a set of stems in Mend after the Ambient: the stem's MIDI the take's own when the MIDI step made one of it (orchestra.midi_set_of), else MuScriptor on the CPU (muscriptor.run, its cards hidden: a training may hold them); velocities from the stem before any shift (orchestra.velocities reads each note's own band), the touch, CC 64 held through each phrase (a gap of 0.6 s ends one), a piano's 88 keys; Pianoteq headless, at the stem's rate, level and length; a lane of its own in the DAW («track»: pianoteq, 1929's way) or the stem's version («source»). Fields: stem, 18 presets of the Stage instruments Viktor bought (Steinway D NY and HB, Bösendorfer 280VC, C. Bechstein DG, Classical Guitar), in the DAW, dynamics, touch, pedal, what it plays, transpose. Plug-N-Play: user/pianoteq.json, models/instruments/pianoteq*/, ~/pianoteq*, the PATH; nothing of Pianoteq shipped. Found on the way: a bought Pianoteq keeps its activation in ~/.config/Modartt/Pianoteq92.prefs; with a --prefs file of its own it rendered silence (−91 dB), which the level match raised +64 dB into a flat noise, and --no-prefs rewrote his file as it quit (its activation kept): the step plays with a copy of that file made for the render and deleted after (0600), and a render under −70 dB is refused («is it activated?»), never raised. The lab reads its steps at each asking: nothing restarted while a training runs. lab/test_pianoteq_step.py; a suite section. MISC/claude-arc/apply1970.py, docs_1970.py.

**A pause that ends only its own start** (1973; 31.10.2026: a run paused at 12:02:45 and resumed at 12:03:15 under the same unit name was ended at 12:03:45 by the pause's own late stop). stop()'s stop a minute after the SIGINT now ends only the start it paused, known by the unit's InvocationID; a run resumed within the minute goes on. gone() counts no save before the step a run began from when output/RUN/carried.json names a save carried in from another run, so the Trainer shows none of those as gone. lab/test_pause_carried.py: five checks, three of them red on the code before.

**Pianoteq's own window** (1977; Viktor 31.10.2026: «Сделай интеграцию Pianoteq даже лучше и удобнее, чем официальный их X11 GUI», and «У меня же Stage лицензия с четырьма пакетами инструментов. Всё активировано по моему серийнику?»). The lab (lab/pianoteq_live.py) drives the Pianoteq installed here through its own JSON-RPC server: a copy of the user's preferences in a folder of its own (0700, the copy 0600, the user's file never written), 127.0.0.1, a low priority. Measured before building on it: headless without an audio device Pianoteq takes no setting. setParameters read back but reached no preset file (volume set 0.95, the saved file 0.7273, the preset's own; getInfo «modified» stayed false), a preset loaded by RPC never read back (the guitar's parameters the Steinway's, 0 of 78 differing), A/B and undo did not carry them; a preset named at the start did (78 differ). So the server's copy names ALSA's default output (the «audio-setup» value, JUCE's DEVICESETUP) and the server alone gets an ALSA configuration (ALSA_CONFIG_PATH) whose default is ALSA's null sink and which defines nothing else, so no card of the machine can even be named (aplay under it: hw:0… unknown; a play to «default» silent); the server refuses to work unless getAudioDeviceInfo says «Default ALSA Output», running. Then «modified» turns true, a loaded preset reads back, the saved file keeps 0.95. The null sink paces nothing: an idle server spins 1.25 cores, so it stops 20 s after its last question (was 300), at nice 10; a cold start and a preset read take 2.0 s. The catalog (FORMAT 3, user/pianoteq-catalog.json, keyed by the program, its packs and Pianoteq's Addons folder) says for each preset whether it plays in full here (Pianoteq's own license_status) and what is activated (getActivationInfo's add-ons, status, error; never the name, the e-mail or the serial): here status 1, four add-ons, 194 of 889 presets in full (the packs bought, KIViR's historical pianos, Champagne, the bells and the other free ones), 695 demos. The page (heresy-pianoteq.js): the step's panel and node carry one line, the preset and how much is changed; nothing asks Pianoteq until it is pressed. It opens a window (1320 × 920 at most, sections in columns): the preset's button opens a browser by class and instrument with the words and a search (Enter takes the first), «Only what plays in full» ticked by default, the demos marked; the six small presets; every free parameter as a row in Pianoteq's words and units read from its scale («Off» stays a word), a switch a box, a choice a list, the eight microphones as a mixer strip each (on, level, pan); what differs from the preset amber, its section's count live, ↺ one by one or «All back to the preset»; A/B; ▶ Listen (chords, arpeggios, a dynamic ladder, the keyboard's range; not played by itself under a webdriver); «Keep in Pianoteq…» into the bank «Ruach Studio» (a test page's scope writes nothing); the edition's 92 locks listed with their values. Esc closes it unless meant for what is over it (the browser, the name's dialog). The state lives in the step's hidden «state» field (plugins.py's new «text» kind, 20 000 characters at most) and only when it says more than the step's own preset list: a preset of the list with nothing changed writes nothing, a preset off the list goes in the list too, a preset picked from the list starts the state over, a profile's state is drawn on the line. The step (pianoteq.py) makes the state a preset file (savePreset into the bank for a moment, copied out, deleted; Pianoteq's folder as it was) and renders with --fxp; a demo is said in its summary. Tests: lab/test_pianoteq_live.py on the real program (the engine on the silent device, each preset its own values, a quieter volume heard: 0.95 at −19.2 dB, 0.45 at −28.5 dB, the presets folder and the user's preferences untouched, the server's copy gone), test_pianoteq_step (the state field), test_plugins (the text kind), the suite's pt77 over a mocked /lab/pianoteq/. The guide's item 22 says the window in twelve languages, and its phone a VPN into one's home network (Viktor 31.10.2026: «хотите вот на мобилке пользоваться? Ставьте VPN, подключайтесь на свою внутреннюю сетку, и открывайте свой компьютер/сервер»).

**A plugin's MIDI, and the first plugin made by someone else** (1978; Viktor 01.11.2026: «чел участие принимает на …discussions/3. Ответь ему, глянь его плагин, и если толковое, внедряй. Пошла движуха»). manchuwook (GitHub Discussions #3, «Basic Pitch Plugin») wrote null-angel/ruach-basic-pitch-plugin (MIT, commit cc5472071e09): Spotify's Basic Pitch (Apache-2.0) on a set of stems, a .mid per stem with notes, pitch bends kept, report.csv; strictly typed, tested against a fake transcriber, its stems' paths kept inside their folder, one stem's failure never losing the others, the model loaded once a run. Read whole before anything ran; installed as its README says into user/plugins/ruach-basic-pitch with a venv of its own (the ONNX way: Python 3.12 has no wheel of Basic Pitch's TensorFlow; 594 MB). On a real eight-stem set (Синт-поп · №1, 2:25), run by hand into tmp/: 30 s on the CPU, 382 MB at most, 8 of 10 stems with notes (3736), the bass F#1–F#3 and the lead vocal B2–F#4 (10–90 %), the empty guitar and piano said silent, not failed; GET /lab/plugins lists it with no errors. The lab's plugins.result now marks a .mid or .midi as kind «midi» (the page already read the extension so since 1834: downloaded, not played, no source); test_plugins checks it (27). docs/PLUGINS.md: the MIDI rule, the «text» field of 1977 (it still said three kinds), and «Plugins made by others» with his as the first. Said to him: the two sums of an eight-stem set (vocals, instrumental) give the same notes again in a mixture (1136 on the instrumental), better left out by default; the Studio has its own sound-to-MIDI step (MuScriptor, 1834), so Basic Pitch is a light second opinion with a voice's bends.

**Basic Pitch, a plugin given to the Studio** (1979; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Берём его плагин в паблик репо как контрибуцию. Оформи всё правильно и напиши ему, что в следующем пуше опубликуем»). Steven Altsman's (manchuwook) plugin ships in extras/plugins/basic-pitch/ as his commit cc5472071e09 of null-angel/ruach-basic-pitch-plugin: 30 files, each byte for byte his (git blob hashes compared with his tree), his own CI workflow left out, his MIT LICENSE in the folder. Nothing of it runs until the user asks: extras/plugins/install.sh NAME (bash) copies the plugin into user/plugins/NAME with rsync (its .venv kept), makes it a venv of its own when it has none, and installs what it needs (Basic Pitch on Python 3.12 and newer by its ONNX Runtime way, as his README says; older ones his requirements.txt); a second run brings the files up to date and leaves the venv. The dev studio's install moved to user/plugins/basic-pitch through it; GET /lab/plugins lists it once, with no errors. Credited: README (Extras, Standing On, Licence), NOTICE (his MIT notice, and Basic Pitch's Apache 2.0, installed from PyPI and not shipped), extras/README.md and extras/plugins/README.md (a table of plugins made by others, where each comes from), docs/PLUGINS.md (shipped, installed on the user's word) and the CHANGELOG; the gitignore keeps a venv made inside extras/plugins out of git. The release commit of 2.0.5 carries «Co-authored-by: Steven Altsman <431161+manchuwook@users.noreply.github.com>», so GitHub counts him among the repository's contributors.

**Stricter terms for copies and forks** (1980; Viktor 31.10.2026, on the Windows port of rc5: «он наш брендинг убрал. Это уже нарушение лицензии? … Вот так понемногу и перекочёвывают открытые проекты в проприетарные», then «Да, с 2.0.5 ужесточаем условия форков»). Read first: vrazraz/Windows-Music-Lab keeps the AGPL, the author, the base commit and the date, and credits the Studio in its README and its UI's footer; renaming a fork is its right, and our name and logo (CC BY-NC-ND) are better not worn by one. Our rc5 page showed no Appropriate Legal Notices, so section 5(d) asked nothing of his interface. From 2.0.5: LICENSE-ADDITIONAL-TERMS.md (English, with a Russian translation for convenience) adds to the AGPL, for the parts whose copyright Viktor holds, the three kinds of term its section 7 permits: 7(b) the attribution «Based on Ruach Studio by Viktor Zhuromskyy · https://github.com/igrbible/Ruach_Studio · GNU AGPL v3 or later» kept in sight in every interactive interface's Appropriate Legal Notices (at least as visibly as Engine → About shows ours) and in the README, translatable, never removed, shortened or hidden; 7(c) a modified version not presented as the original or as endorsed, and marked as different (its own name, or a notice of who changed it and when); 7(e) no rights to «Ruach Studio», «Руах Студия» or the logo as another work's name or brand, a truthful statement of origin allowed. Earlier releases stay as they were released. Engine → About shows the Appropriate Legal Notices under its first line (© 2026 Viktor Zhuromskyy, free software under the GNU AGPL v3 or later with the additional terms of its section 7, LICENSE and the terms linked, no warranty), in twelve languages, so a fork's interface must show them too (section 5(d)). NOTICE says where the terms are; README's Licence says them in one sentence; the guide's About line in twelve languages; make-release copies the new file to the release's root (the release repository does not ignore it). Not legal advice: a reading of the licence's own text.

**Pianoteq's window, finished** (1981; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Pianoteq ты не закончил интерфейс, уверен. ???»). He was right, and it was said so. 1977's Effects showed only the three slots' switches though Stage lets 25 of their parameters be set: Pianoteq's slots carry generic ids (effect_N_param_1…8) whose meaning is the slot's effect, a delay in NY Steinway D Jazz (DelMix, DelTime, DelFb, DelTone, DelPol, DelPing), a parametric EQ in Bösendorfer VC Pop Mix (PEQ1F/G/Q/T, PEQ2…: 110 Hz, −1.0, 0.66, Low Shelve), an empty slot «Param 1…8»; the catalog had sampled them on one preset only, so its scales could not serve another. Now preset() names each slot's effect by its parameters' names and gives their scales in Pianoteq's words, sampled on the slot the first time an effect kind is met (all 21 points, the slot put back as it was) and kept in the catalog (effect_scales: delay, parametric EQ, none); the first preset took 18.9 s with the server's start, the next 2.3 s, a known one 0.3 s. preset() takes the small presets too (?small=JSON): the base the panel marks changes against is the preset as they leave it (Cathedral: the reverb 1.50 → 3.50 s), while «the preset's» in their lists stays the preset's own. keep() puts the kept preset in the catalog at once, so the browser finds it. The window: Effects by slot under «Effect N · Delay / Parametric EQ / No effect in this slot», the switch «On», a delay's Delay mix, Delay time, Feedback, Tone, Polarity, Ping-pong, an EQ's Band N · frequency (Hz), gain (dB), Q, type (a choice); a small preset picked asks Pianoteq again («Pianoteq loads it…»), A/B rebuilds its base too; «All back to the preset» returns to the preset's own base. Seen on the real Pianoteq in the light and the night themes, the browser too, and in the Refiner's list (the line under the step's fields). Tests: test_pianoteq_live (a delay and an EQ named, a band's type a choice, a small preset's reverb in the base), the suite's pt77 (a slot's heading, «Delay mix», an unused parameter hidden, the base asked again with the small preset). And 1981b, found by the live test the same night: `_settle` waited only while getInfo said «computing_parameter_update», which is false at once, so a preset file could be saved before the engine took the values; 1977's own test had passed on luck (volume 0.95 heard, 0.45 lost: both previews at −28.5 dB this time). Now a state is loaded step by step on Pianoteq's word: the preset when getInfo names it, a small preset when its kind names it, the values (only those that differ) when it says «modified»; never said in 5 s: an error, never a render of the bare preset. After it: 0.95 at −19.2 dB, the preset's own between, 0.45 at −40.5 dB, and the test checks both ways from the preset's own.

Tests: lab/test_weight_tiers.py (19 checks), the suite's wt84 on mocks (the rows, a tier past the free room, the questions, the body sent, the progress at its row), 1411 passed; in the live Engine all six tiers «all here» on the Forge, with 74.5 GB free.

**Pianoteq in the Engine** (1986; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Для Pianoteq добавь динамическую вкладку в Движок. Распиши что это и с чем его едят, как установить, зарегистрировать, обновлять, разные наборы на моём примере покупки и т.п. Всё в одном месте… Если есть в вижке пианотек дерегистрация, то и на неё кнопку, а вдруг»). Engine → Pianoteq, after the Refiner Room. Each time it opens the lab asks Pianoteq itself (pianoteq_live.status(): getInfo, getActivationInfo and getListOfPresets on its silent server, about 2 s cold): its program and version, activated or a demo, with its packs and Pianoteq's own message; how many presets play in full (194 of 889 here); what this edition lets one change (106 parameters, 94 kept, from the step window's catalog); its 67 instruments with what of each plays in full. Never the name, the e-mail or the computer's name it also knows. The serial: a masked field. activate() gives it through Pianoteq's own JSON-RPC «activate(serial, device_name)» on the user's own preferences (a server started without a copy, its engine on the null ALSA device so no card is touched), asks what it now is, then asks it to quit, as Pianoteq keeps its preferences when it quits; the preferences' audio setup is put back if Pianoteq rewrote it. The serial is in no command line, log or file, the field empties at once, and a refusal says Pianoteq's words without it; the catalog is marked stale, so the step's window reads what plays in full again. Deactivation: Pianoteq has none (its --help names only --activate, its RPC only activate and getActivationInfo), so no button. The tab says it is done in Modartt's user area, under Manage activations, with Modartt's FAQ warning that a computer deactivated there cannot be activated again with that serial. Seven how-tos folded under their names: what it is; editions and packs (Stage, Standard, Pro; the Studio's own Stage with Steinway D, Bösendorfer 280VC, C. Bechstein DG and the Classical Guitar as the example); install; activate (three computers a licence, again with the same serial after a pack is bought); update; deactivate; its licence (in your music yes, as a library of its sounds no, to teach a model no). Tests: lab/test_pianoteq_status.py on a Pianoteq of our own making (the refusals, the serial never in a command line, the audio setup kept, the catalog stale), the suite's pt86 on mocks; seen live in my Chrome: «Pianoteq 9.2.5 здесь активирован: Steinway D, Guitar, Bösendorfer, BechsteinDG», 67 instruments. Not tried with a real serial: the Pianoteq here is activated, and a serial is not mine to type; the first activation again after a pack is bought is its live test.

**The console's window as large as its strips; the open workspace's bar off the caret** (1987; Viktor 01.11.2026: «По окну микшера DAW убедись, что оно в авто ресайзе»; «В активном воркспейсе сдвинь полосу вправо на 2px и компенсируй -2px паддинга»). 1983's window opened at the docked console's size and stayed so. Now it is measured at its natural size (the dock at max-content) and the window sized to it, the screen's free room the limit, when it opens and whenever what it shows changes: a lane more or fewer, a VCA, a bus, the tab, the strip picked, the mixes kept. Between those, a size the hand gave it stays. A Picture-in-Picture window that may not be sized stays as it is. In the Librarian, the open workspace's row starts 2px further right (its ground and its amber bar off the caret beside it) and its padding is 2px less, so its words stand where they stood.

**A take's family tree** (1988; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Огромное упущение у нас в карточках треков - если трек модифицировался через Огранщика, пометок мало, нужно полное родословное дерево, и я предлагаю внедрить это в контекстное меню, плюс кнопочку ДРЕВА родителей и потомков, и в попапе выводить… подобное тому древу, что в Огранщике, с быстрым переходом на нужной дериватив или производный»). Two lines of descent were written down already, and the tree reads both. Between takes, a take made from another names it in its request.json «parent» (99 of the library's 3065: crops, trims, a section sung again…), and the Library's «regen» marks say a take made again with a new seed. Inside a take, what the Refiner made lives in its derived/, each version's manifest naming what it came from. lab/lineage.py indexes the takes' parents once (0.66 s over the library) and again only when outputs/ changes; tree() climbs to the oldest take still here and draws every take made from it beneath, what each is of its parent (its own word, the word its name ends with, an import, a regeneration), a parent gone said. GET /lineage?name=. A library row now says its parent; an import may name what it is a version of (?parent=&what=). The page: the take's menu «Family tree…» and a tree button on a card that has a family (a parent, a regeneration, a version made in the Refiner, a take made from it); a window over the room, the take asked lit, under each take its Refiner versions nested by what they came from, as the Refiner's own tree draws them (stems → the DAW's mix → the gateway → the remaster → …; «from the set» where a version took a whole set). ▶ plays a take of it, its name opens it, a version opens the Refiner on its take with that version found and lit; Esc, ✕ or a click around closes it. The VLA loop's 24 imports (31.10 and 01.11) named as versions of their originals, so «Госпел · №23» shows its three. Found on the way: the Refiner writes a version's time as «2026-10-24 19:28», read now as such (NaN before). Tests: lab/test_lineage.py (13), the suite's ln88; seen live on «Я – буратино», 23 versions in their chain.

**The playlist's crossfade cut out; the log's views in the rooms' order with the Writer; its chip 20px wider** (1990; Viktor 01.11.2026: «В плейлисте кроссфейд, с которым мы мучались, так и не работает. К хуям вырежь его. В логгере выставь правильную последовательность вкладок в соответствии с порядком комнат. И Писатель отсутствует здесь. Плашку лога сервера расширь на 20px»). The crossfade of 1713, 1722, 1727 and 1737 goes whole: the playlist's slider, the ⋈ on the strip, the second player that crossed the seam (92 lines of app.js). What 1737 also brought stays: the take playing and the next held in the page, so the next starts from the page without waiting on the line; the lab keeps its old seconds, which nothing reads. The log's views now follow the rooms: Server, Creator, Writer, Refiner, Artist, Videographer, Trainer, in the dock and in its window. The Writer is a view of its own: the lab says what its model does (writer_llm.SAY → act_say): starting on which card, ready in how long, each answer's time and tokens, a refusal, leaving its card and why. The log's chip is 148 × 32, «Лог сервера» whole in it. The guides' playlist without the crossfade, in twelve languages. The suite: its playlist section rewritten (no slider, no ⋈, no engine; the next take from the page from its start; Next at once), the views' order and the Writer's line, the chip's size.

**The family tree in the compare window's clothes, the way there and back** (1992; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Оформи его в том же стиле, что и модалка сравнения семплов. Здесь уже без ограничений по количеству, потому что может быть и три десятка дорожек. Клик по реальному дублю подтягивает его в библиотеке, но не закрывает модалку. Внутренние дорожки Огранщика помечаем как доступные в огранщике и спрашиваем, или пользователь хочет перейти в огранщик, с подтяжкой всего и открытием древа в Огранщике. Навигация у нас должна быть безупречно двусторонней и не терять человека у разбитого корыта»). heresy-lineage.js anew: the compare window's box, head and rows (its cmp classes), each row stepped in by its depth, every take and version the family has (a tree of thirty-one in the suite). A take's row: the dot that plays, ▶ (Pause on the take playing), its name, what it is of its parent, when, how long, its 👍 🔥 💎 👎 ★ (the cards' own handlers), and in a room other than the Librarian's a «Show in the Librarian». A take's name shows its card in the Librarian (elsewhere it opens the take) and the window stays, its row lit. A Refiner version is a dashed row with the Refiner's badge: from the Librarian or another room it asks first (what it is, what it came from, the way back), then opens the Refiner on its take with the made node's window open on the canvas and the version lit, and a toast says the way back; from the Refiner it goes at once. «Compare these (N)» hands the family's takes to the compare player (twelve there). The way back: 🌳 in the take's head (the Creator's, after «Show in the Librarian») and in the Refiner's head (after the DAW) opens the same window. Twenty-one new words in eleven languages (a take «семпл», «сэмпл»); the guides' bullet anew in twelve. Tried live on «Ночная гостья»'s MIDI version: the question, the Refiner on its take, the made node's window open, the version shown, the toast. The suite's family-tree section anew: the rows and their depths, the count and the ways said, the marks, the window kept, «Compare these», the question's no and yes, the Librarian from the Refiner, thirty takes, Esc.

**The canvas's looks and its outputs in two columns** (1993; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Статистические и финальные ноды без выходных проводов в авто организации канваса раздели на две колонки и выстрой выходные последней, а статистические предпоследней колонками»). Arrange puts MIDI, which ends a way with no wire going out of it, under «Made from This Take» in the last column; the looks at a file (spectrum, artifacts, lyrics, before and after, a plugin's look) keep the column before it. A canvas too narrow for seven columns no longer folds the outputs into the looks: the file mended before the split goes under the take instead. The suite's canvas section: MIDI under the made node, the looks one column before, nothing between.

**Your first node: the guide and an example to copy** (1994; Viktor 01.11.2026: «В руководство по плагинам допиши гайд для написания нод для Огранщика и смастери примерную ноду как пример для понимания юзером, что и как формируется. В лучших повадках таких схем. Чем лучше сделаем, тем больше будет контрибуций»). extras/plugins/example-node (CC0, to be copied): «Tilt and width», a finish (the tone tilted about a pivot by a zero-phase split that sums back sample for sample, the stereo wider or narrower by mid and side, as loud as it came, never over full scale, a page of what it did), and «Width meter», a look (width, correlation and balance in the lows, the mids and the highs: a page, a CSV and a summary), with check.py, which runs both exactly as the lab does on a sound it makes itself: nothing changed at the neutral settings, the tilt's direction and size, mono at width 0, held under full scale, the meter's files, an error said in words (seven checks, all passed on Forge). PLUGINS.md: «Your first node» (the card, the script, the check, your own), «How a node stands on the canvas» (the ports by input and group, the columns Arrange gives), «What a good node does» (nine rules). install.sh makes no environment for a plugin that names no python of its own.

**The Studio over https, the lab's side** (1985; Viktor 01.11.2026: «авторедирект с 7777 на 7443, модалка с предупреждением… По самоподписному корневому сертификату поддерживаю твою идею»). tls_door.py signs the door's certificate with the Studio's own certificate authority, made once (ten years); the certificate lives 825 days and is made anew 30 days before its end or when the machine's names change, the authority kept, so a browser that trusted it once never warns again. lab/https_door.py: the lab starts the door when nothing answers on its port (Pinokio and ./start.sh as under systemd; RUACH_TLS=0 keeps it off); GET /tls (the door, its port, its authority's fingerprint), GET /tls/ca.crt (the authority to trust), POST and GET /handoff (a page's settings, once, by a token that lives ten minutes, for the page that moves from http to https). test_https_door.py: sixteen checks. The page's side (the move, its question, Engine → Security) comes next.

**Before and after from any two sounds** (1991; Viktor 01.11.2026: «заказываю тебе ноду анализатора ДО и ПОСЛЕ… со спектрограммами, разницами в сравнительном наложении спектрограмм, замеры до и после, разница. Вердикт, что и как, и куда пошло… ей должно быть похер, откуда брать источники. Два аудио входа на ней»). lab/ab_compare.py: two recordings of one music found where they meet (the decimated mids cross-correlated within ±30 s, then sample-exact; the polarity; how alike), the after turned to the before's loudness, then each side's measures (loudness, true and sample peak, peak over loudness, range, crest, width, correlation, left over right, clipped runs, the quietest moments), the tone by sixth-octave and by zone, the dynamics (the loud moments against the middle ones, the sharpest 10 ms peaks), what no filter makes from the before (coherence by band), the spectrograms of both and their difference, a verdict in sentences. Before and after (1557) takes it as its second input, Before: what it was made from when nothing is chosen, else any file of the tree or another take; a file field may name its empty choice now (blank). Its pictures in 200 dpi, the measures a PNG, the spectrograms a JPEG, each with the tree's download. First used on the VLA: «Китайский фолк-фьюжн №8», «Госпел №23», «Рок-баллада №24», «Фолк-поп с бандурой №23» (an opto leveller: the loud moments 0.4–1.6 dB down against the middle ones, the range 0.8–1.4 LU narrower, the sharpest peaks passing; flat ±0.4 dB from 100 Hz to 16 kHz, 1–2 dB less below 40 Hz; 0.4 % THD, a −97 dBFS floor; its right side 0.74 dB hotter by the knobs). test_ab_compare.py: nine checks.

**The compare window's own tools** (1995; Viktor 01.11.2026: «К хуям убери из модалок "Ровная громкость". Для того оно и сравнение, чтобы услышать оригинальный звук… В модалке сравнения подключи контекстное меню… таймстемпа при наведении… временную линейку с рисочками… "Скрыть дизлайкнутые"… переделай на пальчик вниз… переключатель… держаться текущего таймстемпа или… с самого начала… при завершении… сразу переводи в ноль… базовые кнопки перемотки… текст… увеличь на 2 пункта»). «Equal loudness» gone: each version heard as it is, its loudness still on its row. A take's own menu on its row (a way out of the room closes the window). The second under the pointer over the wave; a ruler under it, a minute the tallest tick, then 30 s, 15 s and the seconds, those every 2, 3 or 5 s on a long take and none on an hour. 👎 for the disliked: lit shows them (the default), grey hides them, remembered. A switch beside the time keeps the second or starts the other version from its start; a version that ended starts the next from 0 whatever the switch. ⏪ ⏩ by the player's own step (Engine → Defaults). The strip's words 2 px larger. The suite: four sections brought over, one of its own.

**The trash: everything back where it stood, or wiped out; its emptying by itself in Engine** (1996; Viktor 01.11.2026: «добавь две функции на Корзину, в контекстное меню: очистить безвозвратно, восстановить ВСЁ с пересозданием оригинальных воркспейсов и из поддиректорий. В настройки пользовательские в движке добавь автоочистку корзины. Дефолтом - никогда. Варианты 7-14-30 дней»). A take going to the trash keeps where it stood (.places.json: its workspaces and sections); a take given back stands there again, the workspaces and sections it stood in made again when they are gone; POST /trash restore-all gives back the whole trash so. The trash's row in the workspaces' column has its own menu: everything back, or the trash wiped out for good (asked first; a protected take stays). Engine → Defaults → Library: the trash empties itself never, after 7, 14 or 30 days, the same choice as the Librarian's own (28, as it may have been set, reads as 30). test_trash_places.py: five checks.

**A step that ends a way** (1997). A plugin's step may say «final»: true (MIDI, a render to keep): its node stands in the canvas's last column with Made from This Take and MIDI, whatever its group. PLUGINS.md says it; Basic Pitch's To MIDI is such a node, and its author is asked to add the key upstream.

**The Librarian's places and the Refiner's nodes with the Studio's own outlines** (1998; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Для Корзин и Скрытые добавь иконки. В плейлисте и Избранное тоже замени те чёрные на наши SVG. Для "Все пространства" можно 📯… К нодам, как в Комфи, в строку с заголовкам… нашим SVG стилем, без циганского цветового табора»). Playlist, All Workspaces (a post horn of ours), Favourites, Pinned, Not in a workspace, Hidden, Trash and Trash (Art) each with an outline in its words' colour, amber on the place in hand; ▶ ★ 📌 out of their words. Each node of the canvas an outline before its name: the take a disc, the chain layers, debuzz a wave, upscale chevrons, the stems rows, the DAW sliders, the gateway a pulse, the remaster a gauge, the spectrum, the faults a scope, the lyrics a spell-check, MIDI a note, Made from This Take a folder; the Studio's own steps each its own (Whole lead an ear, the tamer a shield, Before and after two columns…), a plugin's by its group (mend an eraser, finish sparkles, look an eye).

**The Studio with a capital, the Law** (1999; Viktor 01.11.2026: «везде, где мы пишем "studio" и т.п. на других языках, условимся как Закон - пишем с заглавной, потому как это акроним к полному названию и нашему продукту как целой Студии»). Wherever the word is the product, it is the Studio. English: «the/this/our/your studio» (and «…studio's») became «… Studio» in the page's sources, the lab's words, the steps' cards, the suite's expectations, the dictionaries' keys, the guides, the site and the docs, one rule everywhere, so that a key and the string the page shows stay one string; a few more by hand where the product stood without «the» (a public Studio, a new Studio, the whole Studio). The eleven other languages: the noun of every dictionary value whose key names the Studio, and every noun of it in the translated guides and the site's languages (Студия, Студія, Студыя, Στούντιο, Estudio, Studio, Estúdio; de had it, ja and zh have no case). «LM Studio», «Studio One», an adjective (студийный) and «a studio» of any kind stay as they are. The kitchen is `heresy/MISC/claude-arc/cap1999.py` (a dry run, then `--apply`: 152 files), the suite's own expectations after it (`fix1999_suite.py`).

**The compare window's four more tools** (2000; Viktor 01.11.2026, of the four offered: «Берём все четыре»). Each version placed by its own sound against the first: `GET /lab/align` runs ab_compare's alignment over the first two minutes of the two files (kept by the files and their times) and says the lag, how alike the two are and the polarity; a version of the same music (likeness 0.6 and up) that lags 20 ms or more carries the lag on its row, and a switch keeps the music, not the clock (a print through gear comes back half a second late). The switch is lit and remembered; grey goes by the clock. An A–B loop dragged on the ruler, kept in the first version's clock so it stays on the music across a switch; a click on the ruler or Esc takes it off. Blind: the versions shuffled and named A, B, C…, all that tells them apart hidden, the digits and ↑ ↓ following the shown order, the names back when it is off. A moment marked (M): a word at this second goes into the take's note as a line «1:23 — the word», and a flag stands on the wave, its word under the pointer. Kitchen: `apply2000.py`, its suite `suite2000.py` and `fix2000_suite.py`.

**The Studio over https, the page's side** (1985; Viktor 01.11.2026: «авторедирект с 7777 на 7443, модалка с предупреждением, чреватыми последствиями при возврате на 7777… при отказе уведомляем, что не будет работать в сетапе с удалённой машиной Студии»). `heresy-https.js`: a page opened over plain http from another computer is offered the Studio's https door in a dialog of the Studio's own look and, after ten seconds, moves there by itself: `POST /lab/handoff` with the page's settings, and the https page takes them once by the token in its address's hash. «Stay on http» is remembered (`ruach.https.stay`) and says what a browser does not give such a page (MIDI devices, the console's own window, the clipboard); a page that moved says so on its http side (`ruach.https.moved`). Engine → Security has its own block: the door and its port, the Studio's authority to download (`/lab/tls/ca.crt`) with its SHA-256 fingerprint, how to trust it, and the asking switch. This computer and a test page (`?scope`) are never offered. Kitchen: `apply1985p.py`, `heresy-https-1985.js`, `gen_https1985_i18n.py` with `https-1985-i18n.json`, the suite `suite1985.py`.

**The DAW's lanes, a full kit** (1989; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Убирай уровень децибельный в консоль. На каждую дорожку слева… S/L/R/M переключение. Mute… Перетаскивание дорожек… Сдвиг всей дорожки по временному интервалу, ресет… полный инструментарий»). A lane's level is the console's fader alone (its own went). On each lane: **S L R M** (st, l, r, m: both sides as they are, the left or the right on both, the two summed, half each, on both), **Ø** (its polarity, the strip's invert of 1531), mute and solo as before, its colour (a click on its dot steps through ten, Alt+click its own by its name again), ▾ to fold it to its controls (26 px), its name dragged up or down to put it there; the whole lane shifted in time by **Alt+Shift+drag** on its wave (10 ms a step, 1 ms with Ctrl, ±30 s), its badge saying how far, × back to 0. The channel and the shift are the mix's: live, the channel rides on the width's four gains (the channel's matrix, then the width) and a shifted lane's chunk is asked from where its sound is at that second; the render (`daw_mix.lane_of`, `chan` and `offset_s` in a strip) does the same before the cuts and the copies, which stay in the song's time as drawn (a copied stretch heard from where the shifted lane holds it). The colour, the fold and the order are the page's (`yue2.mxLaneC`, `yue2.mxLaneF`, `yue2.mxLaneO` by the set). `lab/test_daw_lanes.py` (L, R, M, S, a shift either way, a cut after a shift, all three at once, the refusals); the suite clicks each tool. Kitchen: `apply1989.py`, `suite1989.py`.

**The evening's polish** (2001; Viktor 01.11.2026). The note's window («прикрути предохранитель, если нечаянно кликнул мимо по канвасу или X нажал, при изменённом тексте заметки»): any window of many lines asks before changed words go, a click beside it, Esc or Cancel showing «The text has changed: keep it, or let the changes go?» with Let the changes go, Back to the text and its own Keep; unchanged, it closes at once. The compare window's tips («на кнопочку синхронизации треков добавь тултип»): the window stands at 80 and the tips at 50, so none of its buttons ever said anything; a tip now stands one above the highest layer around its target, and the keep and align switches carry head lines (Keep the second, Sync by sound). One take's menu («раздел "Метки" с четырьмя нашими метками карточек — ненужное действо»): no Marks, its like, dislike, favourite and protect on its card; several checked keep them. The loading veil («динамической, прогрессирующей синусоидой как на осциллографе, в связке с цветовым прогрессом»): its line an oscilloscope's trace on a canvas, a sine whose phase runs and height breathes with a partial on it, over a faint graticule, dim ahead of the beam and lit in the Studio's colour behind it, brighter toward it; the line's own ten-second clock drives it; past twenty seconds it is lit whole and breathes. Kitchen: `apply2001.py`, `suite2001.py`, `fix2001.py` (the loading words 8 px higher over the taller line).

**The gateway's channel balance** (2002; Viktor 01.11.2026: «По балансам в Лампе нам нужно при начальном замере уровней петли спрашивать пользователя, или балансируем каналы именно в микро значениях, которые не удалось регистрами точно выставить в паритет, и не более, как опцию»). Audio I/O's loop test asks, when its two sides came back 0.05 to 1.5 dB apart (what one click of a knob cannot set; the VLA's sides came back 0.74 dB apart), whether to balance them on the way back; asked, a second tone at −36 dBFS (under the gear's knee, so its compression does not enter) measures each side's gain and the hotter side is lowered by the difference, never the quieter lifted into its noise. More than 1.5 dB apart is the knobs' work: said, nothing kept. The lab keeps it with the gateway (`user/audio.json`: `balance_db`, the level it was measured at, when; `POST /lab/audio/balance`; the same devices kept again keep it, others drop it); a plugin's analog passes put it on the return as soon as it is back, unless the level is by channels (that undoes the gear's L/R itself) or the step says `balance: off`, and say it. `lab/test_audio_balance.py`; the plugin's own `test_balance_2002.py`. Kitchen: `apply2002.py`.

**Peak clip taken out** (2007; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Я за то, чтобы резать пики в постпродакщн в посвящённой ноде, филигранно и правильно… И объяснение, почему мы не срезаем пики прямо при выхлопе из синтеза»; «все новые семплы проб гоним с нулевым клиппингом. Это моё решение, и оно правильное»; then, the measures read: «К хуям вырезаем это говно… убираем это говно из кода Студии. У нас есть огранщик вместо этого звукового эшафота»). The engine's Peak clip (`audio_normalize` in `src/audio-io.h`, the same file in the other ports of yue2.cpp's author) was neither a limiter nor a gate: the song raised until its 99.999th percentile of |sample| met full scale and the top 0.001 % cut flat, no look-ahead, no release (MAP's own pipeline only clamps to [-1, 1]). Measured on six takes made again at 0, the engine's own cut at 10 done on that same sound (`peakclip_sand.py`): 107 to 346 samples cut in 18 to 236 places, runs up to 0.9 ms, the song 0.8 to 3.4 dB louder for it; «Милости Твоей» cut deepest at 3:16.80 (+3.4 dB past the cut), where Viktor had heard a distant backing voice crushed. The dataset's narrating baritone is not clipped at its source (691 reads, none at full scale), only the most dynamic of the readers (crest 21 dB against 15 to 17), so the cut bit it longest. A first word put the field at 0 behind a lock; the second took it out: `audio_normalize` is peak normalization only (the highest sample at full scale, nothing cut), a request's `peak_clip` is read and ignored (on the Arc a request asking 10 comes back bit for bit as at 0), the page has no field (a take's or a file's own value is said to be gone when it opens; the output's help says every peak stays whole). Asked upstream to make 0 the default (yue2.cpp#23) and told YuE2's users (m-a-p/YuE2-3B, discussion 34). Kitchens: `heresy/MISC/claude-arc/sfz/apply2007.py` (the lock), `rework2007.py` (taken out), `suite2007b.py`, `docs2007b.py`.

**A WAV at the decoder's own level** (2008; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Вообще не режем пики при выходе из декодеров. Всё равно, каким бы то ни был экспорт сырца — это сырец… нам нужно 100% сырьё, с которым работать… на экспорт mp3 как самих по себе демок на быстрые прослушки, можешь нормализовать, но ни wav, ни flac, ничего в Студии мы не нормализуем, кроме как в Огранщике через наши ноды»; and of the one exception, «опустить весь трек ровно настолько, чтобы влез — амэн»). The engine no longer normalizes a WAV: 16 and 24 bits carry the decoder's own level, never raised; a peak past full scale, which their bits cannot hold, turns the whole song down just enough (`audio_fit` in `src/audio-io.h`, a gain, never a cut, said in the log). WAV 32 float stays raw as it always was; an MP3, a quick demo, alone is normalized to its peak; the player's listen.flac is made from the WAV, raw too. Measured first on the Arc, three takes as WAV 32 float (`raw_peaks.py`): the decoder's own peaks −0.70, −0.24 and +1.13 dBFS (4 samples past full scale) at −15.9 to −13.8 LUFS, so a 24-bit take now sits within 0.7 dB of where peak normalization put it, and «Милости Твоей» is turned down 1.13 dB to fit. MAP's `clamp(-1, 1)` would have cut those 4 samples; said on the model's page as a precision. His blind A/B that night (`blind_peaks.py`, six pairs, loudness matched) went to the uncut sound by ear: «звучит она богато, очень богато, реверб теперь настоящий без россыпи песочной в песочнице с прямыми краями». Kitchen: `heresy/MISC/claude-arc/sfz/engine2008.py`, `docs2008.py`.

**The audit of 02.11.2026, and what it found mended** (2011; Viktor 01.11.2026: «Готов в очередной раз сделать глубокую ревизию и аудит нашего кода Руах Студии? Можешь поручить это своему зеркалу в соседнем чате… Где не нужна моя рука, глаз и ухо, гони сам в лучших тонах»). The mirror session read 2.0.5 through, nothing touched, and wrote 22 findings with their places and failures (`heresy/MISC/claude-audit-2026-11-02/AUDIT.md`, and `P1-MAP.md` for the Library's lookups). Mended tonight, each with its proof:
- **S1, critical: a page of any website could drive the Studio.** Neither the engine nor the lab looked at Origin or Host; the lab answered every origin (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) and read a `text/plain` POST, which a page sends without asking, as JSON: it could read the takes, empty the trash, wipe the settings, restart the Studio, open it to every address. Now the engine's pre-routing and the lab's own port (`lab/origin_gate.py`) refuse a request a page of another site makes, as the browser itself says (`Sec-Fetch-Site` cross-site or same-site; from an old browser, an `Origin` that is not the address asked on a request that writes), except opening the page by a link (GET / as a navigation); and they answer only the names a site on the internet cannot point at this machine (DNS rebinding): an address written as one, localhost, a name of one label, a private suffix (.local, .lan, .home.arpa, .internal…, a Tailscale .ts.net), the machine's own name, and the names in `RUACH_HOSTS`; `RUACH_ALLOW_PUBLIC=1` answers any name. The lab's `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` is gone (the page reaches it at the engine's own origin). Scripts, DAWs and curl send neither header and pass as before.
- **S3, high: through the https door every visitor was this computer.** The door piped bytes, so the engine saw 127.0.0.1 for everyone: the API's token was never asked and Engine → Security's lockout guard saw no one. `lab/tls_door.py` now reads each request's head and adds `X-Ruach-Peer`, the visitor's own address (one the visitor sent is dropped), the body passing by its length or its chunks, an upgraded connection byte for byte; the engine takes it from a loopback caller alone (this computer can only make itself less trusted by it).
- **S2: Engine → Security took 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0**, opening the Studio, which has no password, to the internet without `RUACH_ALLOW_PUBLIC`. A listed network must lie whole inside one of 1114's private ranges, or the request is refused with why.
- **S4: protection and locks lived in the page alone.** A tab opened before a take was protected elsewhere deleted it for good. The engine's `/library/delete` reads `user/collection.json` by the lab's own rules: protected (1368), a lock of either kind on the take's workspace or a parent's (1473), a take in frozen workspaces only (1166); a file it cannot read refuses too. The page's own check looked at a lock on the tracks of the workspace itself alone, so the 💎 sets, locked as workspaces, went through to «Delete for good»: it keeps the lab's rule now.
- **S5: the chat relay** asks a chat server as a chat client does (POST to …/chat/completions, GET to the rest), says a redirect without following it, and judges an IPv4 address in IPv6 dress as the IPv4 it carries (Python 3.12.3 called `::ffff:a.b.c.d` private). **S6** (a planted hand-over) needs a token a page of another site can no longer get or post, after S1.
- **C1: one infinite sample from the decoder made a whole take silent** since 2007/2008 (the peak infinite, the gain 0). `audio_peak` looks at the samples that are numbers, makes an Inf or a NaN silent alone, and says how many.
- **C2** the ZIP export takes an MP3 or a FLAC take's song (an MP3 as made, a FLAC asked as WAV in 24 bits) and says a take with no song; **C3** a take's lyrics written through a `.part`; **C5** a Range past a file's end answered 416; **C6** the family tree sees a rename; **C7** two imports of one title in the same second land as `-01-` and `-02-`; **C8** a take made by Edit (crop, a section removed, arrange, speed) stands in its source's family tree; **C9** a settings save the lab refused is sent again; **C11** two cover changes within one second keep both covers; **C12** the compare window's ffmpeg and the Videographer's ffprobe have their timeouts.
- **P1** the Library's lookups by name through one Map (650 ms a paint of 3133 takes, 1 ms); **P2** with a library, the engine keeps the two newest finished results for a client that asks right after its job and lets an older one go once its every track is in the library (its `?result` answers 410 with the takes' names: up to 32 long songs, 2–4 GB, sat in memory for nobody); **P3** «sync by sound» reads the first 150 s of each version, the reference once for all of them.
Left for later: C4 (a chain taking a failed step for done when the page asks first), C10 (a Writer server adopted, not stopped, outside systemd), D1 (the playlist crossfade's dead state). Proof: `heresy/MISC/claude-audit-2026-11-02/check2011.sh` (29: the names, pages of other sites, public networks, a protected take, the door's visitor with keep-alive, a 30 MB body and a chunked one, C1), `check2011_s4b.sh` (6: a parent's lock, the section's tracks, frozen only), `check2011_c7.sh`, `check2011_p2.py` (three takes on the Arc), `test_c1.cpp`; `lab/test_origin_gate.py`, `lab/test_audit2011.py` (C2 C6 C8 P3 S5); the suite's «Delete for good: a take under a lock of either kind». Kitchen: `fix2011_engine.py`, `fix2011_engine_b.py`, `fix2011_engine_p2.py`, `fix2011_door.py`, `fix2011_lab.py`, `fix2011_lab_b.py`, `fix2011_page.py`, `fix2011_page_b.py`, `docs2011.py`, `stage2010_lab.py`, all in `heresy/MISC/claude-audit-2026-11-02/`.

**The Bank Builder: an SFZ bank from recordings, in the Trainer** (2031; Viktor 02.11.2026: «дудук уже проявляется в файнтюне, но мало. Шофара вообще не слышал без моего первого адаптера… когда обработаешь их Слушателем, с нотами и остальным как у нас заведено, можно из них две банки SFZ смастерить в Тренере, и проверим сразу и Тренера и дорожку SFZ DAW… Нужно отсеять все посторонние звуки… особенно в записях шофара»). The Trainer's head switches between **LoRA** and **SFZ banks**. `lab/bankbuilder.py`, four steps, each leaving its work in `datasets/banks/NAME/`: the material (a folder of datasets/raw/, a yt-dlp .info.json beside a file read for its title, uploader and licence); the clean (ten-minute pieces; for notes the winds split by UVR's 17_HP-Wind_Inst and a second kept where they stand 12 dB over the rest, pitched; for calls the recording measured as it is, since on the first sample the wind model put a shofar in «no woodwinds» 134 seconds of 143; BS-Roformer as a voice detector only, a voice on the instrument's own pitch counted as the instrument; Qwen2.5-Omni Q8 through llama-server on the same card asked yes or no about every ten seconds that could be kept: a wind instrument, a human voice, drums, strings or keys, a crowd or noise, where an open question had called a duduk «synthetic singing»; a fast YIN in numpy, 2048 frames a block, on the half window's autocorrelation, a whole frame's having bent every pitch 4 % up); the notes (a run within 0.6 semitone of its median, 0.35 s or more, legato taken and cut after its glide; its cents, vibrato, level against its file, the drone under it and its tail; a duduk's range E3–E5, so a dam under a melody two octaves up does not pass for a low note; the shofar's calls told by their shape: tekiah, shevarim, teruah, tekiah gedolah); the bank (the best by length, dryness, attack and steadiness, or the Trainer's picks; 48 kHz 24-bit FLAC tuned by `tune`, looped with `loop_crossfade` where a steady part matches at 0.9 or better; velocity layers only where a key's takes differ by 6 dB or more; round robins; `banks/NAME/NAME.sfz`, for calls the keys C3, D3, E3, F3 and a second .sfz of the tekiah at its own pitch; bank.json with every sample's source and place, the range and the licence, private unless every source says it may ship). The lab: `GET /banks/builder`, `/banks/builder/work`, `/strip`, `/key`, `/snippet`, `POST /banks/builder/start` (the clean on a card of the lab's jobs, 16 GB, its own process outside the heavy turn; no card: 409, and the page offers the processor: on Viktor's «Roformer сади на CPU», workers of 12 threads on three quarters of the cores sharing the files by claims, the voice detector on the seconds that could be kept only, put end to end; a recording past an hour heard in six pieces spread through it, the rest of its seconds said as skipped) and `/stop`. The shelf skips a bank made again (`.NAME.date.old`) and carries a user bank's range; the Layer's drone moves by octaves into a bank's range. The page: `heresy-bankbuilder.js` (a strip a file, a second a column; the keys with their notes heard and picked; the bank's card), 100 units in eleven languages. `lab/test_bankbuilder.py` (YIN, the notes, a droned note refused, layers, loops, the shelf, sfizz between two keys, the four calls cut from the recording itself) and the suite's «The Trainer's SFZ banks». The first trial, on a half-gigabyte sample and the processor: a solo excerpt gave 27 clean seconds of 179 and a first bank A#3–C4; the meditation and orchestral recordings next to nothing (a bed under every note). Kitchen: `heresy/MISC/claude-arc/dsx/`.

**Organteq and Airteq beside Pianoteq** (2036; Viktor 03.11.2026: «Перед этим ожидаю от тебя полноценный интерфейс для Пианотек, эиртек и органтек… ___teq модули должны быть в полнейшей интеграции»; Modartt, the same day: «You are welcome to make use of our free trial versions»). Modartt's other two speak Pianoteq's tongue: the same command line and the same JSON-RPC (read from their trials on 04.11: Organteq 2.1.2, Airteq 1.0.2). The lab's Pianoteq module (1977) became the product's own: its name, its program, its preferences' copy, its folders and its words come from `NAME` and `SLUG`, and `lab/modartt.py` loads it once more for Organteq and once for Airteq, each with its own server and catalog (`user/<slug>-catalog.json`). The `/pianoteq/` routes take `?product=` (a POST's `product`); without it they are Pianoteq's as before. Two new Refiner steps after Pianoteq, the same script (`organteq.py`, `airteq.py` set `PRODUCT`): Organteq plays a stem on a pipe organ's manual (C2–C7, notes beyond it moved by octaves, no pedal), Airteq on Modartt's air-driven instruments (flutes, reeds, horns, bowed and blown pads, drones; the winds stem first); each step's twelve or thirteen presets, and its window (1977's, its words Pianoteq's with the name put in) opens every one: Organteq's 56, Airteq's 176. Engine → Pianoteq chooses which of the three it speaks of (kept). Two things the trials taught: Organteq's engine says «started» a moment before «running», so the silent device's check waits for «running»; and an organ has 559 parameters (Airteq 83), so sampling each one's scale on its own never ended (4 minutes at 744 % CPU): for the two, each sample is set on all of them at once and read back in one call (Organteq's catalog in 101 s, Airteq's in 17.5 s, then kept). Pianoteq's own way is unchanged and its tests pass. Kitchens: `dsx/fix2036.py`, `fix2036b.py`, `fix2036c.py`, `fix2036d.py`. The suite caught one slip before it reached anyone: after «Keep in …» the window set its catalogs to null and the next one threw, its message in place of «Kept» (`fix2036e.py`). The guide (twelve languages): the Refiner's steps 23 Organteq and 24 Airteq, a chapter «Pianoteq, Organteq and Airteq» at the Refiner's end (what they are, how to install, activate and update them, the instrument's window, their licence) and Engine → Pianoteq's three (`dsx/guide2036.py`).

**+dB and the peaks over the old cut, in the player and the compare window** (2037; Viktor 03.11.2026: «За тобой ещё в плеерах пометки пиков за границей удалённого нами позавчера говносреза… и кнопочка на всех плеерных инстансах для увеличения dB на 1-3.4dB ради восстановления громкости по усреднённому максимуму.
