**The Reader, its first room: the spoken word, on a private engine of the Pro tier, kept home until it is turnkey** (2241; Viktor 07.11.2026: «До ума доводи нашу TTS комнату. Дизайн в соответствие с идеологией всей Студии»; his decisions of 06–07.11 on the two blind rounds and the ten-voice probe). A room of the spoken word beside the Videographer, in the Studio's own manner (its pickers open over the page or stand as rows, never a native select; its knobs and fields each with a tip and their limits; its log a view of the dock's own; under 1500 px its tab is a microphone, the bold word app.js reserves beside a room's name dropped with its word, and under 1150 px the room is a row of ☰ More, so the bar keeps one row at 1100 px). A long text read in one steady voice: a narration cut by sentence (sentences gathered to about two hundred characters a piece, a blank line a longer pause) or by verse (a line a piece, its verse number, its address and Strong's numbers not read), the first piece that lasts 2.5 s becoming the reference of every piece after it, so the voice holds through a chapter. Or a dialog written «Name: words», a voice for each speaker (a name of up to four words, never starting in lower case, so a sentence with a colon is not a speaker; a line without a name goes on the turn before it; lines before the first name are the narrator's). Inline tags are read by default in a dialog and taken out of a narration (his marks: plain is a clean book reading, tags make a dialog live); the palette is the engine's own list (emotion, pace and pitch, pauses, style, sounds): a sentence's tag goes to its sentence's start, a sound to the cursor with its word, and the tags are then read. Voices: the Studio's own are timbre groups by gender and register, each read by its centre voice (the one nearest the group's mean pitch and brightness), never a person; made-up voices (an engine's take with no reference); and one's own, uploaded only under a big red warning (cloning someone's voice without their consent is a crime in many countries, and the responsibility is the user's alone) and on the ticked word of consent, which the lab refuses without and keeps beside the clip. Gender and pitch come from pYIN, never a bare autocorrelation. Measured again, the probe's thirteen made-up voices keep their genders (its second man at 96.9 Hz), and the probe's «second voice a woman» was the reading itself: two of his three turns came out at 246 Hz. So each piece's pitch is measured as it is read, and a piece that crossed the line of gender (a man's voice above 190 Hz and 1.7 times itself, a woman's under 140 Hz) is read again with another seed, twice at most. The lab: `lab/reader.py` (GET /reader/engines, voices, cards, runs, file, voice-file; POST say, stop, voice, voice-remove, unload) runs each reading as a job of the lab's table (`reader:RUN`: its bar in the strip above the player, «the Reader» in the log), in the heavy turn as every heavy job, on the card chosen through Engine → GPUs: Auto (the cards given to the lab's jobs, as the guard picks), one of them, an Intel card (where it waits for the Studio's song and asks the engine to let the card go), or the processor. `lab/reader_worker.py` keeps the engine loaded in the engine's own Python between the pieces, and on a CUDA card 150 s after a run. Engines come from a registry: `lab/reader_engines/ID/` (the Studio's own, none yet: an open engine plugs in there) and `user/reader/engines/ID/` (one's own, linked there), each an engine.json (a Python for each device, its memory, its languages, its tag list) and a module of three functions (load, reference, say). The Pro engine is private, outside every release: its code in heresy/MISC, its name in the private-names lock. Every take the Reader makes is marked never for training (`lab/no_train.py`): its meta and its request carry `no_train` and its provenance, its WAV's own comment tag says it (a copy of the file still does: ffmpeg keeps the tag through a conversion), the Library calls it «narrated», the Trainer's preparation refuses a raw folder holding such a file and names it, and the dataset kitchens leave it out (the 💎 guard, and any selection naming a Studio take). The take lands in the Library at 48 kHz 24-bit like an import, one gain for its speech at −20 dBFS and never a clipped peak, its text and its settings in its note, filed into the workspace in hand. Kept home until Viktor calls it turnkey (his word of 06.11: «Чтеца… не пускаем в релизы, пока не будет готов под ключ»): make-release leaves `lab/reader*.py` and the page's `heresy-reader*.js` out as it leaves `lab/starter.py`, build.sh drops a module that index.html names and the tree lacks, and check-no-pro.sh ⑤ stops a tree that carries them. The room brings its own tab, view, view of the log and style (`window.RuachRooms`, read by app.js's room switch and its log), so the page without it is whole; its words by stable ids in thirteen languages (the page's twelve and Hebrew) in a catalog of its own, a word or two the shared catalogs translate keeping their translation, a sentence always its own (the shared patterns gave the red warning back half English). The first runs on GPU2 (an RTX 3090; the model in BF16, its codec in FP32), through the live lab: John 1:1–5 as a narration in the low male group, 20.3 s of speech read in 43 s with the model's load (31.7 s of generation, its two pieces at 87 and 81 Hz); a dialog of four turns with tags, a man and a woman of the middle groups, 12.2 s in 21 s (him at 148 and 134 Hz, her at 297 and 188), no piece read again; asked, the worker let the card go. The page suite 1839 passed, 0 failed, 7 skipped; check-i18n 19 passed. The suite: thirteen checks in a kitchen file (`tools/claude-suite-reader.mjs`), run by a hook before «page health» that a release, carrying no such file, passes over; the checks that count the Studio's own rooms and log views leave a module's out; `lab/test_reader.py` (a whole run on the processor through the real worker with a made-up engine) and `lab/test_no_train.py`.

**The Reader's open engine: Fish Audio Drama 3, kept home with the room** (2255; Viktor 08.11.2026, after the blind round of rivals, Drama 3 17 likes and none against: «Отлично, гони Драму в комнату. Амэн»). `lab/reader_engines/drama3/` holds the manifest and the module that starts SGLang-Omni in its own Python (`.venv-sglomni`) on one CUDA card as the rivals' probe found it workable on a 3090: the int4 W4A16 build (20.8 GB) on the card alone at a 0.92 memory fraction, no CUDA graphs, one request at a time, 1400 frames at most (about 65 s a piece), the reference encoder and the vocoder on the processor in FP32, its codec from the int4 folder rather than the Hub. The server is the worker's child, so the lab letting the worker go takes it along. Its request takes neither a seed nor instructions (SGLang-Omni's Drama 3 lowering refuses both), so the manifest says `"seed": false` and its style is a free-form bracket. Its tags are free-form brackets too (`"form": "bare"`, the palette inserts `[sad]`, not `[emotion:sad]`). The room shows its licence under the engine (Fish Audio Community License v1.0, «Built with Fish Audio», the terms in its tip) and its first-run word: a card of 24 GB or more, the first reading compiling its kernels about 20 minutes once. A NOTICE in its folder carries the licence's attribution. make-release leaves `lab/reader_engines/` out and check-no-pro stops a tree carrying it.

**Stresses before the engine reads: his marks, the user's dictionary, Zaliznyak** (2256; Viktor 08.11.2026: «По ударениям как минимум для русского предлагаю взять парадигму Зализняка… пользовательский словарь, редактируемый прямо в комнате, и делающий точечный оверрайд записей Зализняка»; his ear on the blind round: «стукАють», «наспівувАв», «бармАшина»). `lab/reader_stress.py`: a word the author marked (U+0301, or ё in Russian and Belarusian) stays as written; then the user's dictionary of that language (`user/reader/dicts/LANG.json`, word to its stressed or respelled form, a `+` before the vowel taken as the acute); then, for Russian, Zaliznyak's full accented paradigm (86,839 headwords, private, in `models/reader/dicts/ru/zaliznyak/`), indexed once into `forms.sqlite` beside it (every form under its key, the secondary stress dropped, ё found from е, a hyphened word found whole). A form the paradigm stresses two ways is a homograph: left to its context and named to the user, never guessed. A word of one vowel gets no mark. While the index is not open the report says so (a silent «nothing found» would lie). The probe's texts had carried no marks, so the engines guessed; both tokenizers keep U+0301 as its own token (their NFC normalizer leaves it), and whether each engine heeds an acute, a `+` or neither is left to the GPU smoke (`MISC/claude-arc/reader/smoke/`). Each manifest says how its engine takes the mark (`"stress": "acute" | "plus" | "none"`). Ukrainian has no Zaliznyak here; lang-uk's ukrainian-word-stress (MIT, a dictionary trie) is the candidate, not installed. The room has a Language field (Auto by the letters), Put the stresses in, Check stresses (the counts, each homograph's forms put into the next place after the cursor in the word's case) and the Stress dictionary of the language in use. Each engine's style goes before each piece in its own form where it has one: a free-form bracket for Drama 3, its own sentence tags for the private engine. Neither has a system prompt.

**A finished take fixed piece by piece** (2257; Viktor 08.11.2026: «правка ударения прямо из дубля, чтобы не регенерить снова полный, и как в Творце наш редактор ахуйный, подобное сделай и в Чтеце»). Fix on a finished take opens its editor: the pieces with ▶ each (the take played from the piece's place), a piece picked, its words as buttons, a word's vowels as buttons (the one pressed takes the acute and, when asked, goes into the dictionary), Read this piece again. Only that piece is read, in the take's voice (its cast voice, or the run's anchor piece as its reference) and style, through the same stress pass, with a new seed where the engine takes one. Its versions are kept (`piece-NNN.vK.wav`), the new one brought to the old one's level, and the take is joined anew from the versions chosen: each piece's edges faded 12 ms into its silence, the take's own gain kept from its first joining so every untouched piece stays bit for bit. The Library's take is rewritten in place, still never for training. The history holds every step; Undo takes back the last, and a piece's versions can be picked. A word or a sentence inside a longer piece is fixed by reading that piece, about a sentence (no word timings to cut finer). `lab/test_reader_stress.py` and `lab/test_reader_fix.py` run without a card; the page suite's `claude-suite-reader-fix.mjs` checks the room's new hands against a stub.

**The clip's film: halation and a gentle weave beside the grain and the vignette** (2242; Viktor 08.11.2026: «В видеографе по незакрытым и по идеям, что возникнут у тебя по ходу, гони без моего одобрения»; the note of 02.11.2026, «Видеограф против DaVinci Resolve», §2 item 4). The Look window's film gets two sliders after Grain and Vignette, each 0–100 % and kept a take its own in the browser beside them: **Halation**, the red glow film lays round its brightest lights (the highlights above 72 % lifted out, blurred by 0.6–1.8 % of the frame's height, turned red-orange and screened back over at 25–85 %), and **Jitter**, the gate's gentle weave (the frame drifting up to 0.45 % of its height on two slow sines a side with a breath of tremor, cropped and scaled back to the clip's size). `luts.film_vf` lays them in the order weave, glow, lens, grain, after the look and under the words; sent with the clip only when set, as the grain and the vignette are. Measured: a white square on dark grey through Halation at 100 % comes out with a red rim beside it (red over green and blue), the frame its own size; the order holds in the graph.

**The passes between shots: through white, a push, a zoom; at every cut, or a shot's own** (2243; the note's §2 item 6). «Between sections» gets three more ways beside a cut, through black, a flash and a dissolve: through white, a push (the next shot sliding the last one out) and a zoom, all three laid over the last half second of the shot before as the dissolve is (ffmpeg's xfade: fadewhite, slideleft, zoomin). A new picker beside it, «Where the passes fall», lays the way where a section of the song changes (as before, the default) or at every cut; and each shot's card but the first has its own «The pass into this shot» (the clip's, or any of the seven, a cut too), kept with the plan as the shot's `into`. The lab decides each cut by `videographer.into()` (the shot's own first, else the clip's), so through black and the flash may now fall at any cut as well; a laid-over pass needs both shots longer than itself, else it is a cut, as the dissolve was.

**The output presets: YouTube 4K and Telegram beside the shapes, and the crop by the subject** (2244; the note's §2 item 8). «The clip's shape» gets YouTube 4K (3840 × 2160, its last pass at CRF 18, the sound at 256 kbps) and Telegram 720p (1280 × 720, CRF 26, 128 kbps, a lighter file), each a clip of its own beside the others (`NAME.clip-4k.mp4`, `NAME.clip-tg.mp4`); Shorts and Reels are the tall 9:16, said so in its tip. A new picker, «The crop», says how a picture is cut to a narrower shape: as set (each shot's own focus, as it was), the middle, or the subject: where no focus was set by hand, the picture's columns are weighed by their edges and by how far they stand from its mean brightness, and the crop is centred on their weight (Pillow alone, on a 256 px copy; a shot's own video by its first frame). Measured: a light figure at the right of a dark 16:9 picture (its middle at 0.79 of the width) is found at 0.79 and the tall crop moves to 0.93 of its way to the right; a flat picture stays in the middle.

**A quick draft before the full clip** (2245; the note's §2 item 9). «Quick draft» beside «Clip» (pressed, kept in the browser) makes the clip at a third of its size each way (640 × 360 for the wide one, 360 × 640 for the tall), ffmpeg's ultrafast at CRF 30 with the sound at 96 kbps, as a file of its own (`NAME.clip.draft.mp4`, the full clip never overwritten), and the player and the download show the draft while it is pressed (`/video/clip?draft=1`, `/video/clip.mp4?draft=1`; its own job). Everything else as in the full clip: the cut, the passes, the look, the film, the words, the titles.

**Title templates: in the middle, a lower third, in the corner, with the author and the verse** (2246; the note's §2 item 7). «The idea and the look» gets two fields beside the title shown and the credits, **Author** and **Verse** (the verse's address, as John 1:5), kept with the plan; they go in a smaller line under the title, «author · verse». A picker beside «Titles on the clip» chooses where the title stands: in the middle (as it was; the same line as before when neither field is filled), a lower third (on a dark band at the left of the foot, from 1 s to 8 s, its line under it smaller), or small in the top corner over the first 6 s. The credits stay over the last seconds in all three.

How the batch was proven: `lab/test_finish.py` renders 16 s on the processor from the two pictures an earlier plan painted (20261028-200830-1-a.frames, no new painting, no GPU): a draft with a push at every cut, a lower third, grain, halation and jitter, 640 × 360 and 16 s in 7.0 s; Telegram with white passes, 1280 × 720 in 9.7 s (the lower third shows at the foot's left against it); the tall clip by the subject as a draft, 360 × 640 in 3.1 s; YouTube 4K with a dissolve, 3840 × 2160 and 16 s in 49.7 s; unknown ways, shapes, crops and templates refused. The three small clips are kept in heresy/MISC/claude-arc/video-2242/ to be seen. test_titles, test_dissolve, test_luts and test_videographer pass (one of its words changed: «between the shots»). The page suite 1842 passed, 0 failed, 7 skipped (1839 before, and three new); three new checks (the pickers and «Quick draft» at their plain values, the plan's author and verse in their fields, a shot's own pass on its card; all of them kept, the draft's own file asked and everything sent with the clip, halation and jitter with the look; a shot's pass and the verse saved with the plan), and the checks of the shapes, the ways between and the film's sliders count the new ones; and the debug check of the page's memory takes one event or more (the page notes its memory once a minute on its own, and the batch's new section moved that tick into its window: two events, both sound). check-i18n 19 passed; the words by their English keys in the eleven catalogs (32 new).

**Cuts on the bar where the song's section changes** (2247; Viktor 08.11.2026: «В видеографе по незакрытым и по идеям, что возникнут у тебя по ходу, гони без моего одобрения»; the note of 02.11.2026, «Видеограф против DaVinci Resolve», §2 item 5). «Cuts on the beat» first puts each cut where the section changes (verse to chorus and the like) on a bar line, then the other cuts on the heard beats as before (1947), never pulling a cut already on its bar. The bar grid is the DAW's: `dawproject.tempo_meter` reads the score's Q: and M: (or the style's bpm) from the take's request, bars from 0 s, as the DAWproject and the Reaper export lay them, so a cut in the clip and a bar line in the DAW fall together. It is used only while the take keeps that tempo (the heard tempo within 4 % of the bpm, its half or its double); else the bars are counted on the heard beats, every bar's worth of beats from the phase whose beats sound strongest. A cut moves at most half a bar (2 s at most) and never leaves a shot under 1.5 s; the times as sung are kept, and «Cuts as sung» undoes both. The page says how many of the section changes went on the bar and on which grid. Measured: a 120 bpm click with a 4/4 score, the change at 6.3 s moved to the bar at 6.0 s on the DAW's grid; a 90 bpm score against 120 heard falls back to the heard bars.

**Karaoke: each word lit as it is sung** (2248; the note's §2 item 1). A picker beside «Lyrics on the clip» shows the sung lines whole (as before) or word by word: the line stands whole and each word turns warm gold as it is sung (ASS `\k`, the gold primary and white still to sing), from the take's Whisper timing, each word at its own time where Whisper heard it and the rest sharing the time between their neighbours (`timing._word_times`, the same as the LRC words). The lead-in before the first word is its own beat, so the line fades in white and lights on the word. The clip's answer says how many words had Whisper's own time.

**The colour match: pictures painted apart become one film** (2249; the note's §2 item 2). A picker beside the crop matches every picture's colours to the picture of the shot in hand (the shot chosen when the clip is made): each picture's mean and spread in red, green and blue moved towards the reference's at 80 % of the way, the spread's change held between 0.6 and 1.6 so no channel tears; a still graded in Pillow before its move, a shot's own video by ffmpeg's lutrgb from its thumbnail's palette; the reference itself untouched, a card of words never graded. Measured on the painted pictures of an earlier plan and a cover painted for another take: the pictures' mean colours stood 11.2 apart (RGB, from their common mean) and 2.2 after the match; a cold blue picture matched to a warm one comes out within 12 of the warm one's means.

**Primary correction before the look** (2250; the note's §2 item 3; Resolve's primaries). The Look window gets five sliders after the film, each −100…100 and 0 as painted, kept a take its own in the browser beside the look and the film: **Lift** (the blacks, ±0.15), **Gamma** (the middle tones, ×2 or ½), **Gain** (the whites, ×1.5 or ⅔, the blacks held), **Contrast** (round the middle grey, ×1.6 or ⅝) and **Saturation** (from grey to twice). `luts.primary_vf` lays them as ffmpeg's lutrgb and eq before the LUT, so the look grades a corrected picture as a colourist's node tree does; the button reads «Look + correction» while any is set. Measured on a middle grey: gamma +100 lifts it from 128 to 180, lift −100 lowers it to 108.

**The crop by the subject, up and down too** (2251; batch A's idea). «crop: the subject» (2244) found where across a picture its subject stands; it now finds where down it too, for a picture cut at the top and the foot (a 3:2 picture in the wide clip, a nearly square one in a square crop): the rows weighed as the columns are, and the crop placed so the subject stands at 42 % of the frame's height from the top, room above a face. A shot's own video is cropped the same way from its thumbnail. Measured: a figure high in a 3:2 picture found at the top fifth, the crop moved up to keep it.

**4K made at 1080p and scaled up after the look** (2252; batch A's idea). YouTube 4K no longer moves every picture at 3840 × 2160: the shots are moved, joined, corrected, graded and filmed at 1920 × 1080, then scaled to 4K with Lanczos, and the lyrics and the titles are burnt in at 4K over the scaled picture, sharp. The old way stays in the lab (`native=True`). Measured on 16 s of painted pictures with a dissolve and karaoke, the processor alone: 31.2 s scaled against 57.3 s made whole (×1.8, not the ×4 hoped: the 4K encode of the last pass, the same in both, is most of what is left), 17.1 MB against 23.7 MB.

How the batch was proven: `lab/test_batchb.py`, 23 checks: the bars on a synthetic grid and on a 120 bpm click, the karaoke's ASS, the colour match, the primaries through ffmpeg on a grey, the subject down a picture, and renders of 16 s on the processor from the pictures an earlier plan painted (no new painting, no GPU): a draft with karaoke, the match and the primaries, 640 × 360 in 3.3 s (kept in heresy/MISC/claude-arc/video-2247/), and 4K both ways. test_beats, test_finish, test_videographer, test_titles, test_luts and test_dissolve pass. The page suite 1850 passed, 1 failed (the debug check of the lease, a timer missed under a load of 33 on the processor; a Videographer check never), 7 skipped; three new checks (the two pickers plain at first and the bars said after «Cuts on the beat»; the Look window's five primaries and «Look + correction»; word by word, the match to the second shot and the primaries kept and sent with the clip). check-i18n 19 passed; 21 new words by their English keys in the eleven catalogs («Gain» kept as the catalogs had it).

**The Studio and its lab answer addresses of local networks, never a name for how it looks** (2258; Viktor 08.11.2026, the wave-2 question whether names of one label, .local, .lan and .ts.net stay trusted: «НЕТ. Только по IP локальных сетей.»). Since 2011 the engine (`yue-server.cpp` host_trusted) and the lab's own port (`lab/origin_gate.py`) answered a name that looked private: one label, a private suffix (.local, .lan, .home, .home.arpa, .internal, .intranet, .localdomain, .corp, .private, .test, a Tailscale .ts.net) or this machine's own name. Every one of them is the network's to resolve, and whoever answers for it there can point it at this machine or another. Now a Host is answered when it is an address of a local network written as one, the networks the Studio admits its callers from (is_private_addr, 1114: 127/8, 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 169.254/16, 100.64/10 where Tailscale lives, ::1, fc00::/7, fe80::/10, IPv4 in IPv6 dress; read as inet_ntop writes it, so `[::ffff:7f00:1]` is 127.0.0.1 and a zone such as `%25eth0` is left aside); when it is `localhost`, this machine by definition and never asked of the network; or when RUACH_HOSTS names it (a name, `.example.org` with its subdomains, or an address beyond the local networks). Any other address (8.8.8.8, 0.0.0.0, a global IPv6) is refused unless named there; RUACH_ALLOW_PUBLIC=1 answers any name, as before; a request with no Host passes as before (no browser sends one). INSTALL.md's 403 row and docs/API.md say the same. How proven: `lab/test_origin_gate.py`, 59 checks on both Pythons: 17 Hosts answered (a VPN's 10.x calling a 192.168.x address, 127.0.0.1, localhost in capitals and with its dot, Tailscale's 100.x, fd00::1, fe80::1%25eth0, ::ffff:7f00:1, none at all), 18 refused (a name of one label, .local, .lan, .home.arpa, .ts.net, app.localhost, localhost.evil.com, this machine's own name, 192.0.2.2, 8.8.8.8, 0.0.0.0, [::], 2001:db8::1, a rebinding name), RUACH_HOSTS taking a name, a suffix, a name of one label and a public address. The live engine after `build.sh`, asked by curl under 26 Hosts: ten local addresses, its own LAN address and localhost answered, ten names and outside addresses refused, the https door the same both ways over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2; the lab's port after its restart (with no job running) the same.

**An 8K chain takes the painter's pass: the long side and the colours come after it** (2259; Viktor 08.11.2026 on the pass's strength: «0.67»; his 7680 preset that refused the pass was left to us). 2230 offered the painter's pass only on passes that end at ×1.5 or ×2 with the long side as they land, since the painter paints at 1.5 or 2 times the picture; his chain (span otf strong ×2, Nomos8kDAT ×4, Remacri ×1.5, UltraMix Balanced ×2, then 7680 and his ColorMatch) ends at ×2 but asks for 7680, so it refused the pass. His ComfyUI workflow paints its second pass before DF_Image_scale_to_side and ColorMatch, and now the Studio does the same: with the pass on, the chain lands at its last factor without its long side and colours, the pass paints there (0.67 by default, Second pass's noise), and the long side (Lanczos) and the colours of the picture the passes began from (hm-mvgd-hm) follow in a run of their own (`artist_upscale.py`'s finish: no model, nothing asked of the card), asked when the pass is done (`_finish_after`, as 2230's `_paint_after`). The pass's run keeps them as «then» (never in the painter's ask) and says the run it asked as «finished», or why not as «finish_error»; the finish run is named «Upscale · long side 7680». A chain that ends at ×4 still refuses the pass, its reason no longer naming the long side. The panel says under the strength «The long side and the colours come after the painter's pass, in a run of their own», the toast ends «→ then the painter's pass → then the long side and the colours»; the three new sentences and the shortened reason are in the eleven catalogs and the Hebrew one. How proven: `lab/test_artist_paint_pass.py`, 17 checks, 8 of them new: his four passes with 7680 and the colours take the pass, the chain landing at ×2, the long side and the colours riding on the pass; the colours alone ride too, and without the pass both stay the chain's own; ×4 and a long side of 20000 refused; the chain done asks the pass with «then»; draw() keeps «then» on its run and refuses one without a second pass, of 100 px, or of a picture not here; the pass done asks the finish run; a failed pass asks none; the finish itself on the processor brings a blue 240×160 to 600×400 with the source's red. The suite's 2230 section now expects the pass offered with a long side, and a new section drives the 8K chain in the panel: ticked and offered, the order said, sent with 7680, the colours and the pass, the runs' words. No card has painted it yet (every card was taken until Monday): `heresy/MISC/claude-arc/s209/paint7680-monday.sh` runs it on the newest Qwen-Image 2512 picture and waits for its three runs.

**A plugin may bring a panel of its own and the script that answers it** (2261). A plugin of `user/plugins/` brought Refiner steps and MIDI scripts; it may now bring `page`, a `.js` module the page runs while ☰ → Own plugins is on (512 KB at most, its text from `GET /plugins/page`), and `calls`, a Python script the lab runs in the plugin's folder for each `GET|POST /plugins/call?plugin=ID&path=…` (the request as JSON on its stdin, the answer its last line of JSON: a status and JSON, or bytes of a type, sent back with nosniff and a sandbox; a minute at most), and may be made of them alone. With own plugins off the page loads no panel, as a public studio. `lab/plugins.py` (`_own`, `call`), `lab/lab.py`, `heresy-pro.js`, PLUGINS.md «A panel of your own»; `lab/test_plugins.py` checks a plugin of a panel alone, a file outside its folder and one too big left out, no path in what the page sees, a call's JSON and its bytes, and a script that says nothing said.

**The cuts' strictness: as sung, on the sections, on the beat; a change of section where the music itself changes; the beats and the bars on the timeline** (2262; Viktor 08.11.2026: «В видеографе по незакрытым и по идеям, что возникнут у тебя по ходу, гони без моего одобрения»; 09.11.2026: «гони сегодня Чтеца с Видеографом по максимуму»). «Cuts on the beat» was a button that put every cut on the take's beats, each change of section first on its bar (1947, 2247), or took them all back. It is now a picker in the same place with three strictnesses: **Cuts as sung** (where the words fall), **Cuts on the sections** (the changes of section alone, every other cut as sung) and **Cuts on the beat** (the sections so, then every other cut on the nearest beat within 0.3 s, as before). A change of section now goes first where the take's music itself changes, by the player's own rule (1358: the strongest change heard within 1.5 s of where the section is sung), so the clip's cut and the section the player's wave and the DAW's ruler show (2233) fall together; it is set on the bar line, or else the beat, within 0.3 s of that change, and on the change itself when neither is that near; where no change is heard near, the nearest bar as in 2247; no shot under 1.5 s. The lab cuts each strictness from the times as sung, so one follows another; it hears the take's beats and bars once for its audio as it is and keeps them with the plan (`rhythm`, kept when the plan is cut again), and the timeline's ruler shows them from then on, a short tick a beat and a line a bar, on «as sung» too, for cutting by hand; a cut on a bar line is lit amber, on a beat paler, each with its tip. Ctrl+Z on the timeline takes a strictness back, and the plan then names the strictness the shots it brought back were cut by. The take's changes not heard (no audio.wav, the sound unreadable) are said with the answer, «the music's own changes could not be heard: …», and the bars are taken as before: never «no change heard». The page sends `undo` beside «as sung», so a lab not yet restarted takes them back too. `lab/videographer.py` (`snap_sections` with the changes, `_rhythm`, `_level`, `on_beat(how=…)`, `recut_undo`), `lab/lab.py` (/video/beats {name, how}), `heresy-video.js` (`cutsOn`, `cutsLevel`, `tlOn`, the ruler), index.html, app.css. Measured on a copy of the plan of 20261028-124546-song (37 shots, 123 bpm, the DAW's grid; the live plan untouched): on the sections, 5 of its 12 changes of section went where the music changes and 7 to the bar, every other cut as sung; on the beat, 22 cuts more on their beats, 113 ms on average; 493 beats and 140 bars kept for the ruler. Proven by `lab/test_cuts_2262.py`, 19 checks: a change 0.9 s before the cut set on its bar, the strongest of two, the beat when no bar is near, the change itself when neither is, a change 1.9 s off left to the bar, one that would leave a shot under 1.5 s left alone; on a 120 bpm click with the DAW's grid the sections alone (6.3 → 6.0 by the change, 13.3 → 14.0 by the bar, the cuts inside as sung), then the beats from the times as sung (3.1 → 3.0, 9.62 → 9.5), the take heard once for both, Ctrl+Z back to the sections and to as sung with the strictness named, as sung with the rhythm kept, a failure to hear the changes said, an unknown strictness refused. test_beats and test_batchb pass. The suite's section of 1947 is now the strictness's (four checks: the picker plain at first and the ruler bare; on the sections, 25 beats and 7 bars on the ruler and the cut on its bar lit; on the beat, the first cut lit as on a beat; back as sung with the beats kept; a failure said as one), batch B's section picks «on the beat» from the picker, and 1961's looks for the picker in the bar: the Videographer's 33 sections, 94 passed, 0 failed. Seven new words in the eleven catalogs.

**The Reader's Drama 3 reads through audio.cpp, in the quant the memory allows** (2263; Viktor 09.11.2026: «переводи Драму Чтеца на audio.cpp. Higgs у нас под своим кодом инфиренса висит»; «гони сегодня Чтеца с Видеографом по максимуму»). `lab/reader_engines/drama3/engine.py` no longer starts SGLang-Omni and its int4 build (2255): it starts `audiocpp_server` (audio.cpp, Apache-2.0, its fish_drama3 family; the CUDA build or the processor's from `heresy/MISC/audio.cpp/build/`, or `READER_AUDIOCPP_SERVER`) in the worker's own session with one model, our GGUF quants in `models/reader/drama-3-gguf/` (made 08.11 from the original weights; the engine refuses to load when the LICENSE or the NOTICE is not beside them), and sends each piece to `/v1/audio/speech` with its fish brackets, a seed (audio.cpp's sampling is reproducible: `"seed": true` now), the temperature and frames by its length, never top_k (`"top_k": false`: audio.cpp keeps every candidate as Fish's own Space does, a cap of 30 left takes stuck in silence; the room hides the field and the take's note leaves it out). The manifest gives six tiers, measured on one RTX 3090 on 09.11 with a 27 s Russian piece, Whisper CER 0 for all: Q4_K experts read a second of speech in 0.62 s (21.5 GiB on the card, 3 GiB of RAM), Q6_K in 1.16 (21.9, 11.2), Q8_0 with all 40 expert banks in RAM in 2.43 (6.9, 33.2), the processor alone in 7.0 (Q8_0), 7.3 (Q6_K), 7.8 (Q4_K). `reader.tier_pick` chooses when a run's turn comes: Auto · speed first (the default) takes Q4_K on a job card with 22 GB free, Auto · quality first takes Q6_K there; else Q8_0 with its experts in RAM on a card with 7 GB free and 40 GB of the machine's memory free; else the processor in the largest quant its memory holds. The pick is a look through the guard (nothing claimed, the Studio's models not asked to go); a card that filled since is asked again and the next tier down taken; a named quant waits for its card. The worker gets its tier in `READER_TIER` and is kept per tier; its server's memory on the card counts as the worker's (its session). A CUDA out-of-memory at the load or at a piece starts the server again with four more banks in RAM, up to 40, and the piece is read again, as `monday_gpu_drama3.sh` did. The room: a Quant select under the engine and the card (off when the card is the processor), and a line under it from `GET /reader/tier` saying which quant would read where now, a second of speech in how many seconds, and how long this text would take with its load, the processor said aloud when no card has room or the memory is short; each run's card names its quant, the time left while it reads, its measured speed when done, and «Built with Fish Audio», as the take's editor does and the take's note in the Library. Speed first because on the test piece Q4_K read twice as fast as Q6_K with no wrong letter from Whisper in either; Q6_K stays one choice away for a final reading. `lab.py` answers `/reader/tier` and hands the Reader's later routes to `reader.route_get` and `reader.route_post`. Verified: the engine through the worker on GPU2 beside the dataset (Q8_0, 40 banks in RAM: loaded and warm in 61 s, 6.2 s of speech in 14.9 s, 6.3 GB on the card, 35 GB of RAM); a run through the lab with Auto, while the guard refused all three cards (the dataset's units hold 7.8 GB on each, a service to it), read on the processor, 6.1 s of speech in 45.5 s. `lab/test_reader_tiers.py` holds the pick without a card. A release carries no audio.cpp yet: the public build would fetch or build it as an engine of its own beside the model (decided later); make-release leaves `lab/reader_engines/` out as before.

**The Reader hears each piece and joins the reading to −16 LUFS** (2266; Viktor 08.11.2026, the room's vision: «Whisper сверяет прочитанное с текстом и перечитывает кусок при высоком CER: повторы, пропуски, каша»; «громкость для начитки −16 LUFS, как в подкастах»). `lab/reader_hear.py` is the run's ear: Whisper large-v3 on the processor (faster-whisper, int8, greedy, no VAD, no conditioning on its own words), started with the run in the lab's own Python and kept while the engine reads, so each piece is heard while the next one is read and the ear never takes a card (16 threads when the engine sits on a card with few banks in RAM, else 8). Each piece is scored against what the engine was asked to read, its tags out: letters only, lowercase, every mark off for the key (the acute too: a key compared, never a text kept), ё, э and ы folded, a Latin word in a Cyrillic text folded into Cyrillic (Whisper heard «audio.cpp» as «аудио ТПП»), and a text with no figures heard with Whisper's figure tokens suppressed (it wrote «шестнадцать» as «16»). A piece 12 % or more off, four letters at least, is read once more with another seed (its voice and its other settings as before) and the closer of the two kept, the first beside it as `piece-NNN.first.wav`; each piece keeps its score and what Whisper heard, the run its whole score and its re-reads. The take is joined to −16 LUFS: ffmpeg's EBU R128 measure of the joined pieces, one gain, a soft knee above −3 dBFS that never lets a peak past −1 dBFS (sample by sample, so a take joined again after a fix stays bit for bit), the loudness measured again on the take; a run before 2266 keeps its −20 dBFS speech level. An ear that could not load or hear is said in the activity, the run and the take's note, never taken for a clean reading; a loudness ffmpeg could not measure leaves the old level and says so. The room: «Hear each piece (Whisper)» in the settings, on by default; the run's card shows the share of letters off, the pieces read again and the LUFS; the take's editor marks a piece heard 5 % or more off, what Whisper heard in its tip. The room hides top-k for an engine that takes none (Drama 3 through audio.cpp, 2263). Verified through the lab on the processor (the dataset held all three cards): two pieces, 25.6 s of speech, Whisper 4.7 % off (the one figure, before its suppression; 0.0 % after it), −16.0 LUFS. `lab/test_reader_ear.py` holds the score, the re-read pass, the knee and the loudness without a card.

**The Reader turns a recording into a script: Whisper hears it, the Writer's model cleans it up** (2269; Viktor 09.11.2026: «гони сегодня Чтеца с Видеографом по максимуму»; the room's vision of 08.11: «Писатель: сценарии с репликами и тегами эмоций»). In the Reader room, «From a recording» takes a lecture or a stream as it is (any audio, or a video whose sound is taken): `POST /reader/transcribe?file=&lang=` receives the file as the body (lab.py answers it before the room's JSON routes), keeps it in `reader/transcripts/tr-…/`, reads it to 16 kHz mono with ffmpeg and hears it with `whisper_job.py` in the lab's own Whisper turn (`whisper_turn` and `whisper_env`, handed to the Reader at its setup: a card when one has room, else the processor), three at a time at most, its job in the queue with its expected time. The words land in `whisper.json` with their times and in `transcript.txt` in paragraphs at each pause of 1.2 s or more; a failure is said in its row with ffmpeg's or Whisper's own last word. The room lists the recordings with their length and state and opens a transcript into a box to edit; «Clean up with the Writer's model» sends it in parts of up to 6,000 characters (cut at its paragraphs) through `HeresyWriterAsk`, the Writer's pick among the hosts of Engine → Writer (2097), at temperature 0.2, asking it to keep every word and its order in the transcript's language (never summarizing, adding or translating), to fix only what Whisper misheard, the punctuation and the capitals, to drop fillers and false starts, to keep every accent mark, to write «Name: words» lines only when more than one voice clearly speaks, and to begin a sentence with one of the engine's own tags only where the tone is plain. The script is kept beside the transcript (`POST /reader/transcript-script`); «Into the text» puts it into the Reader's text for the user to read over, as a dialog when most lines are «Name: words» with two names or more (a colon inside a lecture's sentence is no speaker), else as a narration, the recording's name as the title; a recording goes with its transcript and script on the user's word, asked first (`POST /reader/transcript-remove`). `GET /reader/transcripts` and `/reader/transcript?id=` go through `reader.route_get` (2263). Verified: 45 s of the Fosforida reading (`MISC/Fosforida_Novel_Transcription`) as an MP3 through the lab, heard on GPU 1 in 13.6 s, 62 Russian words in two paragraphs; the room listed it, opened it, built the prompt with Drama 3's 27 tags, cut a long text into parts and put the transcript into the text as a narration (`MISC/claude-arc/reader/suite/claude-reader-tr.mjs`, headless). The Writer's model itself was not asked: the Studio's own writer was not running, and starting it would have taken a card from the dataset. `lab/test_reader_transcribe.py` holds the path without Whisper.

**The Reader reads LCV's own letters by the glyph map, and its room edits a copy of it** (2270; Viktor 09.11.2026: «гони сегодня Чтеца с Видеографом по максимуму»). `lab/reader_glyphs.py` reads the table Viktor keeps by hand for `lcvr2tts.sh`, `MISC/claude-arc/reader/lcvr/lcvr2tts.map.tsv`, in his own format (kind, what, with, note by Tab; lit a substring, word a whole word whose neighbours are neither letters nor the acute, re gawk's ERE with \1…\9, & and \&; an empty «with» takes it out; comments and blank lines skipped; the rules top to bottom), and never writes it. «Read LCV letters by the glyph map» beside the stresses applies it to the text before the pieces and the stresses (a run and Check alike; the take's note keeps the text as written and says which table and how many changes); Check shows the count and the text as the engine will read it. Under the stress dictionary, «LCV glyph map» shows the table in a box to edit (Tab writes the field's separator) and names the author's table as read only; «Save as my copy» writes `user/reader/glyphs.map.tsv`, said so in the room, and while that copy is there it is the one applied; «Back to the author's table» lets it go, asked first. A copy with a broken rule is refused by its line (an unknown kind, a pattern that does not compile, an empty what), and so is a rule that would take the acute away; an re whose match would lose an acute keeps that match as it was. A test page (?scope=) has its copy checked and nothing written. Verified on his table (40 rules): «Сы́на Даѵи́да, Сы́на Авраѓа́ма. ЙеЃу́да из ⸂нѵ́мфы⸃ Ѳама́ры.» reads «Сы́на Дави́да, Сы́на Авраהа́ма. Йеהу́да из ни́мфы θама́ры.», 7 changes (`suite/claude-reader-gmap.mjs`, headless; `lab/test_reader_glyphs.py`). The ear of 2266 folds the letters the map puts into a Russian word (ה, ת, ו, ג, ש, θ and the Greek vowels, as the probes' scorer does), so «Авраהа́ма» heard as «Авраама» is no alarm. The switch is off by default: whether the room should read his table before he has answered the ❓ rules in it is his to say.

**The Videographer's plan keeps its history: every edit a named step, Undo and Redo across reloads, what the machines made never taken back** (2268; Viktor 08.11.2026: «В видеографе по незакрытым и по идеям, что возникнут у тебя по ходу, гони без моего одобрения»; the room's open row «a project with history»). Each step keeps the plan's state before it and its name; Undo goes a step back, **Redo** (a new button beside Undo on the timeline's bar) forward again, and a new edit drops the steps undone. A step written before 2268 (the timeline's shots alone) is still undone, named «an edit of the timeline». `lab/videographer.py` (`_state`, `_step`, `history`; save, recut, on_beat, frame_set, frame_off and make keep their steps; `recut_undo` is history's Undo), `lab/lab.py` (/video/cuts {name, redo}), `heresy-video.js` (`stepName`, `histPaint`, `histKey`, `tlPost`), index.html (Redo). Proven by `lab/test_history_2268.py`, 16 checks (a save a step and a save of nothing none; a cut; Undo after the plan read again from the disk, twice, and Redo; a shot's video come since kept through an Undo and a Redo; a picked picture a step and the Artist's drawn one none, Undo of the pick putting it off and keeping the drawn one, Redo bringing it back; a new edit dropping the undone; a step of before 2268 undone; Undo past the first refused), test_beats (its undo check reads the history now), test_cuts_2262, test_roomsa_2206 and test_videographer pass; a suite section (Undo and Redo named by their steps and asked of the lab, «Undone»/«Redone» said, Ctrl+Shift+Z in a scene's field left to the field and on the room taken as Redo, a picture's step naming its shot): the Videographer's 35 sections, 98 passed, 0 failed. **The compare window's A–B loop keeps the playhead: a loop made takes it to its start, the arrows and ⏪ ⏩ never take it out** (2279; Viktor 09.11.2026: «Если слева в конец тяну мышкой, риска проигрывания не подтягивается в выделение. Сделай так, чтобы как только выделил сегмент, риска сразу в него, и кнопками влево/вправо пять секунд перемотку, и ни в коем случае, чтобы клавиши не выгоняли риску из сегмента»). A loop dragged on the ruler moved the playhead only when it stood outside the loop, and a loop dragged to the very end left a playhead at the end where it was (the end is the loop's end too). Now a loop made, either way and to the very end too, takes the playhead to its start at once and plays on if it played; a lost pointer capture ends the drag as the release does. While a loop is on, → and ← step 5 s inside it, and ⏪ ⏩ their own step: past the loop's end a step goes round to its start, before its start it stops there, and from outside the loop it comes to its start. Without a loop the steps are as they were. A click on the wave inside the loop puts the playhead there; a click on the wave outside it does what it did (the playhead goes there: before the loop it plays into it, after it the loop takes it back to the start as it plays); a click on the ruler and Esc still take the loop off. Checked on the live page (?scope=claude, headless, muted, writes held), nine checks: a loop dragged from 40 % past the right edge with the playhead paused at the end puts it at the loop's start; → +5 s, ← twice back to the start and no further; → from 2 s before the end goes round to the start; a wave click outside then ← comes to the start; a loop dragged right to left while playing starts it at its start still playing; a ruler click takes it off. `heresy-derived.js` (`inLoop`, `rulerUp`).

**A link from another site opens the Studio once its worker is installed** (2297; a test through an https proxy on 09.11.2026: the first page came back as the Studio's own 403, «Ruach Studio does not take requests a page of another site makes», twice, while a hard reload got through). The PWA worker of 2024 asked for every page itself with `fetch(e.request)`, and a page asked that way goes out as `Sec-Fetch-Mode: navigate` with `Sec-Fetch-Dest: empty`: the document's destination is lost, and from a link on another site (a messenger, a mail, a bookmark page) `Sec-Fetch-Site` stays `cross-site`. The engine's gate (2011, 2138) lets another site open the Studio as a document only, so the very link that opens it was refused as soon as the worker stood between; the first visit, with no worker yet, and a reload that skips it passed. Measured in headless Chrome 154 against a server that prints the headers: through the old worker a link from another site came as cross-site, navigate, empty, a typed address as same-origin, navigate, empty. Now the worker turns on navigation preload and answers with the browser's own request for the page (`e.preloadResponse`), which carries the true destination, site and frame: the same link comes as cross-site, navigate, document, a typed address or the installed app as none, document, a frame on another site as iframe. The gate itself is unchanged, so a page of another site is refused as before; `fetch(e.request)` stays for a browser without preload, the page that says the Studio is not running too. `tools/console/pwa/sw.js` only, read by the engine at each request: no rebuild and no restart

The rule as built (lab/collection.py, lab/lab.py, lab/lineage.py): a realm written on a take anchors its line, the walk to the root stops there (an imported TTS root; a version imported from a take gets its parent's realm written when made). A Refiner branch's realm is worked out once, when it is made, from the take it is made on and every take it takes in (a step's sound input «take:NAME»): music only, the Creator's; any Reader take among them, the Reader's; it is written in its manifest (`realm`, `inputs`) and never worked out again. A branch made on a Creator's take with a Reader's take in it lands in that Reader take's derived/ (`made_on` says where it was made) and the Refiner of the take it was made on says so once in a toast; the Creator's takes in it stay the Creator's and are linked (Add to workspace, never moved) into the Reader's workspaces its home stands in, the link written as `linked_into`, a failed one as `link_error` and in the log. The DAW's mix of a take's own strips writes the take's realm. The family tree lists a mix's other takes as links with their realm. The switch: one 88-pixel slider (three hit zones, a dragged knob that settles on the nearest position, ← → Home End), its knob showing a note, both or a word said, in the theme's amber; each realm comes back to the workspace last open in it, and Both keeps the one open. Lab test lab/test_collection_realm.py (anchoring, the mixed realm, the links, the tree) and the kitchen suite section claude-suite-realm-derivatives.mjs (seven checks) beside the updated library-realms one; two strings and the switch's new tooltip in every catalog.

**The system bar under the header: the machine, the cards, the disks and the room's jobs, each with its numbers and two graphs on hover** (2299; Viktor 09.11.2026: «В Художнике, Огранщике и Видеографе предлагаю минипанель под хедером студии с реальными метриками по утилизации CPU/GPU/RAM/VRAM/NVMe/HDD, и туда же в неё прогресс-бары, чтобы юзер видел свою систему, а не гадал и не бегал в отдельные консоли за nvidia-smi/nvitop/btop/htop. При наведении мышкой на каждую позицию — тултипом вывод метрик и графов. Давай переплюнем ComfyUI подобные плагины»; again the same day: «За бар с утилизацией устройств не забыл? Сделай его сейчас»). A 24 px bar under the header in the Artist, the Refiner and the Videographer (Engine → Defaults → «The system bar under the header»: in those three rooms, the Studio's own; in every room; nowhere; key `yue2.sysbar`). Left to right: the processor (its load), the memory (used of total), each card, NVIDIA's and an Intel Arc alike (load and VRAM as two lanes, used/total, temperature), each disk something is mounted from (NVMe, SSD or HDD by the kernel's own word, the folder it is mounted at, its busy time and its fill as two lanes, its read ⇣ and write ⇡ rate), and at the right the room's running jobs as bars (the Artist's artwork, the Refiner's stems, MIDI, remaster, upscale…, the Videographer's clips; in another room all of them), each with its percent or its striped run. The meters are green, gold and red by level from the theme's own tokens (`--good`, `--star-gold`, `--bad`), day and night. Hovering (or focusing) an item opens its tooltip under it: the processor's model, threads, load now, time waiting for the disks, load average, ten minutes' mean and peak, the four busiest cores, the last minute and the last ten minutes drawn, and a sparkline a core for the last minute (64 on Forge); the memory's used, available, cache and swap with their graphs; a card's name, what it is given to (the Studio, training, lab jobs), load, VRAM, temperature, power, mean and peak; a disk's model, whether it is the system's or the Studio's, where it is mounted, USB, free of total, read, write and busy now, the peaks and the rates drawn; a job's take, progress and card. The machine's numbers come from the lab's new `/lab/sys/live` (`lab/sys_live.py`): /proc/stat, /proc/meminfo, /proc/diskstats once a second and statvfs every ten, read only by a thread that the first ask starts and that ends 15 s after the last one, ten minutes kept (the cores' last minute); measured 1.8 ms of CPU a second while a page looks and no thread at all when none does. The cards come from what heresy-gpulive.js already asks (`/lab/gpus/live`, one nvidia-smi), kept ten minutes in the bar. Shown, the bar is part of the bar height: `--bar-h` grows by `--sysbar-h` while the header keeps `--top-h`, so every room, sticky band and fixed panel stands under both and nothing moves while it is shown; when the window is narrow the disks' folders and the cards' temperatures leave the bar first, then the disks' rates (the tooltips keep all). It respects the 2560 px page block, hides on a phone's width, and is not asked at all while hidden or while the page is not seen. The friends' door has no line for `/lab/sys/live` in routes.tsv, so its gate refuses it (403): on that refusal the bar leaves the page for good and asks no more; a lab that does not know the route yet (404) is said in the bar and asked again every 30 s. 42 new strings in the eleven catalogs. Suite: «The system bar (2299)», nine checks (not in the Creator and nothing asked there; in the Artist 52 + 24 px with `--bar-h` 76px; the items and the theme's colour; asked while shown and no room moving; the tooltips drawn; the room's own jobs; the Engine's three choices; the door's refusal); live on Forge at 2560 px with no page error.

**The Reader's quants graded by a raw test: green stable, yellow medium, red undesirable, Auto never red** (2300; Viktor 09.11.2026: «прогнать то же, но без каких-либо корректировок и перегенераций… на какой разрядности на 30-секундном отрезке модель проёбывается тяжелее всего… стабильные кванты зелёным, треш не просто красным, но нежелательным по всей Студии. Среднее жёлтое»). Drama 3 through audio.cpp, the first reading only (no Whisper re-read, no second seed, no level change): 01-kuznya and a plain 30-s piece, five seeds each, the Reader's sampling (temperature 0.8, top_p 0.9, top_k 4097); Q4_K, Q6_K and Q8_0 on a card with all 40 expert banks in RAM beside a dataset worker; Q4_K with 20 banks in RAM placed lowest, middle or highest (a probe build of audio.cpp with `fish_drama3.cpu_expert_first`, its patch beside the results; upstream takes only a count from the lowest layer); a temperature 1.0 control; the processor alone measured after (finish_cpu.sh). Whisper large-v3 with word times and the Reader's own word_diff: all 70 card takes clean, so every card tier is green in `engine.json`. Where the tensors are computed acts as a seed: the same quant and seed on another layout parts from the first 40–60 ms, a repeat on one layout is identical to the bit. The «word» after «глубоко» in the blind set of 09.11 is a voiced insertion of 0.7–1 s (two voiced runs of 230–440 ms; clean takes one of 130–180 ms), not a breath, and those 17 takes shared one seed. The lab: a tier's `grade` from the manifest, public in /reader/engines and on a run's tier; Auto and a fallback skip a red tier, the processor's red quant last. The page: each graded quant coloured in the Quant select with its grade as the option's tooltip, the select wearing the chosen grade's colour and word in its tip, the run card's quant coloured; three strings in all thirteen catalogs; the Reader's guide in twelve languages. Results: heresy/MISC/claude-arc/reader/drama3-quants/raw-20261109/summary.md; the blind Library set «🧪 Чтец · кванты сырые, 5 сидов» in the Reader's realm.

**The lamp's guard: one stream through the analog gateway on the whole machine, and a line that says its place** (2301; Viktor 09.11.2026: «По аналоговой петле нужен будет сторож с секирой, чтобы не пропустил из двух+ инстансов или потоков той же сессии параллельные сливы в лампу. Раутинг-то настроен, но нужен сторож и очередь к Лампе»). Before, gear.through locked the gateway's card for one pass, in a folder of its own Studio: a stems print's two passes could let another stream slip between them, and a second Studio instance on the machine locked another file. Now lab/lamp.py: a step its plugin marks «hardware» takes the lamp for its whole processing, a kernel lock on one file every instance of the machine shares (/tmp/ruach-lamp.lock), let go when the step ends, fails or is taken off, and when its process dies (the kernel frees a dead holder; a hung step ends at the lab's four-hour timeout of a plugin step). Who waits stands in one line (ruach-lamp.queue.json under its own short lock), first come first served, Viktor's own runs before a guest's when user/lamp.json says owner_first (a guest's run is named by a proxy in front of the Studio in the step's params, _lamp_who, which the lab takes off before the step sees them); only the head of the line reaches for the lamp, so nobody slips past it, and an entry whose process is gone or older than six hours is dropped. A waiting job says its place and the time ahead (job["lamp"], job["waiting"]); the tree's running row says «the lamp's queue: number 3, about 4:00» instead of «waiting for Forge», one string in all twelve catalogs. Tests: lab/test_lamp.py (two requests at once as two threads and as two processes never share the lamp and the second says number 2; the owner's run goes straight after the one in the lamp; one taken off leaves the line; a holder that crashes frees the lamp at once). Checked live: the lab restarted idle, the page built and loaded headless with no error.

**The system bar in every room, folded to a tab at its right end; the keys on their buttons** (2302; Viktor 09.11.2026: «Бар до такой степени тонкий, что я бы во все комнаты открыл его, абсолютно во все. И в комнате Тренера он точно нужен… по умолчанию пусть везде будет включён. А чтобы глаза не мозолил, если кому нужны те пиксели, что бар съел, то тоже можно сворачивать плашкой вправо вверху в его вертикальной позиции»; «по шорткатам, что у нас в Студии, где это не мешает визуалу, можно добавить подсказки прямо на кнопки… в настройках предпочтений в Движке выключатель видимости этих подсказок, а по умолчанию пусть будет включено»): the system bar of 2299 stands in every room as the Studio's own, the Creator, the Writer, the Refiner, the Artist, the Videographer, the Trainer and the Librarian, the Reader's realm too; Engine → Defaults keeps «in the Artist, the Refiner and the Videographer» and «nowhere» as choices, and a choice made stays. A tab at the bar's right end folds it to a strip of four pixels with the tab hanging from it where it stood, and back; this browser keeps it so (not one of the yue2.* keys the settings carry to every browser), a folded bar asks the lab nothing, and the bar's height follows the bar's animated height, so the rooms move with it; a small script beside the bar shows it, folded or not, before the first paint, so no room slides under it as the page comes. A button a key presses too says its key in its tip («Key: Space»): the rooms' tabs (Ctrl+Alt+1…7, Ctrl+1…7 in the installed app), the Engine (Ctrl+Alt+9), the guide (F1), the player's play (Space) and sound (M), the lyrics lifted over everything (Alt+E), the DAW's play (Space); a tip that named its key already is not told twice. Where a cap does not crowd the button it carries a small key cap, as the Library's bar of the checked does (2288): the guide in ☰, the lyrics' lift, the DAW's play, Ref and full screen (the ruler's Loop and Fit keep theirs in the tip, the column being as wide as the lanes). Engine → Defaults → Hints: «Show key hints on buttons», on by default, takes the caps off, the Library's too; the tips keep the key. The new strings in all twelve catalogs.

**The Reader's crash says why: the first lines of the cause before the stack frames, and an out-of-memory that ends the server retried with more banks in RAM** (2303; the English reading of Claude's card text, 10.11.2026 03:22, failed on piece 5 of 19 with an error made only of stack frames). audio.cpp's server writes its whole life into reader/logs/drama3-server.log, and the engine's _log_tail kept the last six lines of it: a crash ends in some twenty frames, so «CUDA error: out of memory» (ggml-cuda alloc, cuMemCreate, on the tier q8 at 20 banks in RAM) was lost from the run's error. Worse, _oom() looked for the out-of-memory words in the same six lines, so the retry with four more banks in RAM, which exists for exactly this, never ran and the run failed (the rerun at 10:58 got its out-of-memory as words and climbed to 24 banks on its own). Now lab/reader_engines/drama3/engine.py reads the server's lines since its start (at most the last 256 KB), puts first up to four distinct lines that say why (GGML_ASSERT, what(), terminate, exception, CUDA error, out of memory, error, failed, abort; never a frame, never the «CUDA Graph id N reused» chatter, none of which match in a clean session of 290 000 lines), then «…» and the last three lines that are not frames. A server that closes its socket while dying is given five seconds to end before the error is written, so its last words reach the log and the error says «ended», not «did not answer». Checked on that night's log: «CUDA error: out of memory | …ggml-cuda.cu:109: CUDA error | … | libc frames» and _oom() true.

**Our fat decoders in the Studio: RS x3 v1 and RS x3 v2 beside Standard, Legacy and Blend** (2304; Viktor 10.11.2026: «прикрути наши вот эти 3x VAE версию 1, 2 прямо в студию, чтобы она уже работала все, чтобы я мог выбирать при генерации наш VAE»). YuE2-VAE-RS x3 v1 (x3 at step 161,953) and v2 (x3-hf1 at step 155,030) become two more named decoders of the engine, `rs-x3-v1` and `rs-x3-v2`, offered wherever a VAE is chosen: the song form, ☰ → VAE, Engine → Compute and the VAE tiles, and a take's own VAE switch, which decodes its kept latents again in seconds. `vae_rs_gguf.py` (in `MISC/claude-arc/codec/vae-rs/release/kit/`) writes the float32 safetensors as decoder-only GGUFs (`models/YuE2-VAE-RS-x3_v1-F32.gguf`, `_v2`, 803 MB each, 427 tensors, the encoder stays Standard's); `start.sh` names them when they are there. `vae.h` reads the shape from the file (three units at the latent rate after conv1, six units a block, `yue2-vae.halo_frames` 60, `yue2-vae.weights_f32`); a file without those keys is Standard and loads as before. Float32 for real: the weights stay F32 and the convolutions unfold into F32 too, because `ggml_conv_1d` unfolds into F16 whatever the kernel and its GEMM then runs in F16 (tiled against whole decodes differed by −55 dB, the fp16 error the release forbids); Standard keeps its F16 path untouched. The tiles take at least the 60 frames of context the decoder needs whatever the Engine's halo. With the models kept loaded, when the card has under 4.5 GB free after the decoder's weights load, the idle LM leaves first, and on a card under 20 GB the decoder leaves after its song. Measured: the engine on the CPU against the kit's PyTorch reference (64 s, four tiles) −108 to −116 dB, after the WAV's own turn-down past full scale; a 59.2 s song on the Arc B50 decoded in 6.2–11.4 s (2.96 GB working buffer for 512-frame tiles, 0.77 GB of weights), its tile seams −118.5 dB from a whole decode; on an RTX 3090 1.36 s and 4.4 GB for the process. The tip names them in all twelve catalogs: our fat decoder, Standard grown three times and trained on our own music, the first choice in our blind listening test (v1 over v2 over Standard). The family tree says which VAE made each take. Left: on CUDA ggml sets TF32 on every cuBLAS handle, so the 3090 path is −70 dB rather than true float32 (the Studio itself sings on the Arc); the GGUFs are not on Hugging Face yet.

**A shot whose H3 worker was sent away is said lost, not running for ever** (2305; found by Claude 10.11.2026 while cutting Buratino's clip end to end: two final-mode shots stopped with «Stop H3» kept their `.run` records, read «running» in the room and counted against their cards when the next shots were placed). `h3_shots.stop_workers` now turns the `.run` file of every worker it sends away into a `.failed` record with the reason, so the room shows the shot as lost and asks for it again, and the card is free for the next shot. Still open: restarting the lab under systemd (KillMode control-group) takes every H3, SeedVR2 and Artist worker with it, although `/health` shows `"jobs": {}`, so the «restart only when empty» check does not see them.
**Our decoder is the Studio's: RS x3 v1 by default, the m-a-p decoders no longer offered** (2306; Viktor 10.11.2026: «прикручивай основным VAE версию 1, наш VAE, чтобы он был как стандарт в студии. К хуям отказываемся от YuE2 VAE декодеров… дефолтным и нашу Tsunami Wave, и наш декодер, чтобы был максимум качества»). `start.sh` passes YuE2-VAE-RS x3 v1 first and v2 after it when their GGUFs are there, so v1 is the engine's default decoder (`default_vae` in `/props`, and a request without a VAE); Standard still loads after them. The engine took the first `--vae` as the encoder's file too, and our GGUFs are decoder-only, so `yue-server` now takes the encoder from the decoder named «standard» whatever stands first: covers and uploads keep encoding. The page offers our decoders alone when they are there (the song form, ☰ → VAE, Engine → Compute and its tiles, the VAE tip): `STATE.vaesAll` keeps every decoder the engine knows, `STATE.vaes` the choices; a kept m-a-p choice, a draft or a take's request with one gives way to the default; a take made with an m-a-p decoder still shows its own in the take's VAE switch, beside ours, so it can be decoded again with ours. Without our files the page offers m-a-p's as before. Found in checking it end to end, and mended: a request without a VAE was decoded by `vae_path`, which is the encoder's file, so once Standard was no longer first an API song would have been decoded by Standard and named RS x3 v1 in its passport; and `POST /vae` with `src_latents` decoded with that file whatever the request named. `pipeline_vae_path` now takes the first named decoder for an empty name, and the decode route takes the decoder the request names, an unknown name failing the job and said in the log. Round trip of 20 s of a real take (encode by Standard, then decode): no VAE and `rs-x3-v1` the same bytes (md5 31e83480), `rs-x3-v2` 02f340ef, `standard` 7d3abf80, `no-such` refused. Checked on the live page (?scope=claude, muted): 0 page errors, the choices `rs-x3-v1*`, `rs-x3-v2`, the menu and Engine → Compute on `rs-x3-v1`. Left for the 2.0.7 cut: the two GGUFs on Hugging Face and in the install's download lists (today they are on this machine only), and true float32 on CUDA (ggml's TF32 on cuBLAS, −70 dB, see 2304).
**Legacy and the 0.666 Blend out of the Studio; Engine → Defaults chooses the decoders offered, up to three** (2307; Viktor 10.11.2026: «Из Студии к хуям выбрасываем Legacy и 0.666 микс. В HF репо пусть остаются. Можно в Движке в дефолтах юзера прописать выбор активных декодеров, до трёх. Пять декодеров нафиг не нужны, тем более мы увидели, что старый и миксованный не лучше нового стандартного YuE2»). `start.sh` loads RS x3 v1, RS x3 v2 and Standard only, and `fetch-models.sh` no longer fetches Legacy and Blend (both stay in the Hugging Face repo; a take made with one keeps its name in its passport). Engine → Defaults gains «Decoders offered (up to three)», one box per decoder the engine has: ours ticked by default, Standard added with a tick; at most three, at least one (a toast says so); kept as `yue2.vaesActive`, reset with the defaults. The song form, ☰ → VAE, Engine → Compute and its tiles, the VAE tip and a take's VAE switch follow it at once; the row is painted again when the engine's props arrive.
