The 2.0.7 AppImage is built from the release tag with these; `/retest` in the PR after the release.

## heresy-lab

`lab/lab.py` — standard-library Python, port 41870, reached by the page through the Kit (`/lab/…`). One heavy job at a time; each runs in its own process on the GPU with the most free memory and leaves VRAM when it ends. CPU jobs (spectrum, artifacts, debuzz, remaster) one at a time of their own. Packages: `lab/requirements.txt`. The endpoints are listed in HERETICA-GUIDE §7.

### Running in production: two systemd user units

```bash
./systemd/install-units.sh                         # writes ruach-studio.service and heresy-lab.service with this folder in them
./lab/start-lab.sh stop                            # stop a lab started by hand, if any
systemctl --user enable --now heresy-lab ruach-studio
sudo loginctl enable-linger $USER                  # once: alive without a login, up at boot
journalctl --user -u ruach-studio -f                   # logs
```

---

## What we measured

Findings from our takes, with the conditions, so they can be checked.

**Where things live.** The music half (AR) writes the score and the semantic tokens: *what* is sung. The sound half (NAR, flow matching) and the VAE render them: *how it sounds*. Garbled words are an AR matter; solvers and steps cannot fix them.

**Glossolalia on long songs.** Two kinds: the words break down in the middle of the text, or the text ends and the model goes round singing earlier lines. The "high" Performance card (T 1.1 · top-p 0.97 · top-k 140) produced the first on a 7-minute song; the cover configs on r/StableDiffusion keep the music temperature at 0.80–0.95.

**Flash attention.** Kept on everywhere.
- Off in the AR: a different performance from the first tokens; on two seeds both takes were 4–9 dB brighter in 2–12 kHz and less clear in diction.
- Off in the NAR (same tokens): band energies equal to 0.1 dB, SNR 39 dB, 3.2× slower.

**Style against the score.** Same score (`K:Dm M:2/4 Q:1/4=71`), same lyrics, two seeds, Whisper against the lyrics (mean match per minute):

| style | seed A | seed B |
|---|---|---|
| as written for another model (B♭ minor, 74 BPM, 4/4) | 0.60 | 0.61 |
| the same with key, meter and tempo set to the score | **0.76** | **0.73** |
| a 292-character tag line | 0.68 | 0.73 |

The contradiction, not the length, cost the diction — most of all in the first minute.

**The official examples** (110 prompts shipped with the Kit): style 4…999 characters, median 124; no arrows, no dynamics marks; 29 of them have lines in brackets inside the lyrics (instrument cues like `(saxophone)`, voice cues, backing echoes).

**Whisper over music loops** on its own hallucinations unless `condition_on_previous_text` is off.

---

## Patches or commits?

In the fork the patches become what they already are in `build/`: **commits on a branch on top of upstream**, one per patch, same messages. `heresy/apply.sh --export` still writes them out as `.patch` files — for rebasing on a new Kit release and for offering single ones upstream.

**The weights in one tree, models/<room>/, and the move of an install of 2.0.6 into it** (2330; Viktor 10.11.2026: «модели… разбросаны повсюду… всё отсортировать, упаковать под основную папку Models со своими поддиректориями… прикрутить миграцию для тех, кто на апдейте… до 2.0.6… нарисовал там с помощью ASCII знаков саму структуру»). **One tree.** Every weight under `models/`, in the folder of the room that loads it: `engine/` (`yue2/`, `finetunes/<merge>/`, `finetunes/legacy/`, `finetunes/own/`, `vae/`, `tokenizers/`, `helpers/`), `listener/`, `writer/`, `refiner/` (`separation/`, `upscale/`, `midi/`, `instruments/`, `ambient/`), `artist/`, `videographer/`, `narrator/`, `comfy/`, and `misc/` for what several rooms load (Whisper, SeedVR2, MERT, SheetSage2); no links, no caches; `training/`, `datasets/`, `loras/` apart. The folders inside a room keep their names and every file its own (start.sh still reads a backbone's name from its file). **One source.** `lab/paths.py` holds a line a place and the one map from 2.0.6's folders (plain ERE, read alike by Python and bash); `launcher/paths.sh` is written from it. Every loader of the lab, the trainer, the Reader's engine (its engine.json names its quants under `models/narrator/`), start.sh, fetch-heresy.sh, fetch-models.sh, download-models.sh, models_plan.py, extras.sh, update.sh, build.sh, convert.py and convert-models.sh, pinokio.js, the AppImage's AppRun and the Windows launcher take their folders from it. The models repos keep 2.0.6's layout, so a download goes into `models/.incoming/` and each whole file is renamed into its room; the check reads it there (`hf_expect.py --strip`); a repo path in a script says `paths: repo`. `lab/test_paths.py` keeps the two sources equal, the bash map equal to Python's, and turns red on a place written by hand in the code or a 2.0.6 place left in the docs, the page and its catalogs. **The move.** `lab/migrate_models.py` at the first start of the engine or the lab (one at a time under a lock; update.sh before its check too): a rename on the same disk, file by file; a file in place skipped, another of the same name refused and both kept (size, then SHA-256), a cut-short download never touched, a link moved as a link and pointed again, an old folder that is a link to another disk moved as that link, what the map does not know left where it is; `user/migration-2.0.7.log`, `--dry`, `--undo` from the log; held by `user/migration-2.0.7.hold` or `RUACH_MODELS_MIGRATION=hold`. The page says it once (how many files, how much, where the log is). Measured on a sparse copy of the Forge's own tree (100 376 files, 1.27 TB of names): the dry run 23 s, the move 27–33 s, the undo 21 s, a second start 0.1 s; start.sh then offered every backbone and decoder from the rooms, fetch-heresy.sh --check found every part in place, and one file fetched for real from each of hf_into, fetch-models.sh and download-models.sh landed in its room. `docs/MODELS.md` draws the tree, linked from README's What It Downloads. Merged into the Studio on 11.11.2026 by Viktor's word («Дерево моделей глянул… Правильная идея. Сливай, когда безопасно. А для Тренера временно симлинки на старые пути»), right after a save of the running training, the Forge's own weights moved by the log. **Bridges.** `migrate_models.py --bridge` leaves a link at each old place to its new one (an old folder as one link where all of it moved, else each moved file; never over what is there), kept in the same log: scripts that still name the old places read on (the Trainer's runs name `checkpoints/comfy/…` in their run.json); the move neither moves nor judges a bridge, the hold's look does not count one, nothing of the Studio reads through them; `--bridges` lists them, `--unbridge [OLD…]` takes them away, `--undo` takes them first. **Our decoders public.** YuE2-VAE-RS x3 v1 and v2 come from goldhub/YuE2-RS-Finetunes under `VAE-RS/` (pinned at 11dfd0f, the merges' files unchanged since 16ff40f; the GGUFs byte for byte the ones the Studio sang with), no longer from the private goldhub/YuE2-VAE-RS; the map knows the repo path `VAE-RS/` and lands it in `models/engine/vae/`. **The day of the merge.** Master moved on all morning and came into the branch three times; its newest work took its places from paths.py on the way: the Narrator's dictionaries, licence files and setup (2374) under `models/narrator/`, SheetSage2-Refined's own folder (its LICENSE and NOTICE.md) in `models/misc/` beside its GGUF, where the engine looks for the overlay; 2380's guard test marks its fake repo's paths `paths: repo`. The move on the Forge: 100 369 files, 1 258.8 GB, nothing refused, 19 files of a private experiment left where they were, 104 bridges; the lab and the Studio restarted idle on the new places, the training stepping on through the bridges. The page's repo (build/) merges by itself once another lane's half-done catalogs are committed: its changes are words only.

**A Tailscale address is answered when RUACH_HOSTS names it** (2337; Viktor 09.11.2026, to the question whether 100.64/10 stays among the trusted Hosts: «Да, убирай 100.64., а localhost оставляй»; the unified plan's Engine item). Since 2258 the Studio and its lab answered a Host that is an address of a local network written as one, and 100.64/10, the carrier-grade NAT's shared space where Tailscale lives, was among them, as is_private_addr has it for the callers (1114). That space is the carrier's network as much as the home's. Now a Host in 100.64/10 is refused («does not answer this name») unless RUACH_HOSTS names it; localhost stays; callers from 100.64/10 are still admitted by Engine → Security as before, so a laptop on Tailscale reaches the Studio by its local address. `yue-server.cpp` host_trusted (is_shared_addr, IPv4 in IPv6 dress too), `lab/origin_gate.py` (LOCAL_NETS), INSTALL.md (the port's paragraph and the 403 row) and docs/API.md say the same. How proven: `lab/test_origin_gate.py`, 64 checks on both Pythons (100.101.102.103, 100.64.0.1, 100.127.255.254 and ::ffff:100.101.102.103 in both spellings refused; RUACH_HOSTS=100.101.102.103 answers it and only it); the engine's host_trusted cut out of yue-server.cpp and compiled alone (`heresy/MISC/claude-arc/night-2026-11-10/audits-guards/host_harness.sh`): 42 checks pass on the new source and 6 fail on the old (the 100.x ones), as they should. The engine binaries that carry it were built at 18:30 and 18:31 (CUDA and SYCL); the running Studio takes it at its next restart.

**A DAWproject is made by a POST alone; a GET changes nothing** (2338; the audit of 06.11.2026, 2.4 and §7 item 15: «GET оставить для чтения (так же с /dawproject)»; 2175 did it for art/remove). GET /dawproject built the take's derived/dawproject/ file outside the single writer's lease, and a GET is what a link, a prefetch or an old browser's page of another site makes; the page has asked by POST since 1134. Now a GET answers 405 with the POST's name and writes nothing; the POST (under the lease, with the page's MIDI and markers) is as it was, and the lab's own list of routes says so. How proven: `lab/test_dawproject_post.py` (a GET: 405 and no folder; a page without the lease: 409 and nothing written; the holder's POST: 200 and the file; a take not there: 404, never an empty project; the routes' list) and `lab/test_labsec_2175.py` still all passed.

The way's test read a refused `/lab/audio/devices` as a gateway without interfaces («choose its interfaces in Audio I/O»); now it says they could not be read. The Artist: a refused list of upscalers stayed an empty list, and the row said «No upscaler here: put … into artwork/upscalers/» over a full folder (the menus too); now the list stays unknown, the row says the lab's words and the next look asks again; the adapters' library said «No adapters for … here yet» when it was not read, and now says so in its window and on the run's adapters line; the painters' list and the size limits said nothing when refused, and now say it under the painter (asked again every 10 s for two minutes) and in Advanced; moving pictures to the trash when the covers could not be checked said nothing, and now says any cover stays on its take. The Librarian: an unread art trash counted nothing beside «Trash (Art)», and now shows «?» and why, as the Trash does (2130); a datasheet left «A Direct take writes no score» over a score from the sound that could not be read, and hid the earlier covers as none; both now say they could not be read (a 404 is still none). Strings: 14 in the eleven catalogs and the Hebrew one. How proven on the live Studio, headless (`?scope=claude`, every write stubbed, the GETs named answered 502 by the page itself: `heresy/MISC/claude-arc/night-2026-11-10/audits-guards/ag-probe.mjs`): the Refiner showed 0 plugin steps and the line, then 16 steps and no line once the lab answered; the Artist's painter note, Advanced, the adapters' window and the upscalers' row each said the lab's words; the Trainer said its first failure, painted itself whole 30 s after the lab answered, said «since 19:00» on a later failure and healed again; the Librarian showed «?» with its tip and the datasheet both lines; 0 page errors in every run.

**The Trainer's stereo guard: probes against the base model on the same cards** (2340; Viktor 05.11.2026: «Нам нужно убедиться, что мы не убили стерео нашими тренировками… если так, Тренера придётся фиксить и дописывать»; the unified plan's Trainer item «Сторож стерео: TW сужает бас, воздух и панораму тем сильнее, чем сильнее мёрдж»; for the long run's daily probes). A fifth step of the Trainer, Stereo: a workspace of probes (its sections too) is grouped by what sang each take (the backbone, the adapters with their AR/NAR strengths, and the decoder when it is not Standard: a decoder has a stereo of its own), and each group is held against the base on the same cards (the same style and lyrics), the same seed first, the workspace's own base before any other: a stock YuE2 unless another is chosen. For each group the median over its pairs of the side against the middle in four bands (bass, middle, high, air, dB) and of the panorama's spread (%), and a word: as wide, narrower past the first line, too narrow past the second (amber and red); few pairs are said as a hint, a group decoded by another VAE than the base is said, a take that does not decode is said and never measured. The measure is the one of 05.11.2026 (`heresy/MISC/claude-arc/stereo/stereo_measure.py`), number for number: 6 takes measured again by the lab agreed with its file to the hundredth. `lab/stereo_guard.py` keeps each take's numbers in `lab/cache/stereo/` by its audio file's name, size and time, runs a guard as a job of its own (three takes at a time, listed in /health so a restart waits for it), answers GET /stereo/guard?ws=&base=&again=1&peek=1 (202 with its progress, 200 with the table; a peek never starts one), and from the shell `lab/stereo_guard.py WORKSPACE [--base …] [--json]`, exit 1 on «too narrow», for a training's daily probes. The lines, a proposal for his ear, set by the Ring of 02–03.11.2026 measured tonight (240 takes, 40 pairs a side): RS-FW 1.5 as wide; RS-FW 0.7 and 2.4 narrower in the air (−1.3, −1.2 dB); RS-TW 2.0 ×0.75 narrower (bass −2.4, air −1.2 dB, panorama −11 %); ×0.9 narrower (bass −1.3, air −3.2 dB). His ear took them all on 05.11, so the alarm stands past them: bass −3.5, middle and high −1, air −4 dB, panorama −15 %; narrower from −1.5, −0.5, −0.5, −1 dB and −7 %. `user/stereo-guard.json` moves them. Strings: 34 in the eleven catalogs and the Hebrew one. How proven: `lab/test_stereo_guard.py`, 26 checks on takes made of noise whose side is a known share of its middle (−10 dB read in every band, mono, the panorama's spread growing with the swing, the groups, the base by seed and from the library, the decoder apart, the lines, the numbers kept, the lab's Handler: 400, a peek, 202, listed in /health and gone from it, 200 with the table, a missing workspace said); the Ring itself from the shell; the step on the live page headless with the Ring's table (6 rows, 4 narrower, the legend, Measure asking anew, 0 errors, English and Russian).

**The transcriber's two modes, Heretical and Refined, named alike in every language, a tooltip each** (2377; Viktor 11.11.2026 ~10:15: «Назови их как Standard, Tweaked, Refined и Refined Tweaked», then ~13:20: «убирай Standard режим и оставляй наш Tweaked как Heretical, а Refined, стабильный из двух вариантов как `Refined`, и в тултипах свои объяснения и авторство Refined варианта… Наш Heretical (Tweaked) как базовый и дефолтный… если нет стабильного режима, тогда вон из Студии». The break test on the CPU, the 20 Ring cards against the scores they were sung from (heresy/MISC/claude-arc/day-2026-11-11/code-a/break_test.json): Refined with exact angles wrote no score for card 10 (an eighth position outside the meter), no chords for card 02, the bar count right on 4 cards of 19, its bar chords 0.714 of the sung ones, 35 meter changes where the songs have 9, the key on 18 of 19; Refined with bf16 angles wrote all 20, the bar count right on 9, bar chords 0.823, 17 meter changes, the key on 19, card 01 byte for byte the night's. So Refined is SheetSage2-Refined with bf16 angles, and its exact-angle setup is not offered. The page: two toggles in the Musician's cover section, Heretical (SheetSage2 with the bf16 angles it was trained with, the default) and Refined, whose tip says plainly it is anime-song's community fine-tune, not ours, with its numbers and risks; a Library take's score asks the same choice (window.RuachTranscriber); a choice kept by 2359 carries over (its refined is Refined, its exact angles become Heretical). The Trainer offers Heretical and Refined; a set whose sheets SheetSage2 wrote with exact angles shows Standard, read-only, and keeps it. **A triple guard on every model from our repos, and on what we upload to them** (2380; Viktor 11.11.2026: «Тройного сторожа на выгрузках и скачиваниях моделей из наших репозиториев в 2.0.7 срезе. Сами репо не рефакторим, чтобы не сломать 2.0.6 и ниже. Только локальное дерево с безопасным рефакторингом папок при апдейтах»): `tools/hf_guard.py` downloads every file of goldhub/* into a part folder beside its place and moves it in only when (1) the revision is the commit `heresy/hf-revisions.txt` pins, (2) the file has the pinned size and (3) its SHA-256 is the one our manifest `heresy/hf-manifest.tsv` holds at that pin (2105 lines, five pins; the pinned list's own record must agree with the manifest, or the file is refused before any download). A failure keeps what was there, removes the download and says which check failed; a download cut halfway keeps the downloader's unfinished part for the next run, used only when whole and checked; across disks the file is copied beside its place, checked again and renamed; a link at an old path (2330's bridges) leads to its file. `hf_guarded` (tools/hf-env.sh) takes the place of `$HF download` in fetch-models.sh, download-models.sh, fetch-heresy.sh and the Kit's download-loras.sh, so Engine → Models, the launchers, the AppImage and the Narrator's fetch go through it; fetch-ruach-loras.py and upbundle_job.py check the same before their moves. The models tree's `.incoming` takes a file only from the guard, and `settle()` moves only what its call asked for. Found on the way: fetch-models.sh's loop skipped the «newdefault» line (2329), so an update said «the Studio's default decoder, new in 2.0.7» and ended «failed 0» without it; it is fetched now, and a planned line that no step fetches is a failure, said. Uploads: `hf_guard.py upload` refuses when the repo's head is not the pin read, commits on it as its parent (Hugging Face refuses a moved head too), then downloads every uploaded file back at the new commit and hashes it; upload-loras.sh goes through it. make-release stops on a pin of ours without manifest lines. Our repos keep their paths: 2.0.6 and older fetch as before. Proof: `tools/test_hf_guard.sh --scripts` 19/19 on a fake mirror (a good file, a wrong size, a wrong hash, a cut download, a pin the manifest does not know, a branch for a pin, a list against the manifest, another's repo, across disks, a bridge, an upload refused on a moved head, one checked on its way back and one spoiled on it; an install laid out as 2.0.6 left it, moved by migrate_models.py and updated with the new decoder spoiled, then whole, then with nothing to do); online, a real 46 MB file of goldhub/Ruach_Studio_Models_v2 over an old copy, checked, placed, then «here»; the manifest's VAE x3 v1 line equal byte for byte to the master on the Forge.

**The TTS Voice Upscaler by voice: Male, Female, Mixed Male/Female Voices** (2417; Viktor 11.11.2026: «Делай профили как предложил, и пометь их как Male или Female, Mixed Male/Female Voices»; a woman's voice one to two octaves higher, a man's with more lows). The step has a Voice now, Auto by default: Male draws the top from 6.5 kHz, lowers the hiss between 4 and 8 kHz and keeps the lows from 60 Hz (a 60 Hz high-pass); Female draws from 9 kHz, lowers the hiss between 6 and 11 kHz, cleans the lows under 90 Hz and denoises more gently (the enhancer's lambd halved; Clean three quarters denoised, a quarter the take); Mixed Male/Female Voices reads the take through both and joins them phrase by phrase, each phrase by its own speaker, with 40 ms crossfades in the pauses. Auto measures every phrase's pitch by pYIN: each is a man's under 160 Hz (the Narrator's own line), and the take is Mixed only when both sides hold 12 % of the speech or more and stand where two voices stand (the men's phrases at 150 Hz or lower and the women's at 185 Hz or higher, by their medians), so an expressive man rising past 160 Hz stays a man and an alto dipping under it stays a woman (the first blind set's man had come out Mixed under a plain per-phrase rule; a dialog read at 24 kHz had had its mask laid at the take's rate, not the out rate: both mended before the set was made again). The Cut has «by the voice» (the default: the profile's crossover); a cut picked by hand wins; Off is the upscaler as it was. The result's name says the profile (TTS Voice Upscaler · Upscale · Female · above 9 kHz), its summary what Auto found (a man so many seconds, a woman so many, the median). The speech de-esser takes the band's top too (speech_core.deess hi_hz, 11 kHz as before when unasked). **The seam guard: the codec's knock found and mended where a reading is joined** (2420; Viktor 11.11.2026: «Если сможешь вылечить сразу на выхлопе, то это супер»). lab/reader_seam.py finds the drop (a breath or a room noise 1.9 to 60 times over the floor that falls under 1.5 times it within one block of 1.45 ms and stays there 70 ms; a fall into digital silence, the voice's own stop and a breath that dies away are not it) and mends it: its last 90 ms above 100 Hz (over the 50 to 70 Hz knock, under a man's voice), faded to the floor over 45 ms, the codec's click just after it held under for 8 ms, then the floor let back in; every other sample stays. **Russian clitic groups read with one stress** (2447; Viktor 12.11.2026, by the lead: «не было» must come out «не́ было»). The stress pass marked each word alone, so a clitic group got the host's stress (не бы́ло, на по́л) where Russian says it as one word. lab/reader_stress.py clitic(), Russian only, before the dictionary: не before был, было, были, дал, дало, дали, жил, жило, жили, пил, пило, пили takes the stress and the verb none (не́ был, не́ было, не́ дали); не была́, не дала́, не жила́, не пила́ keep the verb's stress and are never read as the nouns жи́ла, пи́ла; не + preposition + что, кого, кому… (не́ за что, не́ к кому, не́ о чем); a preposition in the set phrases where the norm moves the stress onto it (на́ пол, на́ гору, за́ город, за́ руку, по́ полю, по́ уши, по́д гору, по́д вечер, и́з дому, и́з виду, бе́з вести…, a closed list). The neighbours count across spaces only (a comma or a line breaks the group); the author's mark on either word wins (his «Не́ было» leaves the host bare, his «за го́род» keeps the city's sense, which the list cannot tell from «out of town»). The single-vowel clitics (же, ли, бы, то) take no mark as before, and the hyphenated ones (кто-то, скажи-ка, всё-таки) are one word whose stem the paradigm marks. The gramdict index holds single forms, no phrases, so the groups are a table of their own. Before/after on a list of fifteen sentences on the real indexes: heresy/MISC/claude-arc/day-2026-11-12/narrator-lane/clitics-before.json and clitics-after.json. Proof: lab/test_reader_clitics_2447.py (18 checks); stress, dicts, reader, numbers, words pass. Live since the lab's restart at 15:06 (in a gap of the testimony runner, the Arc lock held).

**Polytonic Greek read as monotonic** (2460; Viktor 12.11.2026: «С греческим легче»). Checked the Greek path: monotonic accents (precomposed, NFC) pass every step untouched; stress() has no index for el and leaves the words as they are. Two weak spots: the engines learnt from monotonic Greek, so polytonic letters (the U+1F00 block, breathings, iota subscripts) are marks they rarely saw; and a decomposed (NFD) Greek text lost its grave accents in transport() (U+0300 is the Russian secondary stress it takes out), with the «none» transport its acutes too. reader_stress.el_monotonic() now turns each Greek word monotonic before the engine reads it (reader.py said(), for every engine unless its engine.json says `"el_monotonic": false`): the breathings, iota subscript, koronis, macron and breve out, the acute, grave and circumflex all the tonos (one per vowel), a polytonic monosyllable unaccented (ἦν ην, καὶ και) but ή «or», πού, πώς, the diaeresis kept (προϊόν), the lunate sigma σ inside a word and ς at its end; only Greek words are touched (a Russian й keeps its breve, a Russian grave its place), and they reach transport() composed (NFC), so no Greek accent is lost there; the editor's text is not changed. Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦν ὁ λόγος → Εν αρχή ην ο λόγος. test_reader_dicts_2459.py. The nomina sacra (θ̅ν̅) are passed as they are: expanding them is a reading decision, not a spelling one.

**Hebrew vocalisation and stress: a table from Viktor's corpus, Phonikud measured** (2461; Viktor 12.11.2026: «…из моей Кузни Графа или из Писателя Лексикона тот самый словарь словоформ иврита и не прикрутить сюда… Спорные огласовки и диакритику решать по массовости большинства»). A prototype, not wired: he_forms_build.py reads the ПОЛИГОН corpus files read-only (WLC+ and BHS-DHNT+ with their cantillation, WLCv, DHNT'85, Sefaria's Mishnah and liturgy) and writes, for each unvocalized form, its vocalizations by count, the majority first, its stressed letter from the te'amim (prepositive and postpositive accents set aside) marked as Phonikud marks it (U+05AB): 129,003 forms, 24,394 with a stress, in 56 s. On the testimony's Hebrew: 332 of 415 words found (80 %), 236 with a majority of 80 % or more; but a majority without context misreads modern Hebrew (יצר the noun יֵצֶר where the text says יָצַר «created», שנים «two» where it says «years»), so it is a check and a source for names and Biblical words, not the reader. Phonikud (code CC BY 4.0, its ONNX int8 model MIT, 308 MB, built on Dicta's DictaBERT-char-menaked, CC BY 4.0) vocalizes the whole testimony in context on the CPU in 1.6 s, with its stress (U+05AB) and vocal shva (U+05BD) marks and IPA; it agrees with the corpus majority on 256 of 374 words it shares with the table. Dicta's Nakdan models: dictabert-large-char-menaked, CC BY 4.0, offline through transformers. Probes of Drama 3 on niqqud: see the lane report. Kitchen: `MISC/claude-arc/reader/hebrew-forms-20261112/` (the table is built from texts not all public domain: kept in the kitchen, never shipped as it is).

**One rule for every name: no / \ * ~ ? : " < > | in what the Studio names or renames** (2462; Viktor 12.11.2026: «В Библиотеку по случаю с / нужно прикрутить сторожа, чтобы не пропускал спец символы в названия пространств и треков как в Библиотеке, так и везде, где присваивается имя или есть возможность переименования. /\*~ и другие»). The occasion was 2437: « / » is the Library's section mark, and a space named «… Drama 3 / Higgs» became an empty top with its 15 takes hidden in a section. The rule, one in the lab (lab/name_rule.py: refusal, check, cleaned) and letter for letter in the page (HeresyNames in heresy-dialog.js): a name never holds / \ * ~ ? : " < > | nor an invisible control character (C0, C1, the line and paragraph separators, the bidi overrides, the BOM; the joiner inside emoji passes), never begins with a dot, keeps to its place's length (a workspace's level 56, an album 60, a take's title 80, a preset 120…); a name that becomes a file (a Pianoteq preset, a bank) never ends with a dot either; a trailing dot is otherwise a name's own (his presets end so: «ФОСФОРИДА. Манифест. Крик.»). Spaces at the edges are trimmed as every field always did. A name refused is said, never changed quietly: the page's name dialogs (HeresyDialog.prompt with name) say under the field what the rule refuses and why, offer the cleaned name on a button («Use “…”»: / \ | as -, : as ·, the rest out), and keep OK from closing until it is fixed; a field of the page's own (the take's title on the card, the import's title, the Narrator's title and own voice, the console's mix, bus and VCA names, a text profile, a bank) asks the same question in a dialog; Generate refuses a title the rule refuses with its words (the field offers the cleaned one when left), and an untitled take named by the Studio from its hook line or style is kept to the rule. The page's own quiet changes of a / into a space in a workspace's or a section's name (four places in heresy-collection.js: the new workspace or section in hand, the new section from the column, a section's rename, the new workspace for the selected) are gone: the dialog refuses it. Where: the Library (new workspace, new section, rename of either, new workspace from the take's menu and from the selection, albums new and renamed), the take's title (menu and card), Generate's title, the import, the Writer's brief, the style and profile presets, the Refiner's setups and node names, the DAW mixer's markers and lane sounds, the console mixer's mixes, buses and VCAs, the Pianoteq preset, the text profiles, the Narrator's title and own voice, the Bank Builder's bank and its built name. The lab holds it too, so a script or the API cannot go round the page: collection.py fresh_parts (every new level of a workspace made by ws-create, ws-rename, ws-add, ws-move, ws-merge; api.py already calls it before a job), album-create and album-rename (refused, never cut at 60 quietly), presets (a new name), refiner_profiles, daw_mixes, pianoteq_live.keep, bankbuilder.build, /import (a title given; one taken from the file's name is the Studio's naming, cleaned; the workspace checked before the take is made), the Narrator (a title given; untitled and a book's parts named from the text, cleaned; a voice's name; the workspace checked before the reading, not after it). A name already there is not judged: only what is made or renamed; an old workspace with a / of its own (three «… A/B вслепую», one «пробы / шум: …» level with a colon) takes takes, sections and a rename as before, and 83 take titles with a / and 39 with a colon stay as they are. Not changed: « / » between levels stays the Library's section path for scripts and the API (1161 and 1935: a section's parents come with it; the tests and the probes' scripts stand on it), so a script's « / » is a section by that contract while the page never lets a typed name hold one; the engine's /library/update stays open (the lab's regen gives a new take its old title through it, a / included; a C++ guard there would refuse that and needs a Studio restart); the Trainer's sets and runs are slugs already; the Videographer's clip title, the version labels and the flags are words shown, not names. Proof: lab/test_names_2462.py (36 checks: the rule, 100 names × 4 options alike in Python and JS, the Library, albums, profiles, mixes, Pianoteq, the entry points), test_ws_name_2284, test_ws_parents, test_collection_realm, test_ws_forget, test_albums, test_library_2058, test_library_2168, test_narrator_lane_2437, test_daw_mixes, test_refiner_profiles, test_titles, test_pianoteq_live; check-i18n 29/0; the live page headless (?scope=claude, nothing sent): the Library's own «New workspace» says the refusal in English and Russian, holds OK, takes the cleaned name (names-lane/probe-names.mjs, in English, Russian and Greek); the page suite 1968 passed, 1 failed (the voice builder's three fields without a tip, 2455's work in progress), 7 skipped. Its first run caught the rule holding open a node's rename longer than 48 (2012 cuts it there) with five dialogs queued behind it: name: true judges the characters and leaves the length to the field's own max as before; a length is judged only where one is given (name: {max}).

**The Writer's own llama-server on the Intel Arc: a device in Engine, Vulkan or SYCL, its turn on the card** (2463; Viktor 12.11.2026: «Писатель на Arc у нас на вечер, железно. Нужно комнату Писателя закрыть по-взрослому»; the writer audit of 12.11, 3.1: the Studio's own writer ran only through the CUDA build on an NVIDIA card, so with the three 3090s training it fell to the processor at 4.5 tokens a second). Engine → Writer and Artwork now asks where it runs: Auto (a CUDA card with room, else the Intel Arc when nothing else is on it, else the processor), a CUDA card, the Intel Arc (it waits for its turn there, ten minutes at most, and is never put on the processor behind its back) or the processor; beside it the Arc's backend, SYCL or Vulkan, each offered only when its build is here (vendor/llama.cpp/build-sycl and build-vulkan, built today by the Vulkan lane). SYCL is the default: the Vulkan lane's report was not written by the evening, and its llama-bench of the writer on the Arc (17:57–18:06, the quality quant) favours SYCL for an answer: 29.6 tokens a second written against Vulkan's 14.2, while Vulkan reads the question faster (663 against 365 a second). On the Arc it runs with the card's own environment: SYCL with oneAPI's setvars (never seeing the server's arguments), level_zero:0 and no kernel cache (SYCL_CACHE_PERSISTENT=0), Vulkan through Mesa's Intel driver alone. One process on the Arc at a time (11.11: two of ours on it hung the card): it goes only when /tmp/claude-arc.lock is free (the lock our probes and the nightly songs take; held while it lives there), the Arc's watchdog holds nothing, the Studio's engine sings nothing there (an idle engine's models let go, as the Narrator does) and xpu-smi shows nobody else holding the card's memory (its stats' memory.used_mib; the kernel's DRM fdinfo names who). While it runs it watches the same every two seconds and leaves the card the moment a song, Drama or the watchdog comes, even mid-answer, and says so in the Studio's log, in Engine → Writer and in the Writing room («The Studio's own writer gave the Intel Arc to the Studio's song: send the question again when it is done»); the Musician's Generate asks it to leave first (/lab/llm/yield), and the Narrator's run on the Arc too (engine_unload_for_arc). It leaves the Arc after five minutes without a question (a card after ten, as before). A writer an earlier lab left on the Arc is taken over as before (2060), with its lock and its watch. Viktor's own settings were not touched: with no choice kept (user/writer.json absent) his Writer is on Auto, so tonight it takes the Arc when the Arc is free. How proven: the lane's run of the writer on the Arc waited for /tmp/claude-arc.lock from 18:59 behind the A/B, probe and evening lanes and is recorded in the report when it ran; the Arc's path was proven by the page and the status, the writer itself on the processor (a standalone run at nice 19: up in 14 s, a question counted, the JSON schema, Stop); the lab's own tests (test_llm_hosts, test_roomsa_2206), the live status (/lab/llm/status: device, backend, arc, arc_builds, waiting, yielded), the page's probe in Engine → Writer (heresy/MISC/claude-arc/day-2026-11-12/writer-tonight/).

**The Writer's window 32 768 tokens, the answer's room counted from it and said before sending** (2464; the writer audit of 12.11, 3.2: the room's charter alone is 7 989 tokens, and three of Viktor's songs with their score did not fit the 12 288 of before, by 284, 1 026 and 1 789 tokens). The Studio's own writer reads 32 768 tokens (Qwen3.5's hybrid attention keeps its cache small: the card's peak was not measured tonight, the lock being held by other lanes; computed from the model's own metadata (32 layers, every fourth of full attention, 4 KV heads of 256, f16), its cache is 32 KiB a token, 1 GiB for 32 768 against 384 MiB for 12 288, so about 8.1 GB where 7.5 GB were measured with 12K; need_mb 8 400 for quality and 7 400 for compact). **Drama 3: the emotional arc, two trials off by default: the piece before as history, longer pieces** (2474; Viktor 12.11.2026: «есть эмоция, но без арки… у ВайбВойс… там такая арка эмоциональная подымается, и без эмо-тегов. Сама… Пробуй лечить эмоциональную арку… несколькими методами»). The Narrator reads Drama 3 piece by piece, each its own generation with the first piece as the voice reference; upstream Fish reads a long text with the first and the latest chunk fed back as history, and audio.cpp's fish_drama3 takes such history as `previous_takes` ({text, vq_codes}). Two options of `/reader/say`, both off unless a run asks, so no reading changes by itself: `bridge: true` reads each piece of a narration with the piece before it as history, its words as sent and its ten codebooks as the worker kept them since 2419 (piece-NNN.codes.npz; lab/reader.py's piece loop, lab/reader_engines/drama3/engine.py `previous_takes()`); the anchor piece is the reference already and is never sent twice; a piece whose predecessor has no codes is read without the bridge and said in the log, never a bridge that silently is not; codes that are not ten codebooks fail the piece aloud. `piece_chars` (80–1200) gathers a narration's pieces up to that many characters instead of the engine's own; a paragraph and a Studio pause still end a piece. The take's note says either. Measured the same evening on the Arc B50 (Q4_K, Vulkan): the bridge costs time only (a 3 s piece 12 → 21 s, the prompt longer); one piece of 674 characters (the testimony's last third whole) does not fit the Arc's 16 GB (a 10.1 GB compute buffer, ErrorOutOfDeviceMemory), so long pieces are a trial for a 24 GB card. His ear decides in «🧪 Чтец · арка эмоции · вслепую» (probes-evening.md). Tests: lab/test_reader_bridge_2474.py.

МАНИФЕСТ_ Крик.» from v4.1.3.1 to v4.3.0.1, four «Я - буратино» from v9.4.2 to v9.5.0), and the list showed them as eighteen strangers. Now the list puts the documents whose titles match without the version (a trailing «v4.3.0.1», «- v9.5.0», case, a closing dot or dash, «(copy)» and «· from the backup» aside) under one name with their count: the highest version stands as the group's row, the rest fold under it, a click on the name unfolds them (kept in this browser), and a group holding the open document unfolds by itself. Above the list: the order (date changed, date created, title A–Z, the versions in a group by their numbers), the filter (all, songs for the Musician, readings for the Narrator, with takes), «Versions together» to see every document flat, and Trash: the documents deleted from the notebook (the lab's `writer/.trash`, until now reachable only through an export and an import), newest first, each with Restore, which brings it back (under a new id when its own is taken again) and opens it; a deletion says «the list's Trash brings it back». With no document open, the right side no longer repeats the list as cards (1858): a short guide of six lines (what a document is, the versions in titles and in the list, Keep and Compare, the Musician and the Narrator, the Writing room's kept drafts, the text's keys) and «Where you left off» with the one document last changed. The lab: `trash` and `untrash` in lab/writer.py, the listing carries each document's realm. How proven: the lane's probe on the mock (three versions of one song grouped, unfolded in order, sorted by title, filtered by world, deleted, listed in the trash, restored and opened, the guide) and the page suite's 1858 section turned to the guide; on the live Studio (?scope=claude, 1920 and 2560) the tools, the guide and the trash, no page errors; his own titles, read through the lab, fall into seven names (Крик 8, Буратино 4, Абба 2, four alone).

**Long texts: a paste past the lyrics' 10 000 says what it cuts; a reading for the Narrator has no limit** (2480; the writer audit of 12.11, item 16 and 3.11: the notebook's LYRICS and the Musician's lyrics carry `maxlength="10000"`, and a longer paste was cut by the browser without a word, while the Narrator reads books of 200 parts; the default taken: no limit for readings, the 10 000 kept for lyrics with the warning). A document now has a world, as a Library take has a realm: a song for the Musician or a reading for the Narrator, a two-part switch beside its title (no version is kept for the switch alone; a document without one is a song, as before). A song's LYRICS hold 10 000 characters, the Musician's own limit, and say «the lyrics hold 10 000» past 9 000; a reading's text has no maxlength and says «a reading: no limit». A paste or a drop that would pass the limit is stopped and asked about: the text's length, the room left and how much would be cut, then «Keep it whole as a reading» (the document turns a reading and the whole text goes in, one Ctrl+Z takes it back), «Cut to 10 000» (cut, and «Pasted with N characters cut» said) or Cancel. The Musician's lyrics cut a long paste as before but say how much went. «Read in the Narrator» on a document of no world yet makes it a reading (the evening's migration rule: what was sent to the Narrator is the Narrator's), said in a toast; a document chosen as a song stays one. «Load into the Musician» of a text longer than 10 000 is refused with the reason (its «Save to Writer» would have brought a cut text back over the whole one); a new document made while the list shows readings is a reading. The lab: `realm` on `put` and in the listing, kept through the backup. How proven: the lane's probe on the mock (a reading without maxlength; a paste of 10 500 into a song asked, cut to 10 000 and said; kept whole as a reading; the Musician's lyrics cutting 300 and saying so).

**Every draft of the Writing room kept with its brief, model, time and raw answer, per document; any of them reopened** (2481; the writer audit of 12.11, item 14 and 3.18: each Send replaced the draft on the page, and an earlier answer was lost). Every answer the room gets is kept in the notebook, whatever came of it (a draft, an empty one, none, one cut at the limit): the brief, the task, the structure, the model and its host, the seconds, the tokens in and out, the raw answer and the draft's five fields. A document's answers go with the document (2471: the room writes into the open document), the Musician's song has a list of its own; the lab keeps them beside the documents (`writer/drafts/ID.json`, `song.json`), 60 per list, so a document's own file and its every autosave stay small; a trashed document finds its list again when restored, and Export all and Import carry the lists (an import adds the answers missing here). Under the room, «Drafts kept for this document» (or «for the Musician's song») follows where the room writes and lists them newest first: time, model and seconds, the task, badges for «no draft», «empty», «cut at the limit», the brief's first lines and the draft's title; «Raw response» unfolds the answer as it came, and «Reopen» puts the draft back on the page as it was then: its fields, an empty one shown as the document's text now (1012), its task's guard as then (2466: a style-only draft never brings lyrics in), the diff of 2466, nothing applied until Apply. The room's own code gains two small hooks in app.js (the answer handed to the notebook after the raw answer is shown; `ruachWriteTarget` and `ruachReopenDraft` beside the target line of 2471). The lab: `draft` and `drafts` in lab/writer.py. How proven: the lane's probe on the mock (an answer for the open document kept and listed with its brief and model, reopened with its title, its empty style shown as the document's own, its raw answer; the export carrying it) and the page suite's Export and Import checks.

**Compare a document with any of its versions or with another version of the same song** (2482; the writer audit of 12.11, item 13: the draft against now came with 2466 and a version against now with 2477; between versions and between his versions kept as documents there was none). «Compare…» in the document's head opens a bar under it: «Compare with» lists the document now (when a version is shown), its versions, the other documents of the same song (2479's group, the highest version first) and the other documents; the pick is weighed against what is shown, the style and the lyrics line by line with the Musician's Versions' diff (HeresyVersions.diff): the other's lines (−, its line numbers) above this one's (+), two lines of context, the rest folded, «Lines that differ: N» or «The style and the lyrics are the same». How proven: the lane's probe on the mock (v4.1.3.1 against v4.3.0.1 of one song: the same song's versions listed first, two lines −, three +).

**An engine without the Standard VAE refuses to encode instead of crashing** (2484; Viktor 12.11.2026: «Да, чини то, что реально чревато падением с энкодером»; engine-fixes lane). Found by the evening probes: a Studio server started with VAE-RS decoders alone took a decoder-only GGUF as its encoder file, and POST /vae with audio crashed it on a missing tensor (vae_fuse_wn on a null, src/vae.h:77). `vae_gguf_has_encoder` (src/vae-enc.h) checks every tensor `vae_enc_load` reads, from the GGUF's header alone; `pipeline_configure` warns at the start; POST /vae with audio answers 503 with the reason; `pipeline_encode` refuses with the reason in the job's error; `store_require_vae_enc` returns null instead of loading; `neural-codec --encode` exits 1 with the reason; /props says `vae_encoder` true or false. The normal path is unchanged: start.sh names Standard last, and the encoder is Standard's. Test: `tests/test-vae-encoder-guard.sh` (CPU only): neural-codec on VAE-RS and on Standard, yue-server with a VAE-RS decoder alone (the warning, /props, 503, the server still answering) and in start.sh's order (no warning, an encode done); all passed on a CPU build. build/ d37edd4; the dev Studio takes it at its next build and restart.

Written into the card's table, its «What you need», the free-GPU warning and the note under the table (template.html and the twelve catalogs, the thirteen pages rebuilt; ru, uk and be say «ты» where the line said «попросите»), README (the warning, What you need, What It Downloads, the small cards, the sound engines), INSTALL and INSTALL_WINDOWS (and INSTALL's Python line, 16.5 GB together, and its Trainer line, 10.5 or 6.7 GB with MERT and the head), launcher/install.sh (it still promised 23.7 GB with the transcriber, Whisper and the LoRAs; now 8.5, 5.1, 4.3 or 4.0 GB of models), lab/weights.py (the LoRAs 2.3 → 2.5 GB; Drama 3 24.8, 33.1, 40.9 → 24.9, 33.3, 41.1 GB with the Russian and Belarusian stresses) and the Narrator's guide in its twelve languages (check_guide.py clean); the article «Why our own Studio…» (EN, RU and the wiki copies: 22.5–25.9 GB, about 122–240 GB with every room) and its card patch, regenerated with apply_card.py on the new card (git apply --check clean; the old patch no longer applied). lab/test_weight_tiers.py: one check red before and after, «the Narrator: Drama 3 at Q4_K on any card», left from 2441 (Q8_0 on a 24 GB card).

**The roots раб/роб: a machine that works says it works, the LLM and the rooms keep creating** (2488; Viktor 12.11.2026: «давай внесём исключения для запретных корней РАБ/РОБ. То, что действительно работает, пашет как угорелый, пропускаем. Карты работают, а вот LLM творит, и всё остальное творит, созидает, поэтизирует, делает, образовывает, продвигает и т.п. ОК?»). Both guards of the root now read Russian too (before, only Ukrainian, Belarusian and Greek): check-i18n over the twelve catalogs the page is served with, check_guide.py over the translated guides, one rule written twice (heresy/tools/check-i18n.mjs `keptOut`, heresy/MISC/claude-i18n/guide/check_guide.py `roots_kept_out`; change both). The one way through is a short allowlist of forms of one verb: «работает», «работают», «работать», «работал(а, о, и)», «работающий» and its endings, with «за-» and «с-» («заработала», «сработало») and «срабатывает»; and it holds only in a clause with no creative agent in it: the LLM (and the models by name: Qwen, Qwopus, Gemma, Llama, Mistral, GPT, DeepSeek, Claude), a language model, a neural network, ИИ, the Studio, the Writer, the writing room, the Musician, the Creator, the Artist, the Narrator, the Refiner, the Videographer, the Librarian: they create, write, compose. «работаю», «работаешь» and every other word of the root («работа», «рабочий», «разработчик», «обработка», «раб») never pass: a person does not «работать», and a noun cannot tell a card from an author. Ukrainian and Belarusian need no way through: a machine there «працює»/«працуе», which is not the root. One hole closed on the way: the letters list had «робк» (for «робкий») anywhere in a word, and so let the Ukrainian «обробка» and «розробка» through; it is «^робк» now, at the word's start only. Where the old guard had pushed a machine into an awkward verb, the natural one is back: ru catalog «Оно работает и проверено» (was «действует»), «всё, что здесь есть, уже работает» and «всё в нём работает и проверено» (both «в деле»), «декодер работает тайлами такого размера» (was «берёт тайлы»), «де-эссер работает только с голосом» (was «касается только голоса»), the de-esser in the chain «работает, как задано здесь» (was «действует»); GUIDE.ru «Путь в DAW работает и проверен», «звуковая половина работает на 48 кГц» (was «идёт»). Where the Studio is the author it creates: GUIDE.ru «пока Студия творит» (was «трудится»), and the four read-only lines of uk and be say «Студія творить» / «Студыя творыць» in the other window, as ru already did beside its «Творить здесь», with the guides' line of 2081 in uk and be the same way; the Studio running as a service and the Writer's model running on a card keep «працює»/«працуе». Left as they are: «трудится» and «занята» of the writing room (his own «тружусь»; the first is a key no code uses any more), «берёт» of the Remaster's steps, «действует» where English says «applies» or «is valid». How proven: check-i18n 30/0 with a check of the rule itself (five machines pass; the LLM, the Writer, the Studio, Qwopus at work, «работаю», «обработка», «рабочая» and uk «обробка» fail; «робкий» passes); heresy/MISC/claude-i18n/guide/test_roots_2488.py 23/23; check_guide.py finds no root in any ru, uk, be or el guide (GUIDE, GUIDE-READER, ARTIST).

**A big cut is never saved silently: the notebook asks** (2492; Viktor 12.11.2026: «Удалил текст из поля редактора, и он перезаписал мою текущую версию, что есть недочёт. The autosave keeps a version only after ten quiet minutes, so a part emptied within a sitting overwrote the text with no version left. Now a part of 40 characters or more that loses more than half of itself holds the autosave and asks: keep it as a new version (a real save: the text before is kept as a version labelled «before a big cut»), undo the cut (the part back as saved), or keep editing (nothing saved until a choice; a bar above the parts offers the two choices, and typing the part back releases it). Opening another document or closing this one asks too, without «keep editing». 17 new words in the twelve catalogs.

**Drama 3 on the Intel card reads in audio.cpp's streaming session: the codec decoded in windows as the frames come, not in one graph** (2516; Viktor 12.11.2026: «максимальная длина на выдачу аудио токенов, а не резка на куски»). Offline, audio.cpp decodes a piece's codec frames in one graph whose memory grows with the piece: the Russian testimony's last third in one generation asked Vulkan for 8.6 and 10.1 GB at 28 and 32 expert banks in RAM and never sounded (the probes lane, 12.11 20:50), and with all 40 banks in RAM it peaked at 15.0–15.3 GB of the card's 15.9 and lost its Vulkan device on the fourth take (no xe line in the kernel log; the next lane's server took the card at once). In the streaming session the codec decodes four frames at a time beside the generation, its state carried, and the whole sound and its codes still come back through /v1/tasks/run and /v1/audio/speech. The same take (40 banks, seed 4242, the whole testimony before the third in its window, 6474 prompt rows): 1083 frames both ways, its two decodes 51 dB apart (correlation 0.999996), 9.1 GB at peak instead of 15.1, 252 s instead of 286; the third alone at 40 banks 6.8 GB, the window at the tier's 28 banks 14.7 GB (the long prompt's prefill), so a long history on the Arc wants 32–36 banks for now. The engine's config gives the streaming session to Vulkan only; CUDA and the processor stay offline until measured (the 3090s train). Measured outside the lab through the engine's own module (heresy/MISC/claude-arc/day-2026-11-12/longform-lane: drama_window.py, compare_decode.py). Proof: test_reader_tiers (the mode per device), test_reader_bridge_2474.
